title: 御製秋日澹懐堂詩
excerpt_zh: 乾隆十四年御製秋日澹懐堂詩　玉宇暢霽光松軒俯閬井山水既清佳結搆更寛整土階每覺慚繡柱無須逞神心適可達紛營於以屏斐然翰墨香謐爾希夷境豈惟容膝安寄懐斯良永
summary_en: Autumn poem on 澹懐堂, praising hill and water and the ample plan.

title: 御製 題澹懐堂
date: c. 1797, inferred from the last dated heading (御製詩餘集)
excerpt_zh:
題澹懐堂
背嶺向空甸廓然薊野分一堂延理趣四壁泐前聞（向子）（所題詩懸壁間大都發揮理趣以著澹懐名額之義如丁未詩引仲尼訓顔淵以克已復禮已酉以諸葛澹泊）（明志為見道癸丑復申主静之㫖而曰四匆從頭觀皆意在尊聞並非流連景物也）自覺陳言緒奚如大塊文吾懐未能澹望逺正殷勤
summary_en: Written in retirement. The hall has hills behind and open plain before, and his earlier poems hang on the four walls.

title: 日下舊聞考 澹怀堂、七空闸
excerpt_zh: 長春園宫門五楹東西朝房各五楹正殿爲澹懷堂後爲衆樂亭亭後河北敞宇為雲容水態其西稍南為長橋（長春園册）臣等謹案澹懐堂内額曰樂在人和聯曰敷政協民心好惬箕風畢雨澄懐觀物理妙叅智水仁山與衆樂亭雲容水態諸額皆皇上御題又案園内諸河之水由圓明園東垣之一空閘五空閘流出環繞各所又東出七空閘灌溉稻田
summary_en: The gate is five bays with five-bay court rooms east and west; the main hall is 澹懷堂, then 衆樂亭 behind, 雲容水態 across the stream and 長橋 to the south-west. The second note: water comes from the 一空閘 and 五空閘 of 圓明園, circles the compounds and leaves by the 七空閘 to irrigate rice fields.

title: 日下舊聞考: 澹怀堂
excerpt_zh: 長春園宫門五楹 ... 正殿爲澹懷堂

title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 澹怀堂
summary_en: Finished 1747 inside the south gate, the garden's main hall and also called 勤政殿, used for government and for feasting frontier princes. Behind it is 众乐亭, across the river the five-bay 云容水态, and to the west the thirteen-arch 长桥, the longest of the gardens' bridges.

title: 老北京的记忆(81): 长春园澹怀堂遗址, quoting report and 百景图志
summary_en: Built 1747, repaired 1769 and 1791. 澹怀堂 five bays, used for feasts of frontier princes (1760) and, in the 1830s, for empresses' rites. 众乐亭 was 锦香亭 until after 1761. Macartney's globes of 1793 stood here. Second-hand.

title: 《圆明园长春园宫门区遗址发掘报告》, as quoted in 北平旧梦 老北京的记忆(81)
locator: blog post, quoting the report and 《圆明园百景图志》
summary_en: The dig of the 长春园 gate district found the layout still that of the Qianlong founding, with a strictly symmetrical axis of screen wall, 宫门, 牌楼门, 澹怀堂 Danhuai Tang and 众乐亭 Zhongle Ting, 220 m from screen wall to pavilion. It also found stone steps running into the lake north of 众乐亭, read as the imperial boat landing, and it corrects details of the 1930s Beiping survey map. Second-hand: a blog quoting the report.

title: 长春园宫门首次开放, 京华时报 via 浙江在线
summary_en: Reports that the 长春园 gate, built 1747, was rebuilt on its old site and first opened to visitors in October 2016. One bronze 麒麟 survives and now stands at the Summer Palace. It also gives the park's figures: 86 surface remains registered, about 20% of underground remains excavated.

title: 长春园题句 有序
locator: v3 p.232, under 长春园; source ref 10-735
excerpt_zh: 山水符乐寿之征，兴随所遇。日月引壶洲之景，春与俱长。乃拓余地于御园，爰效嘉名于仙馆。顾当年之赐号，时切体元。筹他日之安居，兹惟卜始。波通福海东，壖旭丽扶桑。垣亘清河北，陌香浮华黍。列缥缃以娱志，堂启含经。抚翰墨以怡神，轩成淳化。思永励始终如一，式是斋乎。开襟而气象盈千，登斯楼也。他若某邱某壑，境足赏心；有榭有亭，胜堪寓目。每几暇朅来游憩，拟耄期恒此颐恬。以纪元六十载为衡，积愿笑惟奢望。从周甲廿五年而计，勖勤敢有倦心。俪以弁言，系之长律。
summary_en: Poem 长春园题句 有序 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1770, filed by the editors under 长春园.

title: 长春园泛舟即景
locator: v3 p.234, under 长春园; source ref 3-17
excerpt_zh: 园接长春御苑东，天然胜槩境相同。棹开柳渚鸭头绿，舟过荷亭雁齿红。山树浮波滴葱翠，楼台倒影印空蒙。澄晖朗映光清洁，鉴水观心表里融。
summary_en: Poem 长春园泛舟即景 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1804, filed by the editors under 长春园.

title: 澹怀堂
locator: v3 p.241, under 澹怀堂; source ref 8-386
excerpt_zh: 闹致动无已，澹斯静有余。虽云互消息，可以悟忙徐。带水惟澄澈，襟林既朗虚。宁敎俗虑染，似与善人居。彦辅韵如彼，孔明语起予。明兹冲漠志，筹治企还初。
summary_en: Poem 澹怀堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1761, filed by the editors under 澹怀堂.

title: 澹怀堂
locator: v3 p.242, under 澹怀堂; source ref 2-402
excerpt_zh: 田盘澹怀乐碧山，御园澹怀俯渌水。仁者静兮智者动，性之所近各具理。天倪涵蓄察鸢鱼，因物付物终于是。心源澄浚气清明，洞烛群情辨正诡。
summary_en: Poem 澹怀堂 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1804, filed by the editors under 澹怀堂.

title: 澹怀堂有会
locator: v3 p.242, under 澹怀堂; source ref 6-034
excerpt_zh: 理明怀澹然，物我皆能觉。超出世俗情，识见自高卓。利欲惑性深，习染日污浊。就下益昏沉，身名嗟尽剒。淡泊志气明，灵台勤澣濯。圣狂一念分，及时修旧学。
summary_en: Poem 澹怀堂有会 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1814, filed by the editors under 澹怀堂.

title: 含经堂
locator: v3 p.244, under 含经堂; source ref 2-975
excerpt_zh: 筑墙所戒雕，构宇何须峻。阶迎花木幽，室贮琴书润。珪璋焕文府，礼乐遵先进。躬修企高坚，气质消鄙吝。学后知不足，道岂蕲声闻。推行惭前规，忧盛抚鸿运。惟此恭默思，菑畬守经训。
summary_en: Poem 含经堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1747, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 含经堂: 乾隆十二年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆十二年 (1747), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 筑墙所戒雕，构宇何湏峻。阶迎花木幽，室贮琴书润。珪璋焕文府，礼乐遵先进。躬修企高坚，气质消鄙吝。学后知不足，道岂蕲声闻。推行惭前规，忧盛抚鸿运。惟此恭黙思，菑畬守经训。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 含经堂, 1747, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 御製 含經堂
date: c. 1747, inferred from the last dated heading (御製詩初集)
excerpt_zh:
含經堂
築牆所戒雕搆宇何湏峻階迎花木幽室貯琴書潤珪璋煥文府禮樂遵先進躬修企髙堅氣質消鄙吝學後知不足道豈蘄聲聞推行慙（去聲）前規憂盛撫鴻運惟此恭黙思菑畬守經訓
summary_en: The earliest poem on 含經堂, in the last section of the first collection. Praises a plain hall, a court of flowers and rooms of books, and warns against carved walls.

title: 秋日含经堂
locator: v3 p.245, under 含经堂; source ref 3-253
excerpt_zh: 不陋非奢德惭馨，有台有沼讵称灵。生机对物观其妙，义府因心获所宁。入户云山萦峭蒨，盈庭露卉灿丁星。优游清昼读书乐，兴与秋空共杳冥。
summary_en: Poem 秋日含经堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1748, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 夏日含经堂
locator: v3 p.245, under 含经堂; source ref 4-300
excerpt_zh: 髙轩能却暑，邃室亦生凉。味道研精义，随时爱景光
summary_en: Poem 夏日含经堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1749, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 御製夏日含經堂詩
excerpt_zh: 乾隆十四年御製夏日含經堂詩　鬲軒能却暑邃室亦生凉味道研精義隨時愛景光（用選句）苑禽鳴處樂砌卉吐來芳石鼎閒嘗煮瑶琴靜不張詩吟西蜀杜壁畫輞川王差喜娛清暇還慚致治康
summary_en: Summer poem on 含經堂: cool rooms, stone tripod, a qin, and paintings of 輞川 Wangchuan on the wall.

title: 味腴书屋: 乾隆二十四年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十四年 (1759), date from the compilation
locator: p.284 item (1), under 味腴书屋
excerpt_zh: 含经堂畔敞书筵，味道腴常喜静便。枕葄崇情托经史，跃飞精趣察鱼鸢。遣闲偶染兔枝墨，结习犹披蠖叶篇。少坐亟临勤政殿，勅几惟日慎邦权。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 味腴书屋, 1759, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 御製味腴書屋詩
excerpt_zh: 乾隆二十四年御製味腴書屋詩　含經堂畔敞書筵味道腴常喜静便枕葄崇情托經史躍飛精趣察魚鳶遣閑偶染兎枝墨結習猶披蠖葉篇少坐即臨勤政殿敕幾惟日慎邦權
summary_en: Poem on 味腴書屋, a study beside 含經堂.

title: 味腴书屋: 乾隆三十四年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十四年 (1769), date from the compilation
locator: p.284 item (2), under 味腴书屋
excerpt_zh: 随宜构书屋，到处可翻披。于学贵时习，所无要日知。寜惟立身彼，特愧化民兹。经史精腴在，真咀味者谁。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 味腴书屋, 1769, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 御製題淳化軒詩
excerpt_zh: 乾隆三十五年御製題淳化軒詩　閣帖欣猶善本全㡬餘考訂為重鐫墨華輝映題軒扁石刻珍藏嵌壁磚閲古於焉閲嵗月賞心何異賞雲烟頤居倘得遂初願（内府藏有淳化閣帖初搨既為訂正重刻因於含經堂後廻廊分嵌石幅廊之中拓為是軒即以帖名名之若紀元得至六十則夀登八十五彼時當歸政居此果如所願得以翰墨静娛誠至樂也）陶冩端知勝管絃
summary_en: Poem on 淳化軒: he had the 淳化閣帖 re-cut from a first impression, set the stones into the rear galleries of 含經堂 and widened the central part into the hall, which he hoped to retire to.

title: 淳化轩: 乾隆三十五年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十五年 (1770), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 阁帖欣犹善本全，几余考订为重镌。墨华辉暎题轩扁，石刻珍藏嵌壁砖。阅古于焉阅岁月，赏心何异赏云烟。頥居倘得遂初愿（内府藏有淳化阁帖，初搨既为订正重刻。因于含经堂后回廊分嵌石幅廊之中，拓为是轩，即以帖名名之，若纪元得至六十则，寿登八十五，彼时当归政居此，果如所愿，得以翰墨静娯，诚至乐也） ，陶写端知胜管弦。
summary_en: Qianlong, 1770: his note says the recut 淳化阁帖 was set in the gallery behind 含经堂, and the hall named after it, for his retirement at 85.

title: 淳化轩: 乾隆三十六年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十六年 (1771), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 中矩折旋廊路循，略经修饰境如新。壁间帖版待精刻（轩廊将以重刻淳化阁帖，石版嵌壁縁摹镌，务在精审，今尚未讫工，而轩廊则早成矣。 ） ，座侧芸编已毕陈。鼎柏氤氲喷瑞雾，盆梅馥郁粲韶春。彩镫应节飘萧缀，无易由言化致淳。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 淳化轩, 1771. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 淳化轩: 乾隆三十六年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十六年 (1771), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 如翼两廊砌帖版，苕华阅古作清供。讵希治世符黄帝，匪学纪年慕宋宗。屏展太湖得怪石，画栽台岭徙竒松。他时结愿斯娱老（拟于将来八十五岁归政时居此），此日铭心敢懈恭。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 淳化轩, 1771, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 淳化轩: 乾隆三十八年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十八年 (1773), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 两廊石版壁安全。精核过于王氏编。嗜古因之频阅古，引年冀以待他年。分阴堪遣万几暇，尺宅恒惺方寸田。虽曰宋宗无可企，以言淳化亦应然（向作淳化轩记，以轩因帖命名，非慕宋太宗之年号意，木如此夫宋太宗始终家国之问，多惭德其人，固不足取，然化理欲淳，实为君者所当勉也）。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 淳化轩, 1773, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 含经堂: 乾隆三十九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十九年 (1774), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 例踰节事始来过，率以灯筵庆赏多。岂似芸编资古汲，已看梅蕊受春和。诸家执臆说诚伙，一室操戈理则那。删驳折中信非易，吾方勉此敢延俄（近命词臣校勘四库全书，每取原书披阅，或缮冩进呈，见其中有《义解踳杂》，纪载失实，辄为题识辩论书之巻端，亦有举其讹舛处，谕诸臣随时订正者。）。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 含经堂, 1774, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 淳化轩: 乾隆三十九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十九年 (1774), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh:
堂（含经）后斋（藴真）前步屧巡，两廊石刻早安匀（昨经三仿终还始，昨岁曾取刻帖，时双钩油条填墨对临。自五月中驻避暑山庄，至木兰行围，回跸凡四阅，月计临三
遍）。却鲜一如精与神，略省察都愧往古。少徘徊又是新春，即兹灯节宁能罢，无易由言欲化淳。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 淳化轩, 1774, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 含经堂: 乾隆四十年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆四十年 (1775), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 闲余节后到书堂，例以新正有咏章。那可放心因政简，依然即景为诗忙。欣看薫蘤含春意，笑指寒檠孤夜光（堂中虽例悬华檠，而曾未燃烛夜赏） 。计日文华循讲典（将以二月初六日举行经筵），枕经先此绎思长。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 含经堂, 1775, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 含经堂: 乾隆四十一年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆四十一年 (1776), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 节前本无暇，节后略余闲。况值开印未，尚迟引见班（开印后方进阁本，各部轮班奏事引见）。圆明及长春，无过咫尺间。冰床渡冻浦，笋舆入松闗。坐我含经堂，展彼霏芸编。不为劳爱耳，洵有益开焉。设问益何得，自反㣲赧颜。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 含经堂, 1776, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 含经堂: 乾隆四十二年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆四十二年 (1777), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 例以来节后（迩年率以节后务间方至此屡见向咏），稍闲乃逮斯。已惭多构筑，宁敢恣游嬉。盆卉当春发，架编遣暇披。东厢贮荟要，数典不忘兹（是处东厢仿宫中摛藻堂之式，按经、史、子、集列架并命缮四库全书荟要贮之）。
summary_en: Qianlong, 1777: his note says the east wing was shelved after 摛藻堂 to hold the 四库全书荟要.

title: 含经堂: 乾隆四十六年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆四十六年 (1781), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 昔岁上元过后来（往年上元节后，每至斯堂，率有题咏，故有闲余节后到书堂例，以新正有咏章之句） ，即今依例此清陪。事无不可过去者（昔有句云：无不可过去之事） ，心则安能顿忘哉。灯火虽教答令节，杯桊仍复引余哀。慎终追远宣尼训，经义由来二语该。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 含经堂, 1781, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 味腴书屋: 乾隆四十六年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆四十六年 (1781), date from the compilation
locator: p.284 item (3), under 味腴书屋
excerpt_zh: 含经堂左箱，荟要个中蔵（四库全书荟要二部，一贮大内者，每册末页用摛藻堂印，一贮御园者，用味腴书室印。）。四库贯今古，万籖贮缥缃。虽云稡精秘，尚自浩汪洋。六部天人备（谓经），千秋治乱详（谓史）。百家纯与驳（谓子），诸集否和臧（谓集）。元以钩而获，腴其味则长。宁输二酉富，祇为万几忙。那得闲无事，于斯枕葄偿。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 味腴书屋, 1781, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 味腴书屋: 乾隆四十七年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆四十七年 (1782), date from the compilation
locator: p.284 item (4), under 味腴书屋
excerpt_zh: 荟要收四库（是室中，列书厨弆四库全书荟要），味腴沃一心。六经言与行，诸史古和今。子已分粹驳，集犹资酌斟。如云踰尝鼎，厓略在精寻。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 味腴书屋, 1782, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 淳化轩: 乾隆四十八年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆四十八年 (1783), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 重摹淳化帖，石版砌厢廊。遂以颜轩额，寜云摹宋皇。亦经几岁月（壬辰年重刻淳化阁帖，成以石嵌轩壁，阅今巳十二年，计宋淳化初刻时几八百年矣。 ） ，时复赏烟光。望雪逢优雪，益増敬不遑。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 淳化轩, 1783, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 含经堂: 乾隆五十年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆五十年 (1785), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 过节芸堂至，率成例事如。闹余颇喜静，几浄遂观书。改过偶思彼（用论语蘧伯玉事），躬行何有予。十年屈指近，娱老企斯居（今岁乙巳新韶至乙夘，归政之期屈指十年）。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 含经堂, 1785, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 味腴书屋: 乾隆五十二年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆五十二年 (1787), date from the compilation
locator: p.284 item (5), under 味腴书屋
excerpt_zh: 四库浩无涘，因成荟要书。依然庋厨阁，何有玩居诸。腴匪外来者，味当已饫如。芸编翻却置，笑负少年初。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 味腴书屋, 1787, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 淳化轩: 乾隆五十二年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆五十二年 (1787), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 淳化因蔵帖，循名未副名。岂真在墨宝，讵可忘民生。风俗漓惟甚，货财价匪轻。徒称滋户口（我朝顺治初年，民数不过一千六十三万，今休养生息百数十年，民数已至二万七八千万之多，较国初增二十倍，户口多则用物多，物价安得不贵，此保泰所以难也），惭愧在持盈。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 淳化轩, 1787. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 含经堂: 乾隆五十六年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆五十六年 (1791), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 自昔元宵三五仍，挈壶时刻别除乘。兹当置望逢十七，却看满轮无减增（上元本言十五而望，或有迟一二日者，今岁正月置望在十七，今夜月轮始满） 。昨偶值风烟火罢（御园镫节，例以十三日起至燕九日收，灯前十四日以傍晩雪势未止，停放烟火，十五正日恰即晴霁，依例举行，昨十六日又以值风停止，七日之内偶停一二日，亦属恒事耳） ，今犹婪节宴游应。买镫那一钱王藉（容斋随笔云：西京正月十五前后各一日看镫，本朝增为五夜，俗言钱忠懿纳土进钱买两夜，遂展至十七十八），中外百年乐可征（向例上元节于御园正大光明殿筵宴各蒙古回部外藩及各国使臣，晚间命于山高水长楼前观放烟火，并令随至同乐园观庆丰图，以示优惠。今岁西北则増哈萨克斯坦，南则増暹罗、缅甸诸藩国来使，我朝百数十年版图式廓，中外一家，欢若家庭，实亦自昔罕闻） 。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 含经堂, 1791, on banquets. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 含经堂: 乾隆五十六年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆五十六年 (1791), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 节后临堂例合仍，庆宵行惠暇难乘。曦烘菱牖昼渐永，雪积玉林景倍増。膏泽扫培真富有，勤劳行赏亦均应（每得雪后，命步甲园户等扫培树根，即藉以行赏，岁为成例，亦敛时敷锡之一端也）。敛时福更敷而锡，义叶含经念庶征。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 含经堂, 1791, on snow. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 淳化轩: 乾隆五十六年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆五十六年 (1791), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 春寒今岁勒花荣，淳化庭梅却发英。讶看舒风迎玉砌，悟因护暖罩毡棚。笑嬴盆树枯和菀（屋中盆梅却烂漫矣），幻结山桃弟与兄（近日山桃始开）。芳谱何须分次第，傥来七字偶摅情。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 淳化轩, 1791, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 含经堂: 乾隆五十七年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆五十七年 (1792), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh:
长春园拟倦勤居（圆明圆之东曰长春园，乃予预葺以待归政后所居，与大内之宁寿宫同。），
堂曰含经久额子。四载为期即归政，一生惟是不离书。可知凡事豫则立，鲜得如心愿以舒。敬忆当年嘉号赐雍正年间，因集当今法会以纪一时问答语，予曾仰蒙恩赐长春居士之号，今即以名园，计倦勤居此，近阅四载，颙冀上苍鸿佑，若果符斯愿，是当年恩贶已为之兆矣），或叨天佑望无虚。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 含经堂, 1792, on state papers. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 淳化轩: 乾隆五十七年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆五十七年 (1792), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 庭梅自与盆梅异，谢却火攻何碍迟。犹忆昔年言理趣，显仁蔵用会于斯。” “今年春冷因通闰，最早山桃亦放迟。却是庭梅具深意，送行几朵发英斯（向年，庭梅至春仲已盛开，今岁以通闰，花信俱迟，日内将启跸西巡，枝头数朵舒英如有意然。）。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 淳化轩, 1792, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 味腴书屋: 嘉庆七年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆七年 (1802), date from the compilation
locator: p.284 item (6), under 味腴书屋
excerpt_zh: 古籍先言味㝡腴，几闲探讨作君谟。唐虞善行难师法，莅政临民实恧吾。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 味腴书屋, 1802, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 味腴书屋: 嘉庆八年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆八年 (1803), date from the compilation
locator: p.284 item (7), under 味腴书屋
excerpt_zh: 治理在简编，诗书存古训。精华味最腴，探寻心切近。沉潜务虚衷，可益真学问。圣道亘千秋，日月经天运。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 味腴书屋, 1803, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 味腴书屋: 嘉庆十五年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十五年 (1810), date from the compilation
locator: p.284 item (8), under 味腴书屋
excerpt_zh:
图治有源本，简编勉味腴。
史经总同贯，今古岂殊途。荟要充楹栋，研精在黄谟。诚求行实政，化雨渐涵濡。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 味腴书屋, 1810, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 味腴书屋: 嘉庆二十四年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆二十四年 (1819), date from the compilation
locator: p.285 item (9), under 味腴书屋
excerpt_zh: 旧额箴心随处题，味余勤学得端倪。衷无嗜好政清简，葄史枕经古与稽。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 味腴书屋, 1819, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 味腴书屋: 嘉庆二十四年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆二十四年 (1819), date from the compilation
locator: p.285 item (10), under 味腴书屋
excerpt_zh: 旧额书斋及六旬，益勤温故庶知新。文源有本时探讨，学海无涯日引伸。师范常怀虞怠惰，圣功力勉永遵循。屏除杂念守成宪，修已诚求安万民。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 味腴书屋, 1819, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 淳化轩: 道光四年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
date: 道光四年 (1824), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 世俗叹浇薄，天恩感渥深。永思不忍政，常廑化淳心。恭俭身应率，真诚道可寻。兢兢瞻宝翰，绍衣凛微忱。
summary_en: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 淳化轩, 1824. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 御製淳化軒記
date: 乾隆 (undated in S05; the stones set up by 1770)
excerpt_zh: 御製淳化軒記淳化軒何為而作也以藏重刻淳化閣帖石而作也蓋自伏滔崆峒之銘石虹堯碑之文歴代相傳石刻尚焉然物有其成必有其壊世逺年湮真偽莫辨則漢唐且難得其全者無論周秦以上矣故言帖必以趙宋為猶近而宋帖必以淳化為最羙重刻之由考稽之故已見於帖前之頁册後之䟦兹不複記記所以藏石作軒之故云石刻既成凡若干頁使散置之慮其有失也爰於長春園中含經堂之後就舊有之廻廊每廊砌石若干頁恰得若干廊而帖石畢砌焉廊之中原有蘊真齋因稍移齋於其北即舊基而拓為軒事起藏帖則以帖名名之夫淳化宋太宗之紀年也為人君者即不能以唐虞為師亦當以夏甲周成為軌所謂取法乎上僅能得其中耳若宋太宗始終國家之間慙德多矣吾所不取而又有何慕於淳化而以之名軒為哉
summary_en: Why 淳化軒 exists: the re-cut 淳化閣帖 stones were set in the existing galleries behind 含經堂, and 蘊真齋 was moved north onto old foundations so that a hall could be built on the site.

title: 日下舊聞考 含经堂
excerpt_zh: 雲容水態西北循山逕入建琉璃坊楔三其北宫門五楹南嚮内爲含經堂七楹後為淳化閣又後爲蘊真齋含經堂東為霞翥樓為淵映齋堂西為梵香樓為涵光室（長春園册）臣等謹案淳化軒内額曰奉三無私聨曰貞石麗延廊畧存古意淳風扇寰宇冀遂初心東西廊廡壁間嵌御定淳化閣帖石刻藴真齋内額曰禮園書圃霞翥樓内額曰味腴書屋
summary_en: Three glazed arches, a five-bay gate facing south, the seven-bay 含經堂, then 淳化軒 (printed 閣), 蘊真齋 behind, with 霞翥樓, 淵映齋, 梵香樓 and 涵光室. The rock-cut 淳化閣帖 stones lined the side galleries; 霞翥樓 holds the plaque 味腴書屋.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 含经堂
summary_en: The 1747 poem is on the newly finished hall. A note of 1777 says the east wing was shelved like 摛藻堂 in the palace for the 四库全书荟要. Most poems are about reading. The compiler captions a poem of 1791 as a feast here, but the poem's own note puts the banquet at 正大光明殿. 含经堂: 34 dated items, 1747-1810, of which 34 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: reading, the view, escaping the heat. First dated 1747, last dated 1810.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 味腴书屋
summary_en: A reading room in the 含经堂 compound (also written 味腴书室, 味余书室); poems of 1781-1787 have Qianlong consulting the 四库全书荟要 here. 味腴书屋: 10 dated items, 1759-1819, of which 10 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: reading. First dated 1759, last dated 1819.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 淳化轩
summary_en: In 1770 Qianlong had a good rubbing of the 淳化阁帖 recut, set the slabs into the gallery walls behind 含经堂 and widened the gallery into this hall, meaning to retire here at 85. A note of 1771 says the galleries were done and the carving was not. 淳化轩: 21 dated items, 1770-1824, of which 21 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing, Daoguang); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1770, last dated 1824.

title: 长春园 No.2, 含经堂 Hanjing Tang
excerpt_other: A palace on the large island in the center of the garden which was almost as large as the emperor's private palace in the Yuan Ming Yuan, and contained an inscribed stone tablet to Emperor Yu the Great which had been handed down from several dynasties before the Sung.
summary_en: Almost as large as the emperor's own palace in the Yuan Ming Yuan, with an old inscribed tablet. Qianlong is said to have retired here after abdication (Yuan's memorandum, hearsay). Plate p.100: rock garden north of it; p.101 calls it very extensive.

title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 含经堂
summary_en: The largest group in this garden, finished 1747, rebuilt 1770 with 淳化轩, 蕴真斋, 三友轩, 静莲斋, 待月楼 and 理心楼. 含经堂 is a seven-bay double-eaved glazed hall; 霞翥楼 mirrors 梵香楼 and, with the inner plaque 味腴书室, held the 四库全书荟要, which identifies our 味腴书屋. A stage was added east of 淳化轩 in 1814. Guards were still posted after 1860.

title: 神心妙达 at 淳化轩
summary_en: In 1814 the 乐奏钧天 stage and dressing rooms went up on the east of 淳化轩, and 神心妙达 was rebuilt as the hall to watch from. The same words in S05 j81:35b are a quotation in the 水木明瑟 preface and have nothing to do with this hall.

title: 嘉庆帝所题圆明园淳化轩诗考析 (尤李)
summary_en: Through Jiaqing's poems. It dates the addition of 淳化轩, 蕴真斋, 三友轩, 静莲斋, 待月楼 and 理心楼 behind 含经堂 to 1770, when the compound reached full size. The 重刻淳化阁帖 stones were set in the galleries in front of 淳化轩.

title: 含经堂平面图 (图名: 长春园淳化轩)
date: 原图乾隆五十九年 (1794) 后, 贴样嘉庆十九年 (1814)
locator: 国家图书馆善本部 样021-23号
summary_en: Presentation plan of Hanjing Tang under the title Chunhua Xuan, 722x503 mm, colour and ink with red and yellow slips, drawn after 1794 with a pasted slip of 1814. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

title: 含经堂 dig: 地天母 bronze from 梵香楼
summary_en: Approval to survey and dig 长春园宫门 and 含经堂 came in March 2001, and the cleared site was presented by December 2003. A small bronze Buddha inscribed 地天母 was found; the park's archaeologist identifies it as the only known survivor of the 700-odd images of 梵香楼 Fanxiang Lou.

title: 北京圆明园含经堂遗址2001~2002年度发掘简报, 考古 2004(2): 41-65
summary_en: Brief report of the 2001-2002 seasons at 含经堂 Hanjing Tang: the site covers over 60,000 m2, with building remains over 30,000 m2 in more than 30 units. Only the abstract is reachable; the full 25 pages must be requested.

title: 澄波夕照 at 含经堂
date: c. 2011 blog, on the dig of 2001-03
summary_en: After the dig of 2001-03 at 含经堂, the foundations of 澄波夕照, 得胜概 and a rock pavilion were restored in part. So the label on S01 has a site on the ground.

title: 含经堂 乐奏钧天 stage as cited in 圆明园戏场探微
summary_en: The park's theatre paper reports the excavated 乐奏钧天 Yuezou Juntian stage of 含经堂 as about 16 m square, built over a granite cellar with a clear height of 2.47 m.

title: 淳化轩
locator: v3 p.256, under 含经堂; source ref 10-839
excerpt_zh: 屏石叠玲珑，文轩有路通。建廊藏帖版，开户对薰风。烟月怡神表，古今想像中。设因验治理，亦得我心同。
summary_en: Poem 淳化轩 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1771, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 淳化轩
locator: v3 p.256, under 含经堂; source ref 10-857
excerpt_zh: 延清契道筦，却暑抚薰弦。此日忧勤励，他年颐养便
summary_en: Poem 淳化轩 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1771, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 淳化轩
locator: v3 p.258, under 含经堂; source ref 11-246
excerpt_zh: 若翼敞轩楹，明窗几席清。宁惟展古帖，藉以缮今情。庭树芳藏干，盆梅馥满英。华灯悬应节，所惭是循名。
summary_en: Poem 淳化轩 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1772, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 御製 詠淳化軒庭梅二首一韻
excerpt_zh:
詠淳化軒庭梅二首一韻
庭梅自與盆梅異謝却火攻何礙遲猶憶昔年言理趣顯仁蔵用㑹扵斯（顯諸仁即蔵諸用一闔一闢生生之所以不息也庭前植梅二株冬間圍）（以氊棚向陽開門春暖則徹棚花發即一梅而顯蔵之理可㑹丁未淳化軒對庭梅作識語中曽闡其義）今年春冷因通閏最早山桃亦放遲却是庭梅具深意送行㡬朶發英斯（向年庭梅至春仲已盛開今嵗以通閏花信俱遲日内将唘蹕西巡枝頭）（數朶舒英如有意然）
summary_en: Two plum trees in the court of 淳化軒 are wrapped in a felt shelter with a south door over winter and uncovered in spring.

title: 御製 題淳化軒
excerpt_zh:
題淳化軒
宫寧夀御園淳化（是處之淳化軒亦猶大内之寧夀宫皆豫為歸政後娛老之所也）都為菟裘娛老居數嵗以前豫立者一年已近即真予天恩獨厚鑒由始衆意雖殷志踐初（予於踐阼之初焚香告天若得）（在位六十年即當歸政今已仰䝉之誠鑒佑幸符初願在天下臣民以及外藩䝉古愛戴以予精力康健）（猶昔無不望予未即倦勤者予亦未嘗不諒其悃忱顧予已上告昊蒼曷敢有渝初志耶）廿五竟符八六願（予即位時年已二十五嵗以百嵗計之已逾四分之一而當陳願之始實未計及在位六）（十年夀當耄耋也明嵗元日傳位嗣皇帝子則八十六嵗若如所願自三代而後未有聞者予之仰䝉天）（眷自非豈易篤愛所獨鍾臻此）豈容易得漫虚譽
summary_en: Written in the year before his abdication. His note compares 淳化軒 with 寧夀宫 in the palace: both were prepared as places for his old age.

title: 榆巢雜識
excerpt_zh: ○淳化阁帖内府所刻帖，三希堂帖，嵌于阅古楼；墨妙轩帖，嵌于万寿山惠山园中。乾隆癸巳，重刻淳化阁帖成。适长春园中新构文轩落成，右、左廊各十二楹，每楹分嵌六石，即以淳化名轩。尝拓四百部，分赐群臣。内府拓帖，多用乌金拓，独此仿蝉翼拓，犹存古意。
summary_en: 淳化軒 was finished as the stones were: galleries of twelve bays on each side, each bay holding six stones. Gives the year as 癸巳 (1773), against 1770 in S05.

title: 蕴真斋
locator: v3 p.246, under 含经堂; source ref 5-324
excerpt_zh: 游览未可亟，宴息贵有时。澹宁斯亦佳，藻缋徒尔为。远愧尧代阶，近取谢氏诗。葆光味妙理，养粹协化机。宁独尚清静，治理从此施。
summary_en: Poem 蕴真斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1755, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 蕴真斋
locator: v3 p.251, under 含经堂; source ref 9-396
excerpt_zh: 道筦天倪自有端，书斋触目入澄观。恰如万物含韶际，真意应从蕴处看。
summary_en: Poem 蕴真斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1768, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 蕴真斋
locator: v3 p.261, under 含经堂; source ref 12-526
excerpt_zh: 蕴为发之始，真则假之对。真以蕴乃佳，假以发斯味。真诚而假私，返身必由内。然与斋何涉，循名实可背。愿言勉克己，如临师保诲。
summary_en: Poem 蕴真斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1774, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 渊映斋偶题
locator: v3 p.252, under 含经堂; source ref 10-643
excerpt_zh: 斋非近池构，何以称渊映。讵曰漫与名，亦惟别托兴。或跃玩羲爻，如临凛诗敬。颇有澄澈趣，而无波澜竞。月影落空庭，岂异琳塘净。
summary_en: Poem 渊映斋偶题 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1770, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 题渊映斋
locator: v3 p.263, under 含经堂; source ref 12-669
excerpt_zh: 书斋实弗临池水，渊映胡然题额名。只为昼存与宵养，欲知物理及民情。
summary_en: Poem 题渊映斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1775, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 渊映斋
locator: v3 p.265, under 含经堂; source ref 12-962
excerpt_zh: 渊乃训其深，映乃训其委。惟深斯不穷，则委皆成美。其要曰忘物，而更在忘己。试看渊映间，其中鲜彼此。书斋讵玩景，顾名当会理。设云即景题，阶前无止水。
summary_en: Poem 渊映斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1777, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 涵光室有咏
locator: v3 p.249, under 含经堂; source ref 7-332
excerpt_zh: 曰明乃是光，于暗义斯堕。曰暗实无光，试向虚室坐。光固有恒性，明暗无不可。明光灭暗生，暗光灭明作。生灭岂涉光，如是薪传火。
summary_en: Poem 涵光室有咏 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1760, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 涵光室有会
locator: v3 p.263, under 含经堂; source ref 12-669
excerpt_zh: 冬室欲其暖，夏室欲其凉。惟有春之室，所喜涵韶光。韶光融户外，十笏中能藏。放弥卷则退，羲经言已详。又如虚生白，颇亦契蒙庄。即景得静会，止止来千祥。
summary_en: Poem 涵光室有会 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1775, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 涵光室口号
locator: v3 p.265, under 含经堂; source ref 12-962
excerpt_zh: 涵光室里说涵光，此意分明是注庄。更咏春生何处好，试看止止纳千祥。
summary_en: Poem 涵光室口号 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1777, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 三友轩
locator: v3 p.254, under 含经堂; source ref 10-736
excerpt_zh: 禁中三友轩，额为藏名迹。园中三友轩，窗外真培植。名实虽不同，要以取有益。寓意非玩物，向曾咏其德
summary_en: Poem 三友轩 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1770, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 御製 三友軒
excerpt_zh:
三友軒
禁中三友軒額為（去聲）藏名蹟園中三友軒窓外真培植名實雖不同要以取有益寓意非玩物向曽詠其徳（舊題）（三友軒詩以松喻直梅喻諒竹喻多聞並就其徳性推言之）益常願居前損則應離側三者正相反求友可不擇於恒總宜謹況在躬為辟
summary_en: He separates the 三友軒 in the palace, named for paintings it holds, from the one in the garden, named for the pine, plum and bamboo planted outside its window.

title: 三友轩歌
locator: v3 p.284, under 含经堂; source ref 2-90
excerpt_zh: 松高荫翠招长风，飒然拂竹摇玲珑。迎冬梅蕊机已动，素心相印形神通。品尊卉木推三友，浮筠劲节岁寒守。肯因冰雪易贞坚，夭桃秾李皆厮走。
summary_en: Poem 三友轩歌 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1801, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 题三友轩
locator: v3 p.296, under 含经堂; source ref 4-180
excerpt_zh: 严飙卷冻云，暖旭映朱牗。蜃窗朗西轩，坐对三益友。苍颜欣不凋，夭矫岁寒后。筼筜枝茂蕃，碧筠劲节守。梅占百花先，冷艳屏尘垢。神契物外交，忘年乐悠久。
summary_en: Poem 题三友轩 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1809, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 御製 理心樓
date: c. 1770, inferred from the last dated heading (御製詩三集)
excerpt_zh:
理心樓
華節甫言過新正頗有暇御苑適清逰卜晝弗卜夜室樓如暖閣（廣厦中鋪板為層室非重樓傑構也）憩息明窓下理心向所題心理在私化竹素具淵源繕性因抽架
summary_en: The note gives a building form: 理心樓 is not a real upper storey, but a floor of boards laid inside a large hall, like a warm room.

title: 理心楼
locator: v3 p.254, under 含经堂; source ref 10-736
excerpt_zh: 书屋名理心，问心云何理。寻思非由外，仍由心内耳。颜渊问为仁，曰克己复礼。己似外物诱，克则从衷矣。至于礼之复，实复心本始。不敏请事斯，吾愿学颜子。
summary_en: Poem 理心楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1770, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 理心楼
locator: v3 p.256, under 含经堂; source ref 10-780
excerpt_zh: 华节甫言过，新正颇有暇。御苑适清游，卜昼弗卜夜。
summary_en: Poem 理心楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1771, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 理心楼口号
locator: v3 p.255, under 含经堂; source ref 10-776
excerpt_zh: 一二日间有万几，易云几者动之微。理心设不于斯会，反致憧憧失所依。
summary_en: Poem 理心楼口号 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1771, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 静莲斋
locator: v3 p.252, under 含经堂; source ref 10-707
excerpt_zh: 斋前本无池，无池安得莲。然则奚名斋，寓意有取焉。芳葩植瓶中，奇峰耸庭前。曰假假固非，谓真真实然。而此非了义，半提讵提全。绣佛供花龛，见叶贮珠编。时偶值几暇，净几几页翻。可以空五蕴，可以息万缘。静乃在斯乎，青莲口所宣。
summary_en: Poem 静莲斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1770, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 静莲斋
locator: v3 p.257, under 含经堂; source ref 10-857
excerpt_zh: 一间静室避歊炎，瓶供莲华水贮奁。识得色香本无处，底须几上置楞严。
summary_en: Poem 静莲斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1771, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 静莲斋
locator: v3 p.260, under 含经堂; source ref 11-436
excerpt_zh: 缀景萧斋额静莲，不关玩物不参禅。即如周氏称君子，岂弗宜珍座席边。
summary_en: Poem 静莲斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1773, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

title: 御製蒨園八景詩
excerpt_zh: 乾隆十八年御製蒨園八景詩　一亭一沼爰静神逰之鄉非壑非林自足天成之趣此中大有佳處物外聊爾寄情不為嵩山之比方偶效右丞之格調　機緘合希夷水木呈明翠銀塘横半𤱔萬頃煙波意（右朗潤齋）　樓臨内外湖地髙望斯逺湛然虚且明絜矩出治本（右湛景樓）　風前度彌静雨後香益清倣彿吳興岸菱歌唱晩晴（右菱香沜）　藍瑛碑側石名之青蓮朶介示無去來黙傳忘物我（右青蓮朶）總此一大内謾稱别有天達人誚坐井匪我古已然（右别有天）　石激出淙乳儼中宫商音我不觧攫醳而愛韻天琴（右韻天琴）　笠亭據假山亦足云標勝設擬宣城蹟合得謫仙詠（右標勝亭）　境以曲折幽中宏延外廣尺宅含寸田至人貴知養（右委宛藏）
summary_en: Eight short poems on 蒨園: 朗潤齋, 湛景樓, 菱香沜, 青蓮朶, 别有天, 韻天琴, 標勝亭 and 委宛藏.

title: 御製重摹梅石碑置青蓮朶側而系之詩（有序）
excerpt_zh: 乾隆三十二年御製重摹梅石碑置青蓮朶側而系之詩（有序）　乙酉冬曽摹徳夀宫梅石碑驛致杭州以留舊跡因思梅既乆枯石又北來則新碑與舊碑不過存其名於依稀髣髴間耳既又思梅之槁於南者雖不可復生而石之存於北者固在也因命重摹一通置之石側青蓮朶者盖壬申初到時所命名亦並有詩紀事云　昔年德夀石名曰青蓮朶梅枯石北來惟餘碑尚妥徳夀豈復存乆矣燬兵火不禁興廢感碑亦漫漶頗因之為橅蹟驛致江之左新碑鄰舊碑那見梅石我重摹置石側為結無緣果誰云假氷玉猶是真嶪峩如因憶中郎武賁何不可
summary_en: Poem with preface: the 梅石碑 from the old 德壽宫 in Hangzhou. The stone itself had come north as 青蓮朶; he made a second copy of the stele to set beside it.

title: 蒨园: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 石磴高低接曲廊，因山筑室景弥彰。晴空飒爽天风迥，秋水澄清锦浪长。列嶂枫屏染深绛，临溪柳带弄轻黄。小园寻径多幽蒨，乘兴还过竹外冈。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 蒨园, 1796, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 蒨园: 嘉庆二年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆二年 (1797), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 御园多丽景，水木湛清华。一鉴澄波漾，千章密荫遮。曦光到窗罅，云影绘天涯。切望甘膏布，登楼凝眺賖。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 蒨园, 1797, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 蒨园: 嘉庆三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆三年 (1798), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 小园临绿水，曲径引藤萝。奇石如蹲虎，危峰若旋螺。林深沿涧壑，境僻过坡陀。布景最幽蒨，得来画意多。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 蒨园, 1798, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 蒨园: 嘉庆十三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十三年 (1808), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 黑云冥漠隐亭台，林外横排急雨来。石骨淋漓秀含砌，松梢飞洒翠浮苔。悬河百道倾檐角，涨浦三篙拍岸隈。倏度前溪闻断续，天光澄洁雾徐开。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 蒨园, 1808, on rain and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 蒨园: 嘉庆十五年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十五年 (1810), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 堂临川上接清浔，水面风来暑不侵。柳蘸汀头绿波漾，松翻亭角翠涛深。花光掩映拖轻藓，石韵瑽琤潄暗琴。一碧连霄远尘埃，卷阿静赏契予心。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 蒨园, 1810, on escaping the heat. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 蒨园: 嘉庆十六年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十六年 (1811), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 堂名沿山庄，额同境迥异。彼谓山体言，此喻水之义。静实仁者根，动则用才智。能动静合宜，造极非二事。乾刚运八埏，坤宁镇大地。得一契涵三，妙理蕴精粹。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 蒨园, 1811, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 蒨园: 嘉庆十九年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十九年 (1814), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 山庄在崖端，御园依水置。悦性察鸢鱼，观文见仁智。彼必跋马登，此则乘舟至。劳逸大不同，境岂因心易。晏安警勿耽，懈弛最误事。息民非惰荒，力勤常励志。凉雨生凉秋，雨细润滴绿杨。矶益洽豆花，秀倍添谷穗。肥织波烟羃，葱笼树影依稀。植物荷沾溉，西成溥近畿。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 蒨园, 1814, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 蒨园: 嘉庆二十一年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆二十一年 (1816), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 山庄御苑客相同，即景抒思一贯通。艮止坎流随动静，见仁见智理无穷。临水虗堂碧鉴开，波光印槛净浮埃。静中偶会浚源道，一勺澄泓万派该。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 蒨园, 1816, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 蒨园: 嘉庆二十三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆二十三年 (1818), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 石径玲珑接曲廊，碧溪一带绕书堂。庭多乔木舒清荫，几有芸编挹古香。心望和甘润畎亩，政求平治守纲常。候临永夏盼嘉泽，播种大田祈稔穰。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 蒨园, 1818, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 蒨园: 道光三年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
date: 道光三年 (1823), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 偶移画舫访林泉，林碧泉清雨后天。面水虚堂增爽籁，沿山曲径幻云烟。葱茏众绿深而窈，点染余青静且便。芦荻疎疎连岸角，生机活泼悟鱼鸢。
summary_en: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 蒨园, 1823, on boating and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 日下舊聞考 蒨园
excerpt_zh: 澹懐堂迤西濵河水石之間為蒨園門西嚮内為朗潤齋三楹其東為湛景樓又東為菱香沜朗潤齋西有石立於園門内為青蓮朶齋東南山池間為標勝亭又東南為别有天西北為韻天琴南角門外别院為委宛藏（長春園册）臣等謹案蒨園門左碑亭一刋重摹梅石碑標勝亭西壁勒御製蒨園八景詩
summary_en: West of 澹懐堂: the west-facing gate of 蒨園 with the three-bay 朗潤齋, 湛景樓, 菱香沜, the rock 青蓮朶, 標勝亭, 别有天, 韻天琴 and 委宛藏. A stele pavilion by the gate holds the re-engraved 梅石碑, and 蒨園八景詩 are cut on the west wall of 標勝亭.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 蒨园
summary_en: Qianlong named eight scenes in 1753 (朗润斋, 湛景楼, 菱香沜, 青莲朵, 别有天, 韵天琴, 标胜亭, 委宛藏). Jiaqing named four in 1809 (虚受轩, 委宛藏, 碧静堂, 菱香沜) and returned to 碧静堂 until 1819, so the compound changed. 蒨园: 13 dated items, 1753-1823, of which 11 poems and 2 court records (Qianlong, Jiaqing, Daoguang); recurring themes: the view, rain, escaping the heat. First dated 1753, last dated 1823.

title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 蒨园
summary_en: Begun 1752, its south-east much rebuilt about 1808, when the five-bay 碧静堂 was made. 青莲朵 is the rock from 德寿宫 in Hangzhou. Three gates: a west land gate, a seven-bay north water gate with a landing, and 蒨园门, the only way through to 绮春园.

title: 蒨园总平面图
locator: 国家图书馆善本部 样067-1号
summary_en: Ink base plan of the Qian Yuan garden of 1808. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

title: 朗润斋
excerpt_zh: 机缄合希夷，水木呈明翠。银塘横半亩，万顷烟波意。
summary_en: Poem 朗润斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1753, filed by the editors under 蒨园.

title: 湛景楼
excerpt_zh: 楼临内外湖，地髙望斯远。湛然虚且明，絜矩出治本。
summary_en: Poem 湛景楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1753, filed by the editors under 蒨园.

title: 湛景楼有会
locator: v3 p.331, under 蒨园; source ref 17-45
excerpt_zh: 湖楼称湛景，湛景义湛思。湛者静之谓，静者归无私。万景纷在前，一静受莫遗。设若著一物，其万遗可知。高楼如有谓，谓我涉多辞。
summary_en: Poem 湛景楼有会 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1789, filed by the editors under 蒨园.

title: 题湛景楼
locator: v3 p.332, under 蒨园; source ref 18-712
excerpt_zh: 层楼俯坦池，一晌引清思。试抚湛如此，可知景最宜。
summary_en: Poem 题湛景楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1794, filed by the editors under 蒨园.

title: 菱香沜
excerpt_zh: 风前度弥静，雨后香益清。仿彿吴兴岸，菱歌唱晚晴。
summary_en: Poem 菱香沜 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1753, filed by the editors under 蒨园.

title: 青莲朵
excerpt_zh: 蓝瑛碑侧石，名之青莲朵。介示无去来，默传忘物我。
summary_en: Poem 青莲朵 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1753, filed by the editors under 蒨园.

title: 标胜亭
excerpt_zh: 笠亭据假山，亦足云标胜。设拟宣城迹，合得谪仙咏。
summary_en: Poem 标胜亭 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1753, filed by the editors under 蒨园.

title: 别有天
excerpt_zh: 总此一大内，谩称别有天。达人诮坐井，匪我古已然。
summary_en: Poem 别有天 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1753, filed by the editors under 蒨园.

title: 韵天琴
excerpt_zh: 石激出淙乳，俨中宫商音。我不解攫醳，而爱韵天琴。
summary_en: Poem 韵天琴 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1753, filed by the editors under 蒨园.

title: 委宛藏
excerpt_zh: 境以曲折幽，中宏延外广。尺宅含寸田，至人贵知养。
summary_en: Poem 委宛藏 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1753, filed by the editors under 蒨园.

title: 委宛藏
excerpt_zh: 十笏容膝安，曲廊达疏牖。芸编座右珍，远胜珠玉薮。委宛列琅函，藏修业培厚。御苑富琳琅，奚用访二酉。
summary_en: Poem 委宛藏 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1809, filed by the editors under 蒨园.

title: 御製 思永齋
excerpt_zh:
思永齋
樸斵含經畔（是處在含經堂西）徃來亦憩留澄觀非藻繢託志在清幽上下鳶魚若居稽今古求言經如展讀切已慎身修
summary_en: His note says 思永齋 lies west of 含經堂. A plain study where he stops and reads.

title: 思永斋: 乾隆二十六年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十六年 (1761), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 佳处堪永日，因题思永名。絜矩在虞书，讵惟怡六情。政靡不有初，道益谦亏盈。肯构期于万，亦云观所行。即景识心官，慎修励以诚。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 思永斋, 1761, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 御製 題小有天園
excerpt_zh:
題小有天園
疊石肖慧峯範錫寫壑庵（西湖小有天園舊名壑庵）分眀虛窓北宛似聖湖南縮逺以近取收大於小含既非仙術幻亦豈佛偈拈屧歩丹崖側撫掌琴臺尖逰神無不可騁目還須兼過去成陳迹未来猶豫探奚如現前對前三與後三
summary_en: The side court of 思永齋: rockwork copying 慧日峰 and a tin-roofed room after 壑庵 at Hangzhou, seen through a window to the north.

title: 思永斋
locator: v3 p.307, under 思永斋; source ref 8-788
excerpt_zh: 韶春煦润锦花舒，为抚时和惕有余。卑室更因思禹拜，倚衡拟欲学师书。修身敬奉三无本，叙族宁忘一脉初。绨几蛎窗增愧处，圣人见说贵鹑居。
summary_en: Poem 思永斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 思永斋.

title: 思永斋: 乾隆二十九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十九年 (1764), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 含经思永近比邻，题额称名实欲循。枕葄礼园希复性，沉濳义府愼修身。底须银烛怜过节，耐可华编娱早春。德业进修宁二道，箕畴愿福万方民。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 思永斋, 1764, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 思永斋
locator: v3 p.308, under 思永斋; source ref 9-150
excerpt_zh: 斋堂一溪隔，其实近尺咫。含经既临诸，思永爰憩只。檐檠亦流苏，屏胜亦叠绮。灯宵稔冉过，顿置风景美。循名如责实，忸怩犹惭此。讵惟慎身修，絜矩治平理。
summary_en: Poem 思永斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1766, filed by the editors under 思永斋.

title: 题思永斋
locator: v3 p.310, under 思永斋; source ref 9-276
excerpt_zh: 思永非惟身慎修，心思永处说从头。敬天益励旦明凜，法祖常怀艰大投。勤政宁无间宵旰，亲贤何有尽登收。至于祈岁更殷若，安得屡绥遍九州。
summary_en: Poem 题思永斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1767, filed by the editors under 思永斋.

title: 御製 思永齋有詠
excerpt_zh:
思永齋有詠
壬寅詠思永申言有二義（壬寅思永齋詩云一曰永修身一曰永後世五帝官天下）（修身一已備三王家天下後世應並計）其義已暢眀兹不復辭贅兹之詠思永用為娱老備建立廿餘年兹近十年計（思永齋在長春園内）（建立二十餘年在寧夀宫落成之先均以備歸政後頤養所居兹自乙巳春至乙夘歸政屈指十年惟期仰承）（庶克天貺得如初願協思永之義耳）永者日以近足知老將至設果得如願額手欽天賜
summary_en: His note says 思永齋 had stood over twenty years by 1785, built before 寧夀宫 as a retirement place, with ten years then left to his planned abdication.

title: 思永斋: 乾隆五十年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆五十年 (1785), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 壬寅咏思永，申言有二义（壬寅，思永斋诗云：一曰永修身，一曰永后世。五帝官天下，修身一已备。三王家天下，后世应并计。 ） 。其义已畅明，兹不复辞赘。兹之咏思永，用为娱老备。建立廿余年，兹近十年计（思永斋在长春园内，建立二十余年，在宁寿宫落成之先，均以备归政后颐养所居，兹自乙巳春至乙夘归政屈指十年，惟期仰承天贶，得如初愿，庶克协思永之义耳） 。永者日以近，足知老将至。设果得如愿，额手钦天赐。
summary_en: Qianlong, 1785: his note dates the hall over twenty years back, before 宁寿宫, both prepared for his retirement.

title: 思永斋: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 开奁对澄波，春潭明百顷。悦目净纎尘，碧浸晴云影。宿雾敛平林，晃耀阳乌炳。轩窗延景光，片时欣引领。斋名义深长，修齐务思永。应物虽万殊，返观必三省。克已胜治人，虚怀戒放逞。无我斯明通，外诱尽绝屏。顾名偶拈吟，中心存自警。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 思永斋, 1796, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 思永斋: 嘉庆三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆三年 (1798), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 修身有要惟思永，恒性常存绥厥猷。三字君难勤保泰，四方民隐务推求。治非好异贵平坦，政必守经听论谋。翼翼小心望淳化，漫图后乐凛先忧。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 思永斋, 1798, on state papers. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 思永斋: 嘉庆七年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆七年 (1802), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh:
斋额义诚永，随时慎厥思。
风融春恰仲，日丽晷徐移。残雪还皴岭，宿冰已泮池。韶华渐繁富，庶汇拓根基。西苑寻芳早，东郊举趾宜。虽蒙三白洽，仍冀一犂滋。兆稔抒民愿，除氛溥昊慈。息戈转泰运，露布即飞驰。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 思永斋, 1802, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 思永斋: 嘉庆九年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆九年 (1804), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 始勤终怠世俗常，莅事修身务思永。良法善政总率由，遵守旧章寸田静。敬循成宪恐未能，毋作聪明私意逞。喜新好奇必乖张，尺宅湛然物欲屏。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 思永斋, 1804, on state papers. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 思永斋: 嘉庆九年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆九年 (1804), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 临轩治庶民，勉此寸诚真。正巳风从偃，持躬德日新。保身皆俗吏，无欲始贤臣。思永流方洁，惟恒世渐淳。慰心逢稔岁，惬意息征尘。尤喜燕齐获，西成救馁贫（三辅屡岁告丰，本年亦称大有，而山东省各属所报秋成，竟有至十分以上者，洵为罕觏之上稔，民食充裕，气象安恬，差慰省岁劭农之意）。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 思永斋, 1804, on the harvest. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 思永斋: 道光四年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
date: 道光四年 (1824), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 承先抚寰宇，兢业凛深思。言动参于是，修齐念在兹。临民惕饥溺，虚巳达猷为。永保钦天眷，诚求慎自欺。
summary_en: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 思永斋, 1824. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 思永斋: 道光十一年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
date: 道光十一年 (1831), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 蛎窗迎暖旭，春盎一斋中。拨火茶初熟，看冰棹未通。修身期有永，学古念无穷。卉木含生意，敷荣识化工。
summary_en: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 思永斋, 1831, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 御製小有天園記
excerpt_zh: 御製小有天園記　左净慈面明聖兼挹湖山之秀為南屏最佳處者莫過於汪氏之小有天園盖辛未南廵所命名也去嵗丁丑復至其地為之流連為之倚吟歸而思畫家所為收千里於咫尺者適得思永齋東林屋一區室則十笏窗乃半之窗之外隙地方廣亦十笏命匠氏叠石成峯則居然慧日也範錫為宇又依然壑庵也（汪氏别業舊名）激水作瀑泠泠琤琤不殊幽居洞之所聞而黄山松樹子雖盈尺有凌雲之概夭矯盤拏髙下雜出於石笋峭蒨間復與琴臺之古木蒼巖玲瓏秀削不可言同何况云異吾於是知天地間之景無窮而人之心亦無窮境有異而人之心無有異夫此為軒為亭為磴為池為林泉為崖壑固不可歴歴手攀而足陟之者使目擊道存㑹心不逺則此為軒為亭為磴為池為林泉為崖壑又何不可歴歴手攀而足陟之乎昔新豐雞犬各識其戸固已侈矣李徳裕平泉之像巴峽冩洞庭則又務窮逺盡態極妍而不必師所可師者其意而已然吾之意不在千里外之湖光山色應接目前而在兩浙間之吏治民依來徃胸中矣是為記
summary_en: The courtyard east of 思永齋 copies 小有天園, the 汪 family garden on the 南屏 hill at Hangzhou: rockwork as 慧日峰, a tin-roofed room, a cascade and small Huangshan pines. He says his mind is on the governance of Zhejiang.

title: 日下舊聞考 思永斋
excerpt_zh: 蒨園後河北岸為思永齋七楹齋北樓宇臨池為山色湖光共一樓齋東别院為小有天園（長春園册）臣等謹案思永齋門額曰静便趣齋内額曰萬横香玉
summary_en: North of the stream behind 蒨園: 思永齋, seven bays, with the tower 山色湖光共一樓 and the side court 小有天園.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 思永斋
summary_en: A Qianlong note of 1785 says the hall had stood over twenty years, older than 宁寿宫, and like it was meant for his retirement. 思永斋: 10 dated items, 1761-1831, of which 10 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing, Daoguang); recurring themes: the view, state papers, the harvest. First dated 1761, last dated 1831.

title: 长春园 No.4, 思永斋 Siyong Zhai, copied from a southern garden
excerpt_other: In 1757 when Ch'ien Lung first visited one of these, Number Four, he said it was as though he could see a thousand li, for it seemed as though he were again in the garden of the Wang Family at Nan P'ing, which he had seen in 1751.
summary_en: Modelled on the Wang family garden at Nanping, Hangzhou, seen in 1751 and visited here in 1757. Malone gives no Chinese name; 小有天园 at 思永斋 fits.

title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 思永斋
summary_en: Begun 1747 on a ringed island: a seven-bay hall, gate plaque 静便趣, with copies of the recut 淳化阁帖 and of the 西洋楼 engravings kept inside. 山色湖光共一楼 stands north with an octagonal gallery; 小有天园, after a Hangzhou garden, is the east court.

title: 赋得山色湖光共一楼
locator: v3 p.302, under 思永斋; source ref 6-603
excerpt_zh: 渭竹环临水，岩楼出竹梢。漪澜常映带，罨黛亦兼包。了识智仁乐，宛成仲叔交。契神疑画舫，悦志即书巢。已足供吟眺，奚烦事豁庨。羲经设观象，育德圣功爻。
summary_en: Poem 赋得山色湖光共一楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1758, filed by the editors under 思永斋.

title: 御製 得全閣
date: c. 1758, inferred from the last dated heading (御製詩二集)
excerpt_zh:
得全閣
髙樓碧沼湄萬景攬無遺水面風來際天心月到時文章假大塊圖畫得神姿益賛通為政吾猶戒在兹
summary_en: A tall building on the edge of green water with a full view around. Its words 水面 and 天心 echo the plaque 天心水面 recorded at S05 j83:11a.

title: 得全阁
locator: v3 p.340, under 得全阁; source ref 6-710
excerpt_zh: 髙楼碧沼湄，万景揽无遗。水面风来际，天心月到时。文章假大块，图画得神姿。益赞通为政，吾犹戒在兹。
summary_en: Poem 得全阁 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1759, filed by the editors under 得全阁.

title: 得全阁
locator: v3 p.341, under 得全阁; source ref 8-457
excerpt_zh: 飞阁流丹碧水涯，遥奇近概览无遗。微言偶忆淳于氏，君道何妨絜矩思。
summary_en: Poem 得全阁 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1761, filed by the editors under 得全阁.

title: 得全阁
locator: v3 p.341, under 得全阁; source ref 8-763
excerpt_zh: 榜题逐处选名言，责实循名意每存。不取沈家传八咏，端思枚叟有佳论。
summary_en: Poem 得全阁 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 得全阁.

title: 御製 得全閣
excerpt_zh:
得全閣
牓題逐處選名言責實循名意每存不取沈家傳八詠端思枚叟有佳論
summary_en: Short poem on the plaque's meaning.

title: 日下舊聞考 得全阁、海岳开襟
excerpt_zh: 思永齋西稍南河外為得全閣南為寳雲樓北為逺風樓齋北河池潨滙中有圓式崇基其上樓宇三層為海嶽開襟四旁枋楔各一（長春園册）臣等謹案得全閣額曰天心水面海嶽開襟為下層樓内額其南簷額曰青瑶嶼最上層額曰乗六龍
summary_en: South-west of 思永齋: 得全閣 with 寳雲樓 and 逺風樓. North of 思永齋 in the pool: 海嶽開襟, a three-storey building on a round platform, with an arch on each side. The note gives the plaque for each storey.

title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 得全阁
summary_en: Finished 1747 in the south-west: three waterside towers facing east, the main one double-eaved of three bays, plaque 天心水面, with two nine-arch bent wooden bridges; 宝云楼 south and 远风楼 north. Note the same plaque name as the 绮春园 hall QC26.

title: 御製海嶽開襟歌（樓名上有扁曰乗六龍）
excerpt_zh: 乾隆二十四年御製海嶽開襟歌（樓名上有扁曰乗六龍）　滄池漾瀁蛟龍窟中聳玉臺規寳月祖州之草琪樹枝襲芳籠影水精闕周禆瀛海誠曠哉崑嶠方壺縮地來八琅雲璈底湏奏松風朅聽塵襟開芥舟祇需抝堂水溟渤何勞千萬里得其環中游物外棗葉須彌皆一理我之所戒在求仙海嶽寄興屬偶然保合太和勵體乾時乗六龍以御天
summary_en: Song on 海嶽開襟, the three-storey building in the pool, which names the top plaque 乗六龍 and says he has no wish for immortality.

title: 海岳开襟: 乾隆二十四年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十四年 (1759), date from the compilation
locator: p.286 item (1), under 海岳开襟
excerpt_zh: 池瀁瀁蛟龙窟中，耸玉台规宝月祖。洲之草琪树枝袭，芳笼影水精阙周，禆瀛海诚旷哉昆，峤方壶缩地来八。琅云璈底须奏松，风朅听尘襟开芥。舟祗需坳堂水溟，渤何劳千万里得。其环中游物外，枣叶须弥皆一理。我之所戒在求仙，海岳寄兴属偶然。保合太和励体乾，时乘六龙以御天。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 海岳开襟, 1759, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 海岳开襟: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation
locator: p.286 item (2), under 海岳开襟
excerpt_zh: 层阁凌波出，周回百顷涛。珠宫拔地迥，贝阙接云高。春陌目千里，神山驾六鳌。开襟一延眺，揽胜纪宣毫。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 海岳开襟, 1796, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 海岳开襟: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation
locator: p.286 item (3), under 海岳开襟
excerpt_zh: 登高畅好开襟抱，千顷晴波漾锦澜。远岭几重林外列，长天一色镜中看。最宜令节临仙境，直上高楼作大观。海岳晏安诚不易，顾名知儆凛君难。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 海岳开襟, 1796, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 海岳开襟: 嘉庆二年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆二年 (1797), date from the compilation
locator: p.286 item (4), under 海岳开襟
excerpt_zh:
重阳令节合登高，漫拟叅
军落帽豪。皎日澄辉鸟驻景，明霞衬字雁长翱。心期海岳全清晏，目极田畴被泽膏。黔宼虽平余楚贼，告功早慰圣衷劳。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 海岳开襟, 1797. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 重阳日登海岳开襟楼即景成什
locator: v3 p.345, under 海岳开襟; source ref 1-277
excerpt_zh: 重阳令节合登高，漫拟参军落帽豪。皎日澄辉乌驻景，明霞衬字雁长翶。心期海岳全清晏，目极田畴被泽膏。黔寇虽平余楚贼，告功早慰圣衷劳。狆苗滋事，经勒保等焚剿擒渠，业已蕆绩。惟教匪分股披猖，东西窜逸。虽屡经官兵歼戮，而路径丛杂，出没靡常，辄以牵制官兵，行其诡窜。皇父特发东省劲旅，并调各省兵前往协剿，此时计可陆续抵营。所冀领兵诸臣，各励公忠，同心协力，速剪幺麽，以安靖吾民。纾我皇父宵旰筹几之勚。登高望远，倍缱殷怀。
summary_en: Poem 重阳日登海岳开襟楼即景成什 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1797, filed by the editors under 海岳开襟.

title: 海岳开襟: 嘉庆十一年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十一年 (1806), date from the compilation
locator: p.287 item (5), under 海岳开襟
excerpt_zh: 流香渚畔泛轻航，弭棹石栏俯锦塘。佳荫遍含松百尺，奥区宛在水中央。惟期海岳敷文命，不羡蓬莱鄙武皇。食德饮和难普被，开襟茂对幸年康。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 海岳开襟, 1806, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 海岳开襟: 嘉庆十一年 poem, naming 流香渚
date: 嘉庆十一年 (1806), date from the compilation
locator: p.287 item (5), under 海岳开襟
excerpt_zh: 流香渚畔泛轻航，弭棹石栏俯锦塘。佳荫遍含松百尺，奥区宛在水中央。惟期海岳敷文命，不羡蓬莱鄙武皇。食德饮和难普被，开襟茂对幸年康。
summary_en: Jiaqing, 1806: rowing along 流香渚 to the stone railing of 海岳开襟, set in the middle of the water, with tall pines.

title: 海岳开襟
locator: v3 p.346, under 海岳开襟; source ref 3-356
excerpt_zh: 御园万景备，到此益开襟。蓊郁围乔木，连延列远岑。霞明青嶂外，云起碧溪浔。超出川岩秀，绝无尘暑侵。临窗波静挹，凭槛句重寻。遣兴偶探奥，境烟不系心。
summary_en: Poem 海岳开襟 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1807, filed by the editors under 海岳开襟.

title: 海岳开襟: 嘉庆十二年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十二年 (1807), date from the compilation
locator: p.287 item (6), under 海岳开襟
excerpt_zh: 岛环溶漾绕清浔，一抹岚光四面林。栏静风微入帘细，松高日煦印窗深。如观雅绘欣宜目，时读古编偶会心。海宇安恬民饱暖，几余游览始开襟。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 海岳开襟, 1807, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 海岳开襟: 嘉庆十二年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十二年 (1807), date from the compilation
locator: p.287 item (7), under 海岳开襟
excerpt_zh: 御园万景偹，到此益开襟。蓊郁围乔木，连延列远岑。霞明青嶂外，云起碧溪浔。超出川岩秀，绝无尘暑侵。临窗波静挹，凭槛句重寻。遣兴偶探奥，镜烟不系心。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 海岳开襟, 1807, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 海岳开襟放歌
locator: v3 p.347, under 海岳开襟; source ref 3-376
excerpt_zh: 洪荒开辟乾坤凿，日昼月夜明两作。乔岳基于土一抔，沧海始于水一勺。人为物灵合三才，圣王治理调六幕。中和位育赞枢机，九有群生大君讬。年康物阜襟抱开，忧其忧而乐其乐。殿额标题意在兹，岂耽豫游爱溪壑。
summary_en: Poem 海岳开襟放歌 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1807, filed by the editors under 海岳开襟.

title: 海岳开襟: 嘉庆十四年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十四年 (1809), date from the compilation
locator: p.287 item (8), under 海岳开襟
excerpt_zh: 假山数仞出林表，清波百顷回栏绕。眼界因心八极周，须弥非大芥非小。君临端拱居丹宸，山陬海澨皆吾民。一人知力及兆庶，俗浇吏懈难化淳。世态纷纭万千状，正已御下慎趋向。治理何时臻大同，几闲游览襟始畅。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 海岳开襟, 1809, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 海岳开襟: 嘉庆十四年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十四年 (1809), date from the compilation
locator: p.287 item (8), under 海岳开襟
excerpt_zh: 芳溆拏舟泛，碧塘亭台在。水中央栏环，白石浮尘凈，砌倚苍松密。荫长五教未，能敷海岳寸。心乘暇味缣，缃开函探讨。襟怀畅化泽，均覃愿少偿。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 海岳开襟, 1809, on boating. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 海岳开襟: 嘉庆二十四年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆二十四年 (1819), date from the compilation
locator: p.287 item (12), under 海岳开襟
excerpt_zh: 圆岛水中央，问景扁舟渡。四围白石栏，八面苍松树。宛如阆风台，游仙心岂慕。即境足开襟，怡情随所遇。岱岳曾雨登，沧溟阅三度。巡典有重轻，恩膏及时布。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 海岳开襟, 1819, on boating and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 海岳开襟
locator: from p.286, under 海岳开襟
summary_en: Poems of 1759-1819: a tower climbed for the view (1796, the Double Ninth of 1797, 1816) and an island approached by boat (1809, 1819). 海岳开襟: 13 dated items, 1759-1819, of which 13 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: the view, boating. First dated 1759, last dated 1819.

title: 长春园 No.5, 海岳开襟 Haiyue Kaijin: the round island
excerpt_other: one of which was on a round terraced island ascended by four flights of steps, surrounded by a white marble balustrade and approached only by boat.
summary_en: Round terraced island, four flights of steps, white marble balustrade, reached only by boat. Number follows p.101, which places the pagoda on the shore north of "the round island, Number Five".

title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 海岳开襟
summary_en: Finished 1747 on an island about 90 m across: a three-storey tower on a round terrace with an archway on each side, each storey with its own plaque. 流香渚 and 罨画溪 lie west, the moon terrace 半月 east. It survived 1860, Cixi visited under Guangxu, and it was lost around 1900, say the editors.

title: 海岳开襟; 映清斋; 蒨园; 鉴园; 狮子林 (search-index text)
summary_en: 海岳开襟: lake islet about 90 m across, about 1,000 m2 of buildings, by 1747, repaired 1778 and 1791; a totem park stood here 1995-2007. 映清斋: added 1766 as a new palace of 玉玲珑馆. 蒨园: 6,600 m2, 2,300 m2 of buildings, 1752. 鉴园: repaired 1810. 狮子林: west part with 丛芳榭 by 1747, the east in imitation of Suzhou finished 1772.

title: 日下舊聞考 流香渚
excerpt_zh: 海嶽開襟之西河池外有亭為流香渚亭北為罨畫溪（長春園册）臣等謹案流香渚之西循山逕行即逹圓明園之明春門
summary_en: West of 海嶽開襟: the pavilion 流香渚, with 罨畫溪 to the north; from here a path west reaches 明春門 of 圓明園.

title: 御製 上天竺法喜寺
excerpt_zh:
上天竺法喜寺
…工肖斯像二而供奉之于御園之法慧寺及玉泉山　之清涼禪窟…
summary_en: Poem on a Hangzhou temple, with a long note on its Guanyin. It says he had two copies of the image made, one for 法慧寺 in the imperial garden and one for 清涼禪窟 at Jade Spring Hill.

title: 法慧寺
locator: v3 p.351, under 法慧寺; source ref 1-175
excerpt_zh: 能仁度众生，演妙观察智。尽登宝莲航，斯愿诚不易。天竺瞻礼曾，慈云临福地。恩波荫大千，六种同蒙赐。杨枝早息氛，神勇消邪魅。民沐佛威光，宗门法不二。
summary_en: Poem 法慧寺 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1796, filed by the editors under 法慧寺.

title: 法慧寺
locator: v3 p.352, under 法慧寺; source ref 1-388
excerpt_zh: 寺仿天竺式，普门济众生。超脱诸苦趣，境遇应感更。杨枝洒震旦，法雨苏勾萌。慈悲随汝愿，接引知群情。善慧有宿果，平等无所争。
summary_en: Poem 法慧寺 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1798, filed by the editors under 法慧寺.

title: 法慧寺
locator: v3 p.352, under 法慧寺; source ref 2-248
excerpt_zh: 境仿上天竺，恩波震旦敷。杨柳试挥洒，甘露遍霑濡。法本有真谛，禅原辟野狐。慧光破愚暗，遵路弃迷途。
summary_en: Poem 法慧寺 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1803, filed by the editors under 法慧寺.

title: 日下舊聞考 法慧寺、宝相寺、谐奇趣
excerpt_zh: 海嶽開襟東北為諧竒趣東為法慧寺山門西嚮内為四面延樓後殿為光明性海其西别院有琉璃方塔法慧寺東為寳相寺山門南嚮内為澄光閣後為曇霏閣又後崇基上有殿為現大圓鏡（長春園册）臣等謹案法慧寺山門額曰普香界現大圓鏡殿内額曰香臺華鬘
summary_en: The only line in 日下舊聞考 on the European palaces: 諧竒趣 north-east of 海嶽開襟. Then 法慧寺 with a west-facing gate, 四面延樓, 光明性海 and a glazed square pagoda; 寳相寺 with a south-facing gate, 澄光閣, 曇霏閣 and 現大圓鏡 on a raised base.

title: 长春园: glazed pagoda of 法慧寺 Fahui Si
excerpt_other: Another was a glazed tile pagoda, square below, octagonal in the middle, and round at the top.
summary_en: A glazed pagoda in a temple on the shore north of the round island; stood until 1900 according to the old man Lu (n.55).

title: 圆明园的法慧寺
summary_en: 法慧寺 Fahui Si, in 长春园, on the south slope of the ridge north of 海岳开襟, gate facing west. Reads its name and halls through Buddhist texts on 五台山, and notes temple rites run by eunuchs were stopped in 1839.

title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 法慧寺
summary_en: Finished 1747 on the slope north of 海岳开襟. Gate 普香界 faces west; a five-bay main hall, a five-bay rear-facing tower with eleven-bay wings (the 四面延楼), a rear hall 光明性海, and in a west court the seven-tiered glazed pagoda, square below and round above, 23.55 m.

title: 法慧寺、宝相寺平面图 (图名: 宝相法慧寺)
locator: 国家图书馆善本部 样069-1号
summary_en: Qianlong-period presentation plan of the two temples, 859x518 mm, colour and ink; Fahui Si has three five-bay halls on its central line. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

title: 宝相寺(-175)
excerpt_zh: 祇园布金沙，捷径看直上。七宝绕莲池，虔瞻满月相。水环功德波，山现须弥嶂。迦陵鸟韵幽，薝卜花光漾。震旦演三车，人我皆叨贶。常转大法轮，仁寿乐咸畅。
summary_en: Poem 宝相寺(-175) by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1796, filed by the editors under 宝相寺.

title: 宝相寺(1-388)
excerpt_zh: 初地祇园信步登，入门直上即三乘。真源须识冰成水，幻相应知火是灯。问疾漫寻居士室，吃茶未遇赵州僧。如来像设殊多事，土木形骸何所凭。
summary_en: Poem 宝相寺(1-388) by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1798, filed by the editors under 宝相寺.

title: 宝相寺瞻礼(2-88)
excerpt_zh: 莲台高建礼曼殊，示相东方有若无。定力能推魔摄伏，慈云垂荫豁迷途。
summary_en: Poem 宝相寺瞻礼(2-88) by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1801, filed by the editors under 宝相寺.

title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 宝相寺
summary_en: Finished 1747 east of 法慧寺. South gate, the five-bay tower 澄光阁 with side halls 云窦 and 松关, 昙霏阁, and behind them the five-bay 现大圆镜 on a high terrace with a three-bay annex.

title: 澄光阁
locator: v3 p.353, under 宝相寺; source ref 6-639
excerpt_zh: 层甍出树大溪横，座俯沧浪可濯缨。近远波澜呈震泽，髙低楼阁学天平
summary_en: Poem 澄光阁 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1758, filed by the editors under 宝相寺.

title: 御製 澤蘭堂
date: c. 1758, inferred from the last dated heading (御製詩二集)
excerpt_zh:
澤蘭堂
翡翠蘭苕琳渚旁斯干擇向搆書堂依然濠濮㑹心處邈爾澧沅稱物芳侈蹟非闗學漢苑别名祗合號都梁摛毫擬欲因成賦却愧文通五色章
summary_en: Early poem on 澤蘭堂: a study set on a bank among orchids, likened to the view at 濠濮.

title: 泽兰堂
locator: v3 p.356, under 泽兰堂; source ref 6-685
excerpt_zh: 翡翠兰苕琳渚旁，斯干择向构书堂。依然濠濮会心处。邈尔澧沅称物芳。侈迹非关学汉苑。别名只合号都梁。摛毫拟欲因成赋，却愧文通五色章。
summary_en: Poem 泽兰堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1759, filed by the editors under 泽兰堂.

title: 泽兰堂
locator: v3 p.357, under 泽兰堂; source ref 7-337
excerpt_zh: 书堂何有有藏书，取便披观总起予。题额宁同国风咏，会心如与善人居。水流山峙常无尽，秋夕春朝毎相于。最爱北山横一帧，云烟变幻罨冰疏。
summary_en: Poem 泽兰堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1760, filed by the editors under 泽兰堂.

title: 泽兰堂六韵
locator: v3 p.357, under 泽兰堂; source ref 8-379
excerpt_zh: 泽畔有幽居，兰芳袭素裾。滋宁须九畹，趣合在三余。楚客佩怀彼，风人觽警予。闻香还耐久，竟体且纡徐。味道迟朱鸟，含经避白鱼。摛毫常得句，惟是惭虚车。
summary_en: Poem 泽兰堂六韵 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1761, filed by the editors under 泽兰堂.

title: 御製 題澤蘭堂
excerpt_zh:
題澤蘭堂
書堂號澤蘭樸斵謝青丹芸帙堪永日藤窻避薄寒蕪情報韶意水法列竒觀（堂北為西洋水法處盖縁乾隆十八年西洋博爾都噶里雅國）（來京朝貢聞彼處以水法為竒觀因念中國地大物博水法不過工巧之一端遂命住京之西洋人郎世寧造）（為此法俾來使至此瞻仰前嵗□咭唎國使臣等至京朝貢亦令閲看深為歎服昨冬廣東督臣長麟撫臣朱）（珪奏荷蘭國使臣嘚□等以今嵗為朕御極六十年大慶懇請来京朝賀鑒其數萬里外慕化悃誠因允其請）（已即於臈月到京新正並與朝賀宴賞節間令於是處觀看水法使知朕所嘉者逺人嚮化之誠若其任土作）（貢則中國之大何竒不有初不以為貴也）洋使賀正至逺瀛合俾看
summary_en: The one imperial statement found on the European water works. Qianlong's note says the 西洋水法 stands north of 澤蘭堂; after a Portuguese embassy of 乾隆十八年 (1753) he had 郎世寧 Castiglione build it to show envoys; British envoys saw it in the 1790s, and the Dutch envoys at New Year 1795 were to see it. He adds that what he values is their coming, not their marvels.

title: 日下舊聞考 泽兰堂
excerpt_zh: 由寳相寺度城關而東迤南為翠交軒軒下石室為熙春洞北為愛山樓又北為澤蘭堂（長春園册）臣等謹案愛山樓上額曰天風海濤樓下額曰山静雲閒澤蘭堂額曰神觀蕭爽
summary_en: East of 寳相寺 through a walled gate: 翠交軒 with the stone room 熙春洞 under it, 愛山樓 and 澤蘭堂. The note gives plaques.

title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 泽兰堂
summary_en: On the south slope of the northern hill, south of 大水法; begun 1746 and known for rockwork. 萃交轩 with the grotto 熙春洞 below, 爱山楼, pavilion 环碧; 泽兰堂, a five-bay high-terrace hall, and 理性居 were added in 1759. Used as a study, and the best view over the fountains.

title: 泽兰堂平面图 (图名: 道光十五年七月十五日奏准拆去理性居并游廊改安巡杖栏杆)
locator: 国家图书馆善本部 样076-3号
summary_en: Presentation plan of July 1835 recording approval to remove Lixing Ju and its corridors at Zelan Tang and fit railings instead, 332x286 mm, colour and ink. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

title: 翠交轩八韵
locator: v3 p.358, under 泽兰堂; source ref 8-425
excerpt_zh: 假山植真树，岁久翠阴交。甘露常承叶，祥云每压梢。瑞图休鼓舞，理趣喜含包。不有四时运，谁明六位爻。隙中无碍远，密处自相捎。未许蛛悬网，惟应鹊缮巢。张如碧油伞，伴合绿琼勹。最爱微风拂，琳枝飒沓敲。
summary_en: Poem 翠交轩八韵 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1761, filed by the editors under 泽兰堂.

title: 翠交轩石生柏子叠辛巳旧作韵
locator: v3 p.360, under 泽兰堂; source ref 14-636
excerpt_zh: 寒燠四时运，阴阳二气交。窍心育根柢，块面长枝梢。茂已柏花吐，粗将石孔包。蕃鲜震标象，磊珂艮陈爻。霭霭祥云护，瀼瀼瑞露捎。玉蟾应驻窟，凡鸟敢移巢。茵俯青苔纽，竿依绿笋勹。载观求应处，堪以畅吟敲。
summary_en: Poem 翠交轩石生柏子叠辛巳旧作韵 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1782, filed by the editors under 泽兰堂.

title: 爱山楼
locator: v3 p.356, under 泽兰堂; source ref 6-706
excerpt_zh: 因迥为髙易，依山得阁清。所欣此朴斫，奚事彼雕甍。泐嵃窗中纳，崥崹砌下平。毎怀仁者乐，益切体元情。
summary_en: Poem 爱山楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1759, filed by the editors under 泽兰堂.

title: 爱山楼
locator: v3 p.357, under 泽兰堂; source ref 7-276
excerpt_zh: 问谁无所爱，仁者乃爱山。斯楼得斯名，顾宁不腆颜。能仁渠足当，为仁愿勉旃。鸟语花香地，春风秋月天。皆可谓之仁，凭窗揽结间。
summary_en: Poem 爱山楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1760, filed by the editors under 泽兰堂.

title: 爱山楼
locator: v3 p.359, under 泽兰堂; source ref 9-423
excerpt_zh: 书楼称爱山，山色罨窗间。堪味仁者寿，端欣静以闲。云常封石迳，叶未锁林关。适可纵遥目，丹梯漫重攀。
summary_en: Poem 爱山楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1768, filed by the editors under 泽兰堂.

title: 日下舊聞考 平畴交远风
excerpt_zh: 愛山樓東北為平疇交逺風南為轉湘帆（長春園册）臣等謹案平疇交逺風宇後額曰平皋綠浄聯曰畏民碞其難其慎敕天命惟㡬惟康
summary_en: North-east of 愛山樓: 平疇交逺風, with 轉湘帆 to the south and a rear plaque 平皋綠浄.

title: 丛芳榭得句
locator: v3 p.372, under 狮子林; source ref 6-692
excerpt_zh: 曲廊回抱疏轩敞，阶俯琳池波泱漭。缭以纱疏碧且虚，延爽障寒幽复朗。宴息四序无不宜，恒春花镇含芳蕤。风栏雨埭氤氲际，月宇雪窗澹荡时。摛藻发思真契妙，一岁之中曾几到。今来憩即今年初，却笑何须亟营造。
summary_en: Poem 丛芳榭得句 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1759, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 御製叢芳榭得句
excerpt_zh: 乾隆二十四年御製叢芳榭得句　曲廊廻抱疎軒敞階俯臨池波泱漭繚以紗疎碧且虚延爽障寒幽復朗宴息四序無不宜恒春花鎮含芳㽔風欄雨埭氤氲際月宇雪牕澹蕩時摛藻發思真契妙一嵗之中曽㡬到今來憇即今年初却笑何須亟營造
summary_en: Poem on 叢芳榭: curved gallery, open hall and steps down to the pool, with a note on how rarely he comes.

title: 丛芳榭
locator: v3 p.412, under 狮子林; source ref 1-171
excerpt_zh: 百卉盛韶春，稍觉太艳丽。我来过重阳，寻芳趁秋霁。傍榭一丛金，掩映东篱际。清标接渚荷，仙品匹月桂。黄蕤日色含，叶傲朝霜厉。彭泽有素心，空谷同辟世。
summary_en: Poem 丛芳榭 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1796, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 丛芳榭
locator: v3 p.414, under 狮子林; source ref 1-327
excerpt_zh: 廿四番过花信风，群芳绕榭绮罗丛。莺梭巧织栁丝绿，燕翦匀裁桃瓣红。叠叠波光摇潋滟，迟迟旭影乐冲融。袷衣初试昼方永，人坐熙春和气中。
summary_en: Poem 丛芳榭 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1798, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 日下舊聞考 丛芳榭
excerpt_zh: 平疇交逺風之東為叢芳榭後為琴清齋（長春園册）臣等謹案琴清齋内額曰霞蹤天想
summary_en: East of 平疇交逺風: 叢芳榭 and 琴清齋 behind it.

title: 琴清斋
locator: v3 p.373, under 狮子林; source ref 6-695
excerpt_zh: 髙斋枕碧川，琴清名有年。徒观澄止水，未听鸣响泉。却讶渊明室，别体蓄无弦。
summary_en: Poem 琴清斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1759, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 琴清斋
locator: v3 p.373, under 狮子林; source ref 8-763
excerpt_zh: 书斋临水号琴清，正是春温和且平。何必七弦虞拨剌，由来太古自然声。
summary_en: Poem 琴清斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 琴清斋口号
locator: v3 p.407, under 狮子林; source ref 18-619
excerpt_zh: 远瀑漫寻七弦比，近湖恒对五音清。那更陶壁相唐突，个里无声却有声。
summary_en: Poem 琴清斋口号 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1793, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 御製獅子林八景詩
excerpt_zh: 乾隆三十七年御製獅子林八景詩　獅子林之名頼倪迂圖卷以傳此間竹石邱壑皆肖其景為之冠以舊名志數典也最憶倪家獅子林渉園黄氏幻為今（吳中獅子林故址雖存已屢易為黄氏渉園丁丑南巡曽訪其勝因郵倪卷證之壬午乙酉復再至前後並有詩題卷中）因教規冩閶城趣為（去聲）便尋常御苑臨不可移來惟古樹遄由飛去是遐心峯之池影都無二呼出艱逄懶瓚吟（右獅子林）　跨水為小橋垂虹宛在片雲帆影何必更羡呉江　駕溪宛若虹其下可舟通設使幔亭張（去聲）吾當問順風（右虹橋）獅林以石勝相傳為瓚自位置者兹令吳下髙手堆塑小景曲折盡肖驛此展拓成林奚啻武賁之於中郎妙手吳中堆塑能絶勝道子冩嘉陵一邱一壑都神肖憶我春廵展歩曾（右假山）　鏡水冩形遇以無心而景自為納斯堂所得迨乎近之　花木四時趣風雲朝暮情一堂無意納萬景自為呈色是空中色聲皆静裏聲摐然聲色表五字亦因成（右納景堂）　臨曲池面假山景清境閟雲林小閣何不可作如是觀　武夷一曲中清閟小閣置近臨活水澄平挹假山翠遐想創作圖自詡荆關意王䝉那夢見因公宜寳弆（叶倪以上三句櫽括瓚自識語）豈期屬黄氏又復御園至今古實一瞬蘇燕非二地當年閣中人未必首肯遂（右清閟閣）　紫藤引架垂隂縵縈可十數武於石橋宛轉尤宜　石橋既曲折藤架復邐迤春時都作花步障垂茸紫瑣月多風流蘸波鮮塵滓施松援覺艱附木平可喜載咏頍弁章庶幾見君子（右藤架）　循巖陟磴詩人比之丹梯此雖叠石而成亦自覺風雲可生足底　房山石似洞庭刻削一例岭嵤拾級試登磴道丹臺咫尺通靈（右磴道）　峯頂一笠清曠絶塵元鎮畫徃徃如是印證故在不即離間　雖是假山亦有峯㠎嶫吸哦轉饒趣歴艱涉頂得稍平四柱小亭翼然據一步一竒極變幻眼底神情乃畢露俗手石工那得窺粉本倪迂精絶處（右占峯亭）
summary_en: Eight poems on the 獅子林 copied from 倪瓚's scroll and the Suzhou garden then owned by the 黄 family, with prefaces on the rockwork by Suzhou craftsmen and on each place: 虹橋, 假山, 納景堂, 清閟閣, 藤架, 磴道, 占峯亭.

title: 狮子林
excerpt_zh: 狮子林之名，赖倪迂图卷以传。此间竹石邱壑，皆肖其景为之，冠以旧名，志数典也。最忆倪家狮子林，涉园黄氏幻为今
summary_en: Poem 狮子林 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1772, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 御製 再題獅子林十六景曡舊韻
excerpt_zh:
再題獅子林十六景曡舊韻
獅子林　獅林圖蹪剏雲林一巻精神直注今却以墨繩為肖築宛如粉本此重（平聲）臨烟容水態萬古調楚尾呉頭千里心瞻就爾時民意切不忘方寸託清吟
虹橋　跨水飲垂虹浮空路可通祗疑縹渺處吹斷慮罡風
假山　白業當年㕘所能至今樹若語迦陵興來欲問倪髙士吐出幾多邱壑曽
納景堂　靜具動之理動形靜者情即如春孟際已藴物華呈盆裏梅英馥庭前松籟聲問他涉園客（呉中獅子林今屬黄氏為涉園）可識本天成
清閟閣　呉工肖堆塑燕匠營位置難移古樹古頗似翠峰翠發帑非累民愛林因寫意髙閣實已搆真圖斯未弆（叶圖真）（已入石渠寶笈不可移置前南巡過涉國自為臨本留貯其中今此間所弆則再臨本也）新正值幾暇延攬偶一至春氷待融池春氣早酥地怡此清閟心觀厥發生遂
藤架　卧波置平橋折旋循□迆綴架藤尚枯那擬步障紫漫訾鮮麗色却免惹纎滓然看寂寞中已覺懐春喜乍欲傲黄筌而弗嫌倪子
磴道　突起那論逕庭羊腸盤上峰嵤豈惜略勞步履端知大愜性靈
占峰亭　平則為嶺側則峰峰亭實勝嶺亭趣於平易工側艱工例論詩文頗有據偶攀絶頂得笠覆便憶巡方斯冕露欲言欲罷而不能是我結習未忘處
清淑齋　前砌帶溪水後簷屏石林却華意猶愜既靜望偏深春稚蕪茵淺風過竹籟沈平心迎淑氣觸目適清襟
小香幢　石磴玲瓏倚翠幢上為佛室朗蓮釭偶然别學倪家調（去聲）若論塵心實未降
探真書屋　試問獅林境孰為幻孰真涉園猶假借（此間結搆是藍本呉中涉園質）（之原圖反有不能盡合者矣）寶笈實源津（原本以藏石渠寶笈已成書不可移弆此）志澹因怡性景清足謐神睪然詩畫表仿彿見其人
延景樓　當石危梯訝不通攀過奇境得壺中似兹結搆安措想宛彼樓軒若倚空俯暢物華皆入望春和吾意與俱融稿摹倪也還黄也莫漫區區辨異同
畫舫　岸傍常待那須呼歐米髙情總不殊何必風帆誇直㨗烟溪幾曲耐縈迂
雲林石室　石作夏雲石作林其中有室費幽尋三間十笏惟容膝却稱（去聲）開忩望逺岑
横碧軒　有橋如弓彎有溪若鏡横過橋坐敞軒不期意與清古帙亦陳几春鐙亦綴楹但識氷即水奚殊碧波呈
水門　跨水為牆下置門此由溯委此探源藝林夫豈外道義我亦因之成性存
summary_en: The sixteen scenes of 獅子林 named together, one short poem each. Its notes say the Suzhou garden is now the 涉園 of the 黄 family, and that the 倪瓚 scroll stays in the imperial collection: he left a copy he painted at the 涉園, and the 清閟閣 here holds a second copy.

title: 狮子林: 乾隆四十年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆四十年 (1775), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 上元前颇有余闲，况后园中咫尺间。未可泛舟沿冻浦，已欣入画对春山。盆梅几朵吐芳意，檐雀一声叩静闗。雅是云林习禅处，却予缱念在民艰。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 狮子林, 1775. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 狮子林: 乾隆四十四年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆四十四年 (1779), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 狮林数典自倪迂，一再肖之景不殊。明岁金阊问真者，是同是异荅能乎。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 狮子林, 1779. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 狮子林
excerpt_zh: 一之为甚岂容三，得莫其风渐自南。欲问狮林结趺者，是龛异也抑同龛。
summary_en: Poem 狮子林 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1783, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 题狮子林十六景
locator: v3 p.397, under 狮子林; source ref 16-547
excerpt_zh: 初谓狮林始自倪，谁知维则早拈题。怜他不忘本师处，者个犹存方寸兮。吴中狮子林，世俱传为倪瓒别业。甲辰南巡，得徐贲画狮林景十二帧。姚广孝跋云：
summary_en: Poem 题狮子林十六景 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1786, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 狮子林: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 名园建置寓茅茨，境异三吴偶仿为。诡石奇松皆入画，假山曲水总宜诗。静聆竹韵穿篱角，欲探泉源过涧湄。我亦无心来问景，早祈甘泽徧繁滋。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 狮子林, 1796, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 狮子林: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 姑苏旧游地，境界易倪黄（吴中狮子林为元维则僧庵，后倪瓒常道咏其地，并曾为维别第三辈弟子如海尽狮子林图，后人遂传为云林别业，今归黄氏） 。漫说尘踪远，真如粉本张。假山环杰阁，曲沼遶书堂。怪石蟠龙虎，高梧引凤凰。洞幽纡达户，径窄巧通廊。清閟思佳士，香幢礼梵王。临窗霏素菊，周砌遍修篁。天上异人世，云林烟水茫。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 狮子林, 1796, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 狮子林: 嘉庆二年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆二年 (1797), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 狮林名胜仿姑苏，御苑山庄境不殊。澄洁曲池波荡漾，玲珑文石径萦纡。傍阶籊籊碧筠袅，绕砌离离黄菊敷。抚序又过授衣候，速祈孚愿靖萑苻。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 狮子林, 1797, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 狮子林: 嘉庆八年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆八年 (1803), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 甲辰随驾莅苏城，狮林遗迹同游行。弹指星霜二十载，尘埃野马嗟纷更。御园仿建远胜彼，山明树茂溪水清。御笔摹图屡题咏，辉腾奎壁常晶莹。赏心悦目适可止，帝京吴郡孰实名。南巡事大曷敢举，敬守记语安民生。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 狮子林, 1803, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 狮子林: 嘉庆十年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十年 (1805), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 云林留胜境，甲岁莅姑苏。乌兔环何速，溪山致不殊。天章瞻十叠，尘迹在三吴。肯构怀前训，永言念典谟。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 狮子林, 1805, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 狮子林: 嘉庆十二年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十二年 (1807), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 茂苑名园入品题，披图印证境欣稽。方池溶漾平临槛，仄磴嵚崎转曲蹊。几折竹桥相映带，三间石洞互高低。天成佳胜远尘俗，粉本云林妙取携。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 狮子林, 1807, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 狮子林: 嘉庆十九年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十九年 (1814), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 结构仿姑苏，额同境迥异。粉本始倪迂，摹写御园置。文石堆玲珑，奇峭径幽邃。曲池环水厅，古松拂檐翠。吴郡昔曾游，三十年前事。勤政几务繁，何暇重临莅。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 狮子林, 1814, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 狮子林: 咸丰八年 poem of the Xianfeng Emperor
date: 咸丰八年 (1858), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 名园风景四时饶，湛渌溪光映小桥。试陟占峯亭子望，层层烟树豁清寥。每因几暇来游豫，争奈年华烂漫何。池馆憩留慰岑寂，祇余勤政志无磨。
summary_en: Poem of the Xianfeng Emperor at 狮子林, 1858, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 御製續題獅子林八景詩
excerpt_zh: 御製續題獅子林八景詩　倪瓚原卷中自識與趙善長商㩁作獅子林圖且屬如海因公宜寳弆云云是則為圖本自倪而叠石築室已在疑似何况歴嵗四百餘年室主不知凡幾更而今又屬黄氏矣則今之亭臺峯沼但能同吳中之獅子林而不能盡同迂翁之獅子林圖固其宜也雖然予之詠髙山而企慕藺寔在倪而不在黄言之不足長言之因復取其可詠者凡八景為續題云　就樹得佳隂境原獅子林假山亦嵒齬曲逕致幽深花色淑非艷溪聲清以沉如云晤倪老恐未契髙襟（右清淑齋）　一間樓湧小香幢調御琉璃朗慧釭珍重迂翁囑如海（倪瓉獅子林自識卷有如海因公宜寳弆之語）由來者箇未全降（右小香幢）雲廊拾級上書屋號探真詎在逰文苑所希識道津精硏足縆嵗深造貴濳神欲問枕葄者誰誠自得人（右探真書屋）　詭石玲瓏棧徑通入來渾似萬山中近峯逺渚攬次苐秋月春風觀色空拾級望遙目容與焚檀習静意冲融雖然延得江南景罷露臺慙未昔同（右延景樓）　有溪有岸有舟呼活景沿缘面面殊欲傲清河書畫舫收來真蹟是倪迂（右畫舫）　灑然石室額雲林元鎮流風若可尋却與田盤開别面（盤山静寄山莊中向有雲林石室）古松都隠剰嶔岑（假山雖肖吳中稚松皆新種固不如田盤古松林立也右雲林石室）　文軒築溪上溪水如帶横一條拖碧玉朗映心目清有時漾輕漪閃影翻檐楹奚必藉鳶魚天然道趣呈（右横碧軒）　牆界林園水作門泛舟雅似武陵源贏他祗有淵明記不及迂翁畫卷存（右水畫）
summary_en: Eight more poems, on 清淑齋, 小香幢, 探真書屋, 延景樓, 畫舫, 雲林石室, 横碧軒 and the water gate 水門. He admits the pines are young, and that the Suzhou garden no longer matches 倪瓚's picture.

title: 御製 題文園獅子林十六景 序 (excerpt)
excerpt_zh: 向愛倪瓚獅子林圖南巡時擕巻再至其地摹跡題詩昨於長春園東北隙地規倣為之即仍獅林之名初得景八續得景亦如之皆系以句然其亭臺峯沼但能同呉中之獅子林而不能盡同迂翁之獅子林圖兹於避暑山荘清舒山館之前度地復規倣之其景一如御園之名則又同御園之獅子林而非吳中之獅子林且塞苑山水天然因其勢以位置並有非御園所能同者若一經數典則仍不外雲林數尺巻中所謂言同不可何况云異知此則二亦非多一亦非少不必更存分別見嬾
summary_en: Preface to the Chengde copy. It says that the Changchun Yuan 獅子林 was built on spare ground in the north-east of the garden and earned eight scenes then eight more, and that the Chengde copy has the same names. The other poems titled 文園獅子林 are about Chengde, not this compound.

title: 日下舊聞考 狮子林
excerpt_zh: 叢芳榭之東為獅子林為虹橋為假山為納景堂為清閟閣為藤架為磴道為占峯亭為清淑齋為小香幢為探真書屋為延景樓為雲林石室為横碧軒為水門（長春園册）
summary_en: A bare list of what stands at 獅子林: 虹橋, the rockwork, 納景堂, 清閟閣, a wisteria frame, stone steps, 占峯亭, 清淑齋, 小香幢, 探真書屋, 延景樓, 雲林石室, 横碧軒 and the water gate.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 狮子林
summary_en: Qianlong named sixteen scenes in 1775 and wrote the set again in 1779, 1781, 1786 and 1793; Jiaqing in 1796 and Daoguang in 1828 did the same. The dowager dined here in 1828-1829, Daoguang arrived by ice sled in 1829, and the last entries are of 1858. 狮子林: 22 dated items, 1775-1858, of which 17 poems and 5 court records (Qianlong, Jiaqing, Daoguang, Xianfeng); recurring themes: the view, visits to the dowager, boating. First dated 1775, last dated 1858.

title: 长春园 No.6, 狮子林 Shizi Lin, and No.8, 如园 Ru Yuan
excerpt_other: The Lion Grove, Number Six, was patterned from a garden of that name in Che-kiang, and the Ju Yuan, or Garden of Likeness, Number Eight, and its pools, bamboos, rockeries, and flower beds arranged like those of the provincial treasurer's yamen in Nanking.
summary_en: 狮子林 after a garden of that name (Malone says Zhejiang; it is usually placed at Suzhou, in Jiangsu) and 如园 after the provincial treasurer's yamen garden in Nanjing.

title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 狮子林
summary_en: Two gardens: 丛芳榭 of 1747 (five-bay hall on the lake, 琴清斋 behind, 漾月 and 集虚 pavilions), and from 1772 the Suzhou copy to its north-east. It lists the sixteen scenes, and says Qianlong's copy of Ni Zan's painting was kept in 清閟阁. Partly rebuilt 1828.

title: 虹桥
excerpt_zh: 跨水饮垂虹，浮空路可通。只疑縹渺处，吹断虑罡风。
summary_en: Poem 虹桥 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1773, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 虹桥
excerpt_zh: 饮虹跨两岸，冰渚步堪通。因之生别解，半实半犹空。
summary_en: Poem 虹桥 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1775, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 虹桥
excerpt_zh: 卧波上者形如半，印水观来体忽圆。名曰虹桥真副实，试看雨后影拖天。
summary_en: Poem 虹桥 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1779, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 假山
excerpt_zh: 狮子以石胜，相传为瓒自位置者。兹令吴下高手堆塑小景，曲折尽肖，驿此展拓成林，奚啻武贲之于中郎。妙手吴中堆塑能，绝胜道子写嘉陵。一邱一壑都神肖，忆我春巡展步曾。
summary_en: Poem 假山 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1772, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 假山
excerpt_zh: 白业当年参所能，至今树若语迦陵。兴来欲问倪高士，吐出几多邱壑曾。
summary_en: Poem 假山 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1773, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 假山
excerpt_zh: 吴中狮子林，结构云倪者。即今肖御园，岂异粉本把。又思石渠藏，颇多斯翁写。展观皆似真，何独此云假。历历况可步，谓胜一筹也。然而久暂间，其理悟者寡。
summary_en: Poem 假山 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1775, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 纳景堂
excerpt_zh: 静具动之理，动形静者情。即如春孟际，已蕴物华呈。盆里梅英馥，庭前松籁声。
summary_en: Poem 纳景堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1773, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 纳景堂
excerpt_zh: 一时偶涉惟偷暇，七字成吟又隔年。似此忽忙问景者，安能高逸学迂仙。
summary_en: Poem 纳景堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1775, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 纳景堂
excerpt_zh: 春风秋月应依旧，白发苍颜略觉殊。似是虚堂有相谓，纳来景已两年孤。
summary_en: Poem 纳景堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1779, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 清閟阁
excerpt_zh: 吴工肖堆塑，燕匠营位置。难移古树古，颇似翠峰翠。发帑非累民，爱林因写意。高阁实已构，真图斯未弆
summary_en: Poem 清閟阁 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1773, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 清閟阁
excerpt_zh: 画屏围石嶂，奁镜俯冰池。弗诩饶佳致，所欣契静思。和风轻幕拂，旭日朗窗移。清閟真清閟，春光未冶时。
summary_en: Poem 清閟阁 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1775, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 清閟阁
excerpt_zh: 何曾清閟收奇品，雅似江南绝点埃。一石一松胥入画，可知粉本所由来。
summary_en: Poem 清閟阁 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1779, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 藤架
excerpt_zh: 石桥上置藤萝架，不必施松引蔓通。谩诮忽收紫步障，几多花意在其中。
summary_en: Poem 藤架 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1775, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 藤架
excerpt_zh: 石桥曲折俯波明，岁久藤枝布架盈。已过花时绿阴蔚，宁须重忆紫云棚。
summary_en: Poem 藤架 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1779, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 藤架
excerpt_zh: 石桥宛转俯冰池，架上藤萝枯蔓披。吐叶开花虽有待，迅于驹隙者惟时。
summary_en: Poem 藤架 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1781, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 磴道
excerpt_zh: 循岩陟磴，诗人比之丹梯。此虽叠石而成，亦自觉风云可生足底。房山石似洞庭，刻峭一例岭嵘。拾级试登磴道，丹台咫尺通灵。
summary_en: Poem 磴道 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1772, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 磴道
excerpt_zh: 突起那论迳庭，羊肠盘上峰嵘。岂惜略劳步履，端知大惬性灵。
summary_en: Poem 磴道 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1773, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 磴道
excerpt_zh: 假山颇致崔巍，几梯磴道盘回。弗劳步履陟顶，骋怀游目能哉。
summary_en: Poem 磴道 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1775, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 占峰亭
excerpt_zh: 峰顶一笠，清旷绝尘。元镇画往往如是，印证故在不即离间。虽是假山亦有峰，㠎嶫砐硪转饶趣。历艰陟顶得稍平，四柱小亭翼然据。一步一奇极变幻，眼底神情乃毕露。俗手石工那得窥，粉本倪迂精绝处。
summary_en: Poem 占峰亭 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1772, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 占峰亭
excerpt_zh: 平则为岭侧则峰，峰亭实胜岭亭趣。于平易工侧艰工，例论诗文颇有据。偶攀绝顶得笠覆，便忆巡方斯冕露。欲言欲罢而不能，是我结习未忘处。
summary_en: Poem 占峰亭 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1773, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 占峰亭
excerpt_zh: 峰顶构亭号占峰，不知亭亦被峰占。譬之持竿以钓鱼，却成鱼钓率可验。贪夫狥财，烈士狥名。此善于彼，仍属有营。
summary_en: Poem 占峰亭 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1775, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 清淑斋
excerpt_zh: 就树得佳阴，境原狮子林。假山亦岩龉，曲径致幽深。花色淑非艳，溪声清以沉。如云晤倪老，恐未契高襟。
summary_en: Poem 清淑斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1772, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 清淑斋
excerpt_zh: 前砌带溪水，后檐屏石林。却华意犹惬，既静望偏深。春稚芜茵浅，风过竹籁沉。平心迎淑气，触目适清襟。
summary_en: Poem 清淑斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1773, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 清淑斋
excerpt_zh: 斋不设窗牖，旷观惬倚凭。齐簷叠石诡，入座俯冰澄。图史自娱暇，松篁可作朋。略言弗称者，应节缀华灯。
summary_en: Poem 清淑斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1775, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 小香幢
excerpt_zh: 石磴玲珑倚翠幢，上为佛室朗莲釭。偶然别学倪家调，若论尘心实未降。
summary_en: Poem 小香幢 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1773, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 小香幢
excerpt_zh: 芙蓉擎出小楼孤，调御当中坐丈夫。供养香幢实余事，若论佛法本来无。
summary_en: Poem 小香幢 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1775, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 小香幢
excerpt_zh: 一间小阁供金仙，竖石为幢静不妍。设以普贤功德论，个中饶是净因缘。
summary_en: Poem 小香幢 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1779, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 探真书屋
excerpt_zh: 云廊拾级上，书屋号探真。讵在游文苑，所希识道津。精研足縆岁，深造贵潜神。欲问枕葄者，谁诚自得人。
summary_en: Poem 探真书屋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1772, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 探真书屋
excerpt_zh: 楼廊曼转处，书屋得清幽。长物心期屏，古香鼻观谋。三余信可乐，四库近方搜。咨尔穷经者，应于真际求。
summary_en: Poem 探真书屋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1775, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 探真书屋
excerpt_zh: 底须虎帐设皋比，偶坐常欣芸简披。学者都知探真也，践斯言却鲜逢之。
summary_en: Poem 探真书屋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1779, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 延景楼
excerpt_zh: 诡石玲珑栈径通，入来浑似半山中。近峰远渚揽次第，秋月春风观色空。拾级望遥目容与，焚檀习静意冲融。虽然延得江南景，罢露台惭未昔同。
summary_en: Poem 延景楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1772, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 延景楼
excerpt_zh: 当石危梯讶不通，攀过奇境得壶中。似兹结构安措想，宛彼楼轩若倚空。俯畅物华皆入望，春和吾意与俱融。稿摹倪也还黄也，莫漫区区辨异同。
summary_en: Poem 延景楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1773, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 延景楼
excerpt_zh: 四时之景无尽，延来及节为嘉。最喜韶年春孟，况对冰天月华。梅香细细玉晕，柳色旋旋金加。何必苏台忆古，倪黄本是一家
summary_en: Poem 延景楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1775, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 云林石室
excerpt_zh: 石作夏云石作林，其中有室费幽寻。三间十笏惟容膝，却称开窗望远岑。
summary_en: Poem 云林石室 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1773, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 云林石室
excerpt_zh: 盘山精舍名，置此实相称。刻削荦嶨间，一线通云径。幽宅才三楹，纳景乃无罄。虽乏肤寸功，亦有气求应。设诚为甘霖，于耜恰春令。
summary_en: Poem 云林石室 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1775, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 云林石室
excerpt_zh: 容容润欲逼嶙嶙，粉本倪家貌得真。可识云林原未古，俨如石室接其人。
summary_en: Poem 云林石室 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1779, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 横碧轩
excerpt_zh: 文轩筑溪上，溪水如带横。一条拖碧玉，朗映心目清。有时漾轻漪，闪影翻檐楹。奚必借鸢鱼，天然道趣呈。
summary_en: Poem 横碧轩 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1772, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 横碧轩
excerpt_zh: 有桥如弓弯，有溪若镜横。过桥坐敞轩，不期意与清。古帙亦陈几，春灯亦缀楹。但识冰即水，奚殊碧波呈。
summary_en: Poem 横碧轩 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1773, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 横碧轩
excerpt_zh: 水碧冰亦碧，一例轩前横。虚实象中孚，会理因循名。
summary_en: Poem 横碧轩 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1775, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 水门
excerpt_zh: 墙界林园水作门，泛舟雅似武陵源。赢他只有渊明记，不及迂翁画卷存。
summary_en: Poem 水门 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1772, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 水门
excerpt_zh: 跨水为墙下置门，此由溯委此探源。艺林夫岂外道义，我亦因之成性存。
summary_en: Poem 水门 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1773, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 水门
excerpt_zh: 跨波门径上骑墙，历历人行来往航。设使桃源拟洞口，不教迷路误渔郎。
summary_en: Poem 水门 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1775, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

title: 御製玉玲瓏舘詩
excerpt_zh: 乾隆二十年御製玉玲瓏舘詩　湖石三四峯湘筠五六箇月下詭狀獰風前清影簸詩渾白濁吟畫是倪迂作發興在宣毫澄懐當筍座而我每少閒隔月纔一過（叶）
summary_en: Short poem on 玉玲瓏館: three or four lake rocks and a few bamboos, visited about once a month.

title: 玉玲珑馆
locator: v4 p.1, under 玉玲珑馆; source ref 5-366
excerpt_zh: 湖石三四峰，湘筠五六个。月下诡状狞，风前清影簸。诗浑白浊吟，画是倪迂作。发兴在宣毫，澄怀当筍座。而我每少闲，隔月才一过。
summary_en: Poem 玉玲珑馆 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1755, filed by the editors under 玉玲珑馆.

title: 鹤安斋: 乾隆二十五年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十五年 (1760), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 朴室水之裔，嘉树为其屏。方蓬岂必楼，心疑即斯境。幽禽翩然翔，彳亍步顾影。斋前性所安，露下韵愈警。我来惟片时，难值静以永。明月与清风，合付胎仙领。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 鹤安斋, 1760. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 狎鷗亭
excerpt_zh: 臨水孤亭名狎鷗煙波無盡任飛浮
summary_en: Reads the plan label 狎?亭 at 玉玲珑馆: the small pavilion by the water "in the imperial garden", 1764. The poems do not name its compound. 狎鷗舫 of 1782-96 is another name and not tied here.

title: 御製 題玉玲瓏館
excerpt_zh:
題玉玲瓏館
緑瓊繞砌戛玲瓏真玉應勞追琢工光透一輪寜礙月聲敲六律雅宜風桃詩還為（去聲）思韓愈笛賦何須詠馬融静對恰如㕘半偈是無色色不空空
summary_en: Green stone around the steps at 玉玲瓏館, with moonlight showing through the holes.

title: 玉玲珑馆: 乾隆二十九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十九年 (1764), date from the compilation
locator: p.288 item (1), under 玉玲珑馆
excerpt_zh: 绿琼绕砌戛玲珑，真玉应劳追琢工。光透一轮寜碍月，声敲六律雅宜风。桃诗还为思韩愈，笛赋何须咏马融。静对恰如参半偈，是无色色不空空。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 玉玲珑馆, 1764, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 鹤安斋: 乾隆二十九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十九年 (1764), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 园林率飬鹤，以其调弗俗。素羽与朗音，足清人耳目。不无资稻粱，斯有所拘束。闲庭松石佳，鹤安名我屋。其然岂其然，胎仙意如恧。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 鹤安斋, 1764. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 鹤安斋: 乾隆二十九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十九年 (1764), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh:
壬午剏放鹤，自此每推挍。静宜例避暑，业已从其好（去岁驻香山静宜园，曾视避暑山荘，例放
鹤，并迭旧韵作诗纪事）。御园亦蓄鹤，隔林偶闻呌。翦羽常怀苦，充腹且谋乐。意虽不肯住，焉能巢父掉。因命概放之，往事胥堪效。既无絷体虞，仍有清音报。林监乃窃叹，官粟何由调。胎仙饱与饥，彼固弗能告。是谓免禽食（用孟子意），而实减人稻（饲鹤者，或窃馈，今放之，则不支鹤粮，无由窃矣，故戏及之） 。鹤安信鹤安，大遂凌霞操。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 鹤安斋, 1764. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 再题玉玲珑馆
locator: v4 p.7, under 玉玲珑馆; source ref 9-156
excerpt_zh: 竹石此间佳，而皆宜雪物。今朝问景来，积素犹蓊郁。磊磊与虚笼，猗猗与轻拂。通体一玲珑，怡神在穆沕。试问孙兴公，于何觅充诎。
summary_en: Poem 再题玉玲珑馆 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1766, filed by the editors under 玉玲珑馆.

title: 御製 題玉玲瓏館
excerpt_zh:
題玉玲瓏館
假山堆作玉玲瓏羣玉中間有路通不效未央誇間（去聲）璧尚慙大禹是卑宫碧璈聲出竹敲砌古鑑光呈月隠櫳翰墨林非資博雅時因粥粥省吾躬
summary_en: Rockwork called a jade mass with a path through it, bamboo tapping the steps, and an old mirror-like moon at the lattice.

title: 玉玲珑馆: 乾隆三十一年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十一年 (1766), date from the compilation
locator: p.288 item (2), under 玉玲珑馆
excerpt_zh: 假山堆作玉玲珑，群玉中间有路通。不效未央夸间璧，尚惭大禹是卑宫。碧璈声出竹敲砌，古鉴光呈月隐栊。翰墨林非资博雅，时因粥粥省吾躬。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 玉玲珑馆, 1766, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 芥舟
excerpt_zh: 水中亭子小而幽喻物名之曰芥舟舟已非舟芥豈芥兩㤀離即幻隨流
summary_en: A very small pavilion in the water named for the boat of the Zhuangzi. The poems sit in runs on garden halls and do not name 玉玲珑馆; only the S01 label places it. The phrase 芥舟 in the 海岳开襟 poem (S05 j83:11b) is a figure of speech, not this pavilion.

title: 玉玲珑馆: 乾隆三十二年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十二年 (1767), date from the compilation
locator: p.288 item (3), under 玉玲珑馆
excerpt_zh: 绿水回环中有居，坐来悦可适几余。松间飒飒风含爽，竹际泠泠月入虚。纵目恰宜遇寥朗，托怀又喜得清舒。优沾时雨逢秋霁，为此欣予亦惕予。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 玉玲珑馆, 1767, on escaping the heat. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 鹤安斋: 乾隆三十五年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十五年 (1770), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 夙有胎仙伴，无过缀景看。非闗稻粱省，欲使翥翔欢。仍此空庭下，由他碧宇寛。开笼放去者，真觉性相安。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 鹤安斋, 1770. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 鹤安斋: 乾隆四十年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆四十年 (1775), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 放鹤从来屡咏诗（屡作放鹤诗，向皆书泐此斋中），鹤安复不免拈辞。任他长羽无拘束，即是好生有顺宜。时亦庭前呈舞态，欣于松畔具仙姿。惟余一节难调处，苑吏禽粮怨减支。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 鹤安斋, 1775. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 鹤安斋: 乾隆四十七年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆四十七年 (1782), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 始作鹤安斋，谓宜适其性。既不翦羽翼，亦省梁稻供。侵寻数十载，翼长去无剩。青松朋若失，白鸥鸣鲜应。斋安鹤未安，名实似庭径。既而静思之，胎仙本清净。戞然返青田，得所夫何病。鹤安斋亦安，辞多此为咏。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 鹤安斋, 1782. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 鹤安斋: 乾隆五十年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆五十年 (1785), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 借问鹤之安，应在山林杳。亭台及湖石，胎仙岂所晓。有如王仲宣，信美故土藐。因命弗翦翮，任其翱云表。初去转翔仍，既久弗来了。快㢤得其安，漫议庭禽少。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 鹤安斋, 1785. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 鹤安斋: 乾隆五十六年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆五十六年 (1791), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 昔罢翦鹤翎，翱翔任其性。既而减鹤粮，园伇以为病（自壬午年剏放鹤之例，鹤既得遂其性，而罢支鹤粮。虽云不蹈孟子禽食之讥，然园丁自此无由侵克余粮，未免失其利縁矣。）。乃悟鹤安伇弗安，昔诗得半非全称（利于鹤乃弗利于园，伇是以戊中诗有一利有一弊两得鲜兼全之句）。大都一利有一弊，吾将通此于施政。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 鹤安斋, 1791. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 玉玲珑馆: 嘉庆七年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆七年 (1802), date from the compilation
locator: p.288 item (4), under 玉玲珑馆
excerpt_zh: 试放兰桡碧沼东，天光澹淡午烟笼。云容层叠欣将雨，林影婆娑又舞风。远岸染霞高岭绘，回溪问景曲廊通。麦秋候届未蒙泽，时切苍穹锡岁丰。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 玉玲珑馆, 1802, on boating. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 玉玲珑馆: 嘉庆七年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆七年 (1802), date from the compilation
locator: p.288 item (5), under 玉玲珑馆
excerpt_zh: 庭前叠石致玲珑，略彴相连别馆通。崇朴敬承继大宝，晏安时戒处深宫。傅心常仰诗题壁，克俭宁教玉琢栊。肯构寸忱祈赐佑，戢戎和众厪予躬。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 玉玲珑馆, 1802, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 玉玲珑馆: 嘉庆十二年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十二年 (1807), date from the compilation
locator: p.288 item (6), under 玉玲珑馆
excerpt_zh: 清溪右转径玲珑，弭棹寻幽文馆通。竹坞禽栖枝上下，荷池鱼戏叶西东。闲阶寂静敷疏荫，广厦虚明纳远风。到此顿忘伏暑候，市廛狭隘悯难同。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 玉玲珑馆, 1807, on escaping the heat and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 日下舊聞考 玉玲珑馆
excerpt_zh: 獅子林之南為玉玲瓏館正宇為正誼明道五楹北為林光澹碧東為鶴安齋西南為蹈和堂（長春園册）臣等謹案林光澹碧宇内額曰逰心於淡
summary_en: South of 獅子林: 玉玲瓏館, main range 正誼明道 of five bays, with 林光澹碧, 鶴安齋 and 蹈和堂.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 鹤安斋
locator: from p.288, under 玉玲珑馆
summary_en: Eight Qianlong poems, 1760-1791: cranes kept here, released in 1764 and 1775, one returning in 1770, and the freed birds remembered in 1785 and 1791. 鹤安斋: 8 dated items, 1760-1791, of which 8 poems (Qianlong). First dated 1760, last dated 1791.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 玉玲珑馆
locator: from p.288, under 玉玲珑馆
summary_en: Poems of 1764-1807 on its rockery of Taihu stone and its summer use; in 1802 Jiaqing came here by boat from 狮子林. 玉玲珑馆: 6 dated items, 1764-1807, of which 6 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: the view, escaping the heat, boating. First dated 1764, last dated 1807.

title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 玉玲珑馆
summary_en: Built 1747, added to about 1764, on an island south of 狮子林. Gate five bays; main hall of seven (plaque 正谊明道), rear of nine (林光澹碧). West court has 撷景室, 蹈和堂 and the square 朝晖亭 on the water; the east has five-bay 鹤安斋, the double-eaved 狎鸥亭, 随安室, a greenhouse, a fountain, 澹然书屋 and 芥舟 at the shore.

title: 玉玲珑馆平面图
locator: 国家图书馆善本部 样式雷排架070-1号
summary_en: Base plan of Yulinglong Guan in colour and ink with yellow slips, 1170x848 mm, late Qianlong to Daoguang, showing its two groups of buildings. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

title: 戏题鹤安斋
locator: v4 p.2, under 玉玲珑馆; source ref 8-754
excerpt_zh: 园林率养鹤，以其调弗俗。素羽与朗音，足清人耳目。不无资稻粱，斯有所拘束。闲庭松石佳，鹤安名我屋。其然岂其然，胎仙意如恧。
summary_en: Poem 戏题鹤安斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 玉玲珑馆.

title: 鹤安斋放鹤再叠避暑山庄放鹤亭韵
locator: v4 p.3, under 玉玲珑馆; source ref 8-792
excerpt_zh: 壬午创放鹤，自此每推挍。静宜例避暑，业已从其好
summary_en: Poem 鹤安斋放鹤再叠避暑山庄放鹤亭韵 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 玉玲珑馆.

title: 鹤安斋戏题
locator: v4 p.16, under 玉玲珑馆; source ref 12-962
excerpt_zh: 昔原赋之粮，即而放于野。赋粮拘束兮，放野逍遥也。非缘省粮为，乃图鹤安者。继因去渐多，栖松或致寡。铩羽仍饲之，园吏喜跃冶。饲鹤即饲人，鹤瘦欲言哑。
summary_en: Poem 鹤安斋戏题 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1777, filed by the editors under 玉玲珑馆.

title: 蹈和堂
locator: v4 p.4, under 玉玲珑馆; source ref 8-853
excerpt_zh: 元气化工氲，醇风万物欣。王褒讲德论，曹植事神文。静挹筦倪趣，闲披翰墨芬。四情皆中节，不敏愿尊闻。
summary_en: Poem 蹈和堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 玉玲珑馆.

title: 题蹈和堂
locator: v4 p.4, under 玉玲珑馆; source ref 9-102
excerpt_zh: 座有古芸披，甄陶左右宜。履贞兼纳顺，率礼复敦诗。省岁调元气，祈年协四时。与民同保合，念释总于兹。
summary_en: Poem 题蹈和堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1765, filed by the editors under 玉玲珑馆.

title: 蹈和堂
locator: v4 p.10, under 玉玲珑馆; source ref 9-454
excerpt_zh: 履贞济徽懿，率礼守安详。永念儿宽对，非循支父方。殷勤树禽语，自在砌花芳。协序惟旸雨，消闲有缥缃。
summary_en: Poem 蹈和堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1768, filed by the editors under 玉玲珑馆.

title: 芥舟
locator: v4 p.7, under 玉玲珑馆; source ref 9-179
excerpt_zh: 杯水无殊覆坳堂，堂如舟亦芥堪方。蒙庄原谓胶舟者，安识须弥个里藏。
summary_en: Poem 芥舟 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1766, filed by the editors under 玉玲珑馆.

title: 芥舟
locator: v4 p.12, under 玉玲珑馆; source ref 10-639
excerpt_zh: 冻合池冰近砌坳，置舟杯芥总须胶。何如悟取华严旨，极大须弥个里包。
summary_en: Poem 芥舟 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1770, filed by the editors under 玉玲珑馆.

title: 芥舟
locator: v4 p.13, under 玉玲珑馆; source ref 10-770
excerpt_zh: 杯水坳堂芥作舟，问谁能以此乘浮。今来冰凝芥亦胶，可复于杯相傲不。
summary_en: Poem 芥舟 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1771, filed by the editors under 玉玲珑馆.

title: 映清斋
locator: v4 p.24, under 映清斋; source ref 9-204
excerpt_zh: 宛转回廊圆中规，纱疏面面俯临池。春风淡荡吹澜候，秋月高寒入影时。澄际堪因悟心性，照来恰复见须眉。如斯无尽藏佳处，久坐何曾刻漏移。
summary_en: Poem 映清斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1766, filed by the editors under 映清斋.

title: 映清斋
locator: v4 p.26, under 映清斋; source ref 9-221
excerpt_zh: 回廊半浸水，水气入斋凉。互映色空际，含清上下光。契神于缥渺，得景即苍茫。物色与人意，相将报白藏。
