locator: v4 p.262, under 展诗应律; source ref 3-349
excerpt_zh: 试步虚明榭，重寻曲折廊。平临渌波活，静挹碧苔香。柳影偶疏宻，蝉声互短长。心清境益远，溽暑已想忘。
summary_en: Poem 苔香室 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1807, filed by the editors under 展诗应律.

title: 苔香室
locator: v4 p.263, under 展诗应律; source ref 4-37
excerpt_zh: 嘉泽滋芳甸，新波漾碧塘。荷钱浮藻影，花片恋苔香。爽籁来疏牖，清阴转曲廊。时和乐咸畅，庶汇普繁昌。
summary_en: Poem 苔香室 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1808, filed by the editors under 展诗应律.

title: 苔香室
locator: v4 p.264, under 展诗应律; source ref 4-77
excerpt_zh: 弭棹芦洲畔，依晖步曲廊。菊开不见叶，苔薄尚留香。林外云光淡，天边霞影翔。室虚挹方沼，澄澈印沧浪。
summary_en: Poem 苔香室 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1808, filed by the editors under 展诗应律.

title: 苔香室
locator: v4 p.266, under 展诗应律; source ref 4-157
excerpt_zh: 昨宵敛秋雨，润景满亭台。浅浪汀前漾，幽香砌下来。帘纹笼薄霭，花片罥闲苔。碧映窗纱淡，迎凉北牖开。
summary_en: Poem 苔香室 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1809, filed by the editors under 展诗应律.

title: 虚明境
locator: v4 p.259, under 展诗应律; source ref 3-164
excerpt_zh: 心源至虚灵，涵养去尘滓。不为外诱移，淡泊祛华靡。定见未坚持，遇境志渐徙。既徒即沦亡，就下嗟如驶。智者识虑超，遏欲循实理。达观养天和，定静安汝止。
summary_en: Poem 虚明境 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1805, filed by the editors under 展诗应律.

title: 虚明境 (绮春园三十景)
excerpt_zh: 虚庭闳敞印空明，心镜圆澄内照清。霞影微茫连雁影，泉声戛击杂松声。阶前新菊黄英灿，浦里残荷翠益擎。最爱秋光悬皎旭，辉腾高宇倍晶莹。
summary_en: One of the Thirty Scenes of 绮春园 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1805 (S58): the poem 虚明境.

title: 虚明境有会
locator: v4 p.260, under 展诗应律; source ref 3-218
excerpt_zh: 自内观外境若烟，由外省内心如水。灵源澄澈蕴清辉，静待物来安汝止。集虚观妙得大成，养晦涵明察众理。予不敢为天下先，克己存诚凛顾諟。本性湛然泯贪痴，直道而行去奇诡。
summary_en: Poem 虚明境有会 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1806, filed by the editors under 展诗应律.

title: 虚明境
locator: v4 p.261, under 展诗应律; source ref 3-327
excerpt_zh: 心德极虚灵，浩然超物表。澄源勿混淆，朗若明镜皎。所患外诱来，世态相纷扰。遂欲趋迷途，舍大转图小。鉴古得失昭，义利一目了。有勇斯去邪，总由性中肇。
summary_en: Poem 虚明境 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1807, filed by the editors under 展诗应律.

title: 虚明境
locator: v4 p.261, under 展诗应律; source ref 3-338
excerpt_zh: 养心务集虚，静观明众理。处晦洞群情，去私谁誉毁。内省无危机，澄澈如止水。乱丝寻其端，析缕得原委。朗鉴难遁形，公溥消奇诡。至境蕴灵通，万缘尺宅始。
summary_en: Poem 虚明境 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1807, filed by the editors under 展诗应律.

title: 虚明境
locator: v4 p.262, under 展诗应律; source ref 4-4
excerpt_zh: 养心在集虚，洞明应万事。情态任变迁，静观辨诚伪。欲识邱壑幽，先澄方寸地。内省果无瑕，外诱奚能累。安仁非市恩，顺应勿炫智。即境抒予怀，艰哉大宝位。
summary_en: Poem 虚明境 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1808, filed by the editors under 展诗应律.

title: 嘉庆 《题含淳堂》 (as quoted in S220)
locator: S220 section 一; primary not seen
excerpt_zh: 绮春佳境御园东，别有洞天复道通。明善旧题念堂构，含淳新额焕檐栊。
summary_en: The hall once named 明善堂 Mingshan Tang gets the new plaque 含淳 Hanchun. Position hint: S220 says 含淳堂 was later renamed 生冬室, so QC48 is an earlier name of QC18 and should stand at QC18.

title: 含淳堂得句
locator: v4 p.287, under 生冬室; source ref 2-104
excerpt_zh: 曲沼冰初解，清波印静心。岸莎新土茁，阶石旧苔侵。淳化嗟难返，春光看渐深。萦怀邪未靖，抚字愧君临。
summary_en: Poem 含淳堂得句 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1802, filed by the editors under 生冬室.

title: 含淳堂
locator: v4 p.288, under 生冬室; source ref 2-245
excerpt_zh: 临水轩堂敞，虚明接远天。荷风翻浦荇，竹雾卷溪烟。延爽回廊曲，来薰复径穿。只惭政多阙，淳化未能宣。水榭宜闲眺，招凉四面风。地幽无暑到，境雅有廊通。烟幕柳丝绿，露含荷朵红。偶探长夏景，民瘼每萦衷。
summary_en: Poem 含淳堂 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1803, filed by the editors under 生冬室.

title: 含淳堂 (绮春园三十景)
excerpt_zh: 答阳纳影豁平坰，挹爽高堂对碧汀。层叠石峰开牗见，清泠泉磴隔林听。菊芬绕座探幽秀，鸿影横霞入窈冥。写额含淳政难格，闾阎犹未见盈宁。
summary_en: One of the Thirty Scenes of 绮春园 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1805 (S58): the poem 含淳堂.

title: 水心榭
locator: v4 p.275, under 春泽斋; source ref 2-123
excerpt_zh: 虚榭碧池中，回廊步可通。层波叠轻雾，四面引薰风。鱼影穿疏荇，林阴罨画栊。授时方长养，百谷望全丰。几暇偶习静，悠然在水心。碧奁欣若接，赤伞漫相侵。人寂波弥定，林稠夏渐深。观澜明性海，洞达鉴群忱。
summary_en: Poem 水心榭 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1802, filed by the editors under 春泽斋.

title: 水心榭对雨 六月初六日
locator: v4 p.275, under 春泽斋; source ref 2-128
excerpt_zh: 酷暑昼复宵，凌晨布云脚。近午坐水心，欣逢甘雨作。万斛珠跳波，银箭倾错落。繁响溅池荷，飞流悬杰阁。烦暍易清凉，驱炎胜服药。大田普透滋，庶可苏沟壑。去夏实苦霖，今幸沐时若。总荷上天恩，锡丰转歉薄。疏密间滂沱，膏泽庆溥博。更愿兆洗兵，邪靖群黎乐。
summary_en: Poem 水心榭对雨 六月初六日 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1802, filed by the editors under 春泽斋.

title: 水心榭
locator: v4 p.276, under 春泽斋; source ref 2-237
excerpt_zh: 虚榭纳清景，宛在水中央。畧彴达前渚，雁齿连回廊。倒浸明霞影，荡漾涵云光。游鳞戏锦浪，拨刺唼落芳。静玩有至乐，达观濠濮乡。息机罢垂钓，齐物思蒙庄。代谢漫兴感，四时迭显藏。调御斡元化，天工勤替襄。
summary_en: Poem 水心榭 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1803, filed by the editors under 春泽斋.

title: 水心榭
locator: v4 p.276, under 春泽斋; source ref 2-245
excerpt_zh: 虚榭延薰纳新爽，藤床静坐玩沧浪。绿波叠叠光溶漾，拨刺游鱼叶底藏。四面回廊步可通，赤栏雁齿接西东。抚时解愠消烦热，农事艰难总系衷。
summary_en: Poem 水心榭 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1803, filed by the editors under 春泽斋.

title: 水心榭
locator: v4 p.277, under 春泽斋; source ref 3-5
excerpt_zh: 水榭最宜夏，虚延四面风。回廊互环抱，高柳映葱茏。绮浪层层碧，金鳞叠叠红。来薰吹曲槛，纳爽透轻拢。远岭萦林雾，闲庭绚卉丛。心清畅延眺，验候望年丰。
summary_en: Poem 水心榭 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1804, filed by the editors under 春泽斋.

title: 水心榭 (绮春园三十景)
excerpt_zh: 曲折回廊四面周，水心虚榭景全收。立汀白鹭浪花溅，穿藻金鳞波影浮。林幄敷阴风飒爽，泉琴戛响韵清幽。霞光倒印澄潭底，岚黛苍茫落远州。
summary_en: One of the Thirty Scenes of 绮春园 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1805 (S58): the poem 水心榭.

title: 茗柯精舍
locator: v4 p.172, under 绮春园; source ref 2-107
excerpt_zh: 妙选芳芽品玉泉，竹垆妥置及时煎。能消尘念生清爽，两腋风来觉静便。
summary_en: Poem 茗柯精舍 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1802, filed by the editors under 绮春园.

title: 茗柯精舍
locator: v4 p.184, under 绮春园; source ref 3-164
excerpt_zh: 玉泉味甘芳，活火煎竹鼎。雨前贡浙西，嫩芽试佳茗。鱼蟹眼浮波，旗枪茁细梃。一瓯润诗肠，幽芬砚席迥。得暇偶怡情，岂同吟客等。心清理万几，镜辉常炯炯。
summary_en: Poem 茗柯精舍 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1805, filed by the editors under 绮春园.

title: 茗柯精舍 (绮春园三十景)
excerpt_zh: 珍藏佳茗贮都篮，试煮玉泉味至甘。嫩叶欣传龙井产，枯禅漫向赵州参。浇诗雅合一瓯足，解渴何须七椀贪。悦性养和消暑气，凉飔两腋觉清酣。
summary_en: One of the Thirty Scenes of 绮春园 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1805 (S58): the poem 茗柯精舍.

title: 茗柯精舍
locator: v4 p.187, under 绮春园; source ref 4-49
excerpt_zh: 湘帘筠几置都篮，茗事宜从午昼探。鱼蟹泛波佳候转，旗枪沸鼎淡芬含。碧浮嫩荚芽轻漾，清挹名泉味至甘。试品半瓯烦暑滌，岂同七椀玉川耽。
summary_en: Poem 茗柯精舍 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1808, filed by the editors under 绮春园.

title: 茗柯精舍
locator: v4 p.188, under 绮春园; source ref 4-139
excerpt_zh: 几闲涤心虑，座右置都篮。芳浥旗枪列，候先鱼蟹探。茗抽龙井美，水煮玉泉甘。祛暑胜瓜李，无须七椀贪。
summary_en: Poem 茗柯精舍 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1809, filed by the editors under 绮春园.

title: 茗柯精舍
locator: v4 p.188, under 绮春园; source ref 4-260
excerpt_zh: 精舍在川上，趁闲偶一过。名泉煮活火，佳茗掇柔柯。顿觉暑氛滌，平添吟思多。清风齐入牖，延爽乐安和。
summary_en: Poem 茗柯精舍 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1810, filed by the editors under 绮春园.

title: 来薰室
locator: v4 p.171, under 绮春园; source ref 2-82
excerpt_zh: 习习南熏静里来，纱棂洞启八窗开。招延爽籁中庭敞，扇被清风广厦恢。念系小民怨暑雨，忧深余孽鼓氛埃。西南何日方消劫，筹笔惭非将将才。
summary_en: Poem 来薰室 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1801, filed by the editors under 绮春园.

title: 来薰室 (绮春园三十景)
excerpt_zh: 赤伞烘云畏赫炎，南薰习习入疏帘。消除溽暑凉生簟，披拂轻飔爽接檐。庭际禽声林外啭，阶前花馥座中添。心清身逸居佳境，轸念嚣尘遍里阎。
summary_en: One of the Thirty Scenes of 绮春园 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1805 (S58): the poem 来薰室.

title: 来薰室
locator: v4 p.186, under 绮春园; source ref 3-231
excerpt_zh: 几椽书屋临芳渚，习习南薰入牖来。棲叶新蝉噪密树，寻巢好鸟啄轻苔。浇诗佳茗一瓯瀹，延爽疏棂四面开。妙景天成足吟眺，兰桡又溯碧溪隈。
summary_en: Poem 来薰室 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1806, filed by the editors under 绮春园.

title: 来薰室
locator: v4 p.187, under 绮春园; source ref 4-49
excerpt_zh: 书堂启平原，四面清溪绕。波光叠轻漪，幽芬布曲沼。绿幄荫葱茏，南薰来树杪。纱疏新爽延，尽屏尘壒扰。披襟暑顿消，游心超物表。晴霞绘长空，朗映远山皎。
summary_en: Poem 来薰室 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1808, filed by the editors under 绮春园.

title: 来薰室
locator: v4 p.188, under 绮春园; source ref 4-260
excerpt_zh: 室小轩庭敞，南薰静里来。花宜沿砌种，窗必向林开。帘影遥分竹，炉烟低罥苔。片时契真赏，放棹碧溪隈。
summary_en: Poem 来薰室 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1810, filed by the editors under 绮春园.

title: 来薰室
locator: v4 p.189, under 绮春园; source ref 4-355
excerpt_zh: 茗事初探讨，南薰习习来。清声摇砌竹，天籁下庭槐。帘影笼红药，炉香印碧苔。燕居观物候，长养溥陈荄。
summary_en: Poem 来薰室 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1811, filed by the editors under 绮春园.

title: 般若观 (绮春园三十景)
excerpt_zh: 回环洲屿连诸胜，试泛兰舟漫挂帆。锦水蹙澜翻碧藻，澄潭倒影印苍岩。亭亭净植层波出，叠叠余霞极浦衔。试寄萍踪随荡漾，观同般若远尘凡。
summary_en: One of the Thirty Scenes of 绮春园 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1805 (S58): the poem 般若观.

title: 内务府 repair list 乾隆四十三年 (as quoted in S220)
locator: S220 section 三; archive not seen
excerpt_zh: 明善堂后碧涛书屋、双寿寺、眺吟楼、浩然亭、松风萝月等处捞堆坍塌山石泊岸、码头，勾抿油灰
summary_en: Earliest dated mention of these places. Settles the plan readings of QC53 松风萝月 and QC54 眺吟楼, both partly unread on S01.

title: 毕沅 《春和园纪游》 荻蒲 诗序 (as quoted in S220)
date: 乾隆; S220 gives no year. Describes Fuheng's garden, so before he gave it up
locator: S220 section 三; primary not seen
excerpt_zh: 海于天地为物最巨，谓其受纳广博也。园中西海子南受双寿寺前水，东受北海子水，旷如也，奥如也。南有凝翠轩，沿缘而上，多小石山，山无大林，木皆短松瘦竹……右转而北，崇冈俯仰，最高者为岚翠亭、横翠山房，次之浩然亭、眺吟楼……下瞰湖波，渺弥沦涟，千顷一碧。
summary_en: The northern ridge above the back lake with short pines and thin bamboo; 浩然亭 and 眺吟楼 look down on the water. Useful for planting and for terrain at QC54, QC57.

title: 内务府 repair list 乾隆五十六年 (as quoted in S220)
locator: S220 section 三; archive not seen
excerpt_zh: 涵远斋东顺山房一座三间，两山游廊二座六间 ... 联晖楼后檐拆盖听雨屋殿一座三间，撷秀山房（在西爽村）后檐粘补五抹槅扇一槽，拆修平台码头一座，拆砌虎皮石大墙三段 ... 修葺明善堂东山游廊一座八间，……眺吟楼一座三间
summary_en: Bay counts, in the older state. The bracket is the modern author's. 眺吟楼 is three bays. The two parts of the quotation are separate lists in S220.

title: 招凉榭
locator: v4 p.319, under 含辉楼; source ref 5-271
excerpt_zh: 楼南射圃绿阴长，虚榭空明竹榻凉。碧毯遥连桥略彴，鸣蝉嘒嘒树千章。沼澄林静景清寥，坐挹凉飔不待招。翠盖亭亭擎凈植，欣看君子具丰标。
summary_en: Poem 招凉榭 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1813, filed by the editors under 含辉楼.

title: 招凉榭
locator: v4 p.320, under 含辉楼; source ref 6-213
excerpt_zh: 楼西地高敞，虚榭临陂塘。簷楹遍通达，木榻依砌长。四面来爽籁，雨足气候凉。密荫铺岸柳，碧线薰风扬。坐观庶汇茂，弥觉农务忙。心惬肃乂顺，治协由年康。
summary_en: Poem 招凉榭 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1816, filed by the editors under 含辉楼.

title: 招凉榭
locator: v4 p.321, under 含辉楼; source ref 7-324
excerpt_zh: 菜畦花圃绕楼前，虚榭空明爽气延。东沼荷香遥岸送，西山林影远村连。润含心境一瓯茗，静悟闻思众木蝉。序入新秋消伏暑，生生不息四时旋。
summary_en: Poem 招凉榭 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1820, filed by the editors under 含辉楼.

title: 招凉榭观荷（72）
excerpt_zh: 虚榭楼南绿影长，森森夏木印方塘。锦云翠盖标清兴，盈沼芙蕖一槛香。
summary_en: Poem 招凉榭观荷（72） by the Xianfeng Emperor, 1858, filed by the editors under 含辉楼.

title: 《養吉齋叢錄》 on 澄懷園, called 翰林花園
excerpt_zh: 澄懷園在圓明園東南。康熙朝大學士索額圖賜園，鑾輅嘗臨幸焉，有聖祖御書制節謹度額。雍正三年，賜大學士張廷玉、朱軾，尚書蔡珽，翰林吳士玉、蔡世遠、勵宗萬、于振、戴瀚、楊炳九人居之，蓋皆直書房者。此兩書房詞臣得居之始，俗稱翰林花園。其稱澄懷者，則張文和於康熙間扈從塞上，蒙賜澄懷二大字，雍正五年揭以名其園也。後不戒於火，乾隆間給帑修葺，而山夾水檻已殊昔觀，惟近光樓至今巋然，上有聖祖御書青翠霄漢額。嘉慶壬戌，戶侍英公和直南書房，以樓將圮，鳩工繕完。樓東為麗景軒，又東有屋三楹，植紫藤二本，嘉慶辛酉朱文正直兩書房，治屋扶藤，顏曰古藤書屋。
summary_en: S01's 翰林花园 QC60 is 澄懷園, the garden of the court's Hanlin scholars, not part of Qichun Yuan; it fits the plan, where it lies outside the channel, and S220 puts it beside 绮春园's south-west. S01 draws no buildings, so it gives no form; 山夾 is an uncertain reading. Transcribed by eye.

title: 毕沅 《春和园纪游》 西爽村 诗序 (as quoted in S220)
date: 乾隆; S220 gives no year. Describes Fuheng's garden, so before he gave it up
locator: S220 section 一; primary not seen
excerpt_zh: 西爽村秋原如画，遥缅凤城，楼阁隐见浮岚暖翠中。公平旦趋朝，每由园西角门入左掖垣。
summary_en: West of the garden, open autumn fields with a view to the capital; Fuheng left by the west corner gate for court. S220's bracket gloss is removed.

title: 嘉庆十三年 谕旨 on 西爽村 (as quoted in S220)
locator: S220 section 一; archive not seen
excerpt_zh: 西爽村着仍称绮春园宫门（即绮春园西宫门），嗣后一切称谓书写，俱不得再有西爽村字样。
summary_en: The name 西爽村 is to be dropped in favour of the west gate of the garden. The bracket is the modern author's gloss. S220 puts 西爽村 in the area of the later 延英论道 QC28: a position hint for QC28 near QC61.

title: 绮春园 东南隅 四所
summary_en: Under Daoguang the four courts in the south-east corner served as quarters of consorts of former emperors. S01 labels a long block in that corner 四局, in a hand that miscopies other labels: 四所 is possible. Position and that likeness only.

title: 观谐奇趣水法
locator: v4 p.121, under 西洋楼; source ref 1-110
excerpt_zh: 连延楼阁仿西洋，信是熙朝声教彰。激水引泉流荡漾，笵铜伏地制精良。惊潮翻石千夫御，白雨跳珠万斛量。巧擅人工思远服，版图式廓巩金汤。
summary_en: Poem 观谐奇趣水法 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1796, filed by the editors under 西洋楼.

title: 谐奇趣
locator: v4 p.122, under 西洋楼; source ref 1-385
excerpt_zh: 运水由楼顶，发机务审详。周流虽尽妙，渗漏亦须防。波浪千层叠，珠玑万斛量。纡回伏脉远，灌注溯源长。浩浩终归壑，涓涓始滥觞。观澜奇趣会，至理即包藏。
summary_en: Poem 谐奇趣 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1798, filed by the editors under 西洋楼.

title: Plate I: 谐奇趣 Xieqiqu, north front (by content)
excerpt_other: Trois arcades au rez-de-chaussée; trois fenêtres à l'étage supérieur.
summary_en: Palace of two orders flanked by two isolated octagonal pavilions; the middle arch a niche with a throne; two-basin fountain with four dolphins and candelabra in a railed basin; lawns with shrubs and vases. Delatour's Plate I matches Malone's Engraving 2.

title: Plate II: 谐奇趣 Xieqiqu, south front (by content)
excerpt_other: Sur le sol de cette seconde terrasse sont placées à droite et à gauche deux galeries en hémicycle, lesquelles ne s'élèvent que jusqu'au niveau de la première terrasse.
summary_en: Round stair with a double ramp and a niche with a throne; a basin with vases and animals, birds and quadrupeds spouting; a dolphin in the centre; octagonal pavilions at the ends of the galleries; on the left a triumphal arch with a European dial; a three-arch bridge. Delatour's Plate II matches Malone's Engraving 1.

title: Engraving 1: 谐奇趣 Xieqiqu, south front
excerpt_other: A three-story building in the center was joined by curved galleries to two two-storied towers at the southeast and southwest of the main building.
summary_en: Curved stairs from the second floor down to a pool with several fountains between galleries and towers; a lake with a balustrade in front. Capitals mix Corinthian and Ionic (p.143).

title: Engraving 2: 谐奇趣 Xieqiqu, north front
excerpt_other: The north front of the Hsieh Ch'i Ch'u faced on a fantastically paved courtyard containing conventionally trimmed trees.
summary_en: North front on a patterned paved court with clipped trees. Plates p.142-143 show the ruin after 1860 (from Favier) and after further damage in 1900 and later.

title: 谐奇趣总平面图
locator: 国家图书馆善本部 样077-1号
summary_en: Undated base plan of Xieqi Qu. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

title: 谐奇趣样式雷图
locator: 故宫博物院图书馆 样986号
summary_en: Undated design and survey sketch with the perspective bridge, the water tower, the aviary and Xieqi Qu. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

title: Plate III: 蓄水楼 Xushui Lou
excerpt_other: C'est un corps-de-logis composé d'un rez-de-chaussée, et d'un étage; celui-ci percé de cinq fenêtres, celui-là de quatre fenêtres et d'une porte.
summary_en: Titled Château-d'eau, or Machine du Val-Saint-Pierre. Five windows above, four and a door below, a one-storey wing, clipped shrubs on lawns.

title: Engraving 3: 蓄水楼 Xushui Lou
excerpt_other: A small two-story building with a northern wing of one story faced eastward on the courtyard north of Number Two.
summary_en: Small two-storey water building with a one-storey north wing, facing east.

title: 线法桥
locator: zh.wikipedia 圆明园, 西洋楼 section
summary_en: South of 蓄水楼 against the west wall of 长春园: five arches with beast faces spouting water, and a false door with a large Western clock in the centre, carved walls either side. Parts were later moved to Yenching University. A lead: not seen on a Qing source. No engraving of the 20 is named for it.

title: Plate IV: 花园门 Huayuan Men
excerpt_other: Aux pieds des colonnes sont deux cippes sur lesquels posent deux lions accroupis,
summary_en: Arch with two columns and entablature, two crouching lions on cippi. Panelled wall carried on a small bridge, river below with two more small bridges.

title: Engraving 4: 花园门 Huayuan Men
excerpt_other: The wall was of gray brick cut smooth and decorated with a large pattern in pink and a deep cream tint.
summary_en: North side of the maze gate, seen from inside; 蓄水楼 visible over the wall. Wall colours as quoted, source of the colours not stated.

title: 万花阵 and 花园门; 线法山 and 螺蛳牌楼, yaffin 系列02, 13
summary_en: Lead: the maze gate 花园门 is shaped like a Western clock case with two brass doors; the maze 89 x 59 m, walls about 1.2 m high and over 1,600 m long; the hill 线法山 has a gate each side, the east one called 螺蛳牌楼. Check against the engravings.

title: Plate V: 黄花阵 Huanghua Zhen, the maze
excerpt_other: A-peu-près au centre du labyrinthe s'élève un édifice octogone établi sur un soubassement circulaire.
summary_en: Square, in a wood, inside a wall and then a river with rocks and flowers; small wooden bridges and gates. Octagon with arches on its large faces, windows on the small ones, cul-de-four dome with a small lantern, circular stair round the base. Apparently a throne inside. Small casino at the east entry.

title: Engraving 5: 黄花阵 Huanghua Zhen, the maze
excerpt_other: This was a maze or labyrinth with carved brick walls about shoulder high, surmounted by little slender conventional pines.
summary_en: A two-storey building at the back overlooks it. Round stairs in the centre to an octagonal pavilion where, says the old caretaker Lu, mechanical singing birds were kept (hearsay).

title: 黄花阵平面图
locator: 国家图书馆善本部 样337-146号
summary_en: Plan of the Huanghua Zhen maze; date not seen in the extract. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

title: Plate VI: 养雀笼 Yangque Long, west
excerpt_other: on aperçoit sur la droite une pièce d'eau, où un vaisseau à l'européenne paroît faire naufrage.
summary_en: A portico rather than a house; low gallery on the left; columns on pedestals with bases and no capitals; a pond with what seems a European ship foundering, perhaps a painted or staged scene.

title: Plate VII: 养雀笼 Yangque Long, east
excerpt_other: En face de ce portique est une rivière, que l'on passe sur un pont garni de balustrades,
summary_en: An entry more than a dwelling; looks Greek at first; capitals, arch and niches compared with Borromini; balustrade on the entablature.

title: Engravings 6 and 7: 养雀笼 Yangque Long
excerpt_other: Water flowed from carved white marble fountains on both sides of the doorway.
summary_en: West front on the court behind 谐奇趣, with a passage east through the building. Peacocks until Jiaqing, per Lu. Plate p.146: being torn down about 1924.

title: 圆明园遗址考古今年推进至大水法, 浙江在线
summary_en: 养雀笼 Yangque Long: 1,000 m2 cleared in 2015, showing foundations that combine 三合土 lime concrete with brick and stone. 大水法 and 远瀛观 were next, about 2,000 m2 planned for 2016, with the stated aim of learning how imperial buildings were founded, which standing buildings cannot show.

title: Plate VIII: 方外观 Fangwai Guan
excerpt_other: Sous cet avant-corps est pratiqué un souterrain, dans lequel on pénètre par une porte, accompagnée à droite et à gauche d'une espèce d'œil de bœuf grillé;
summary_en: Small building on a terrace, three windows, rusticated pilasters at the ends. Under the projecting terrace a low room with a door and two grilled oeil-de-boeuf, thought to be for coolness. Round stairs at each end. On the left an open octagonal pavilion beyond a canal with a rich bridge.

title: Engraving 8: 方外观 Fangwai Guan
excerpt_other: From the sides of this building ostentatious circular stairways led downward from the second floor.
summary_en: Circular stairs at the sides from the second floor; bridge over the moat with carved marble scroll balustrades.

title: Plate IX: 五竹亭 Wuzhu Ting
excerpt_other: Cinq pavillons en bambou, posés en hémicycle, et ouverts de tous côtés, d'où l'on voit les jets d'eau.
summary_en: Five bamboo pavilions set in a half circle, open all round, joined by bamboo galleries. Our model has them in a row (Q15, Q35).

title: Engraving 9: 五竹亭 Wuzhu Ting
excerpt_other: It consisted of five pavilions in Chinese style connected by covered walks.
summary_en: Faced north towards 方外观. In Malone's time only two lotus pools, the fountain and the wall behind it were left (plate p.149).

title: Plate X: 海晏堂 Haiyan Tang, west, and the water clock
excerpt_other: Sur deux des côtés du triangle, sont placés douze animaux de différentes espèces, six de chaque côté.
summary_en: Ten bays with a central block and attic and end pavilions; a landing with two stairs, jets from vases along both ramps as at St Cloud and Versailles. A triangular basin; animals spout towards the centre; at the apex towards the building a rock group with a shell; the largest jet from a vase at the base; two pyramids at the sides. He says animals spout by hour count.

title: Plates XI to XIII: 海晏堂, other views
excerpt_other: Ce palais est rempli de jets d'eau, et son perron rappelle le palais de Caprarola, près de Viterbe en Italie.
summary_en: Weeping willows in the gardens of plate XI. Stair compared with Caprarola. Little else.

title: Engraving 10: 海晏堂 Haiyan Tang, west front and water clock
excerpt_other: There two broad staircases one swinging to the right and one to the left, met before the main entrance on the level of the second floor.
summary_en: Largest of the group; held Benoist's pumps and the main reservoir. Fifty small jets on the stair balustrades fed three basins. Twelve seated animal figures, one for each two-hour period, spouted in turn to a larger fountain in the pool. After Benoist's death the machinery failed and water was raised by buckets and ropes (Benoist 1786, Amiot 1787, per n.). Malone compares bronze figures in the Winter Palace, made later.

title: Engravings 11 to 13: 海晏堂 north, east and south
excerpt_other: The tallest parts of the building covered the hydraulic machines, and between them lay the reservoir.
summary_en: North front covers the machines, with the reservoir between; zigzag stairs at the east end lead to the reservoir; the south side repeats the north.

title: Informants on the ruins: Lu, Ho, Tung
excerpt_other: He says he was twelve sui, or ten or eleven years of age, and employed there as a helper to sweep the walks and pull the weeds, when the palace was destroyed in 1860.
summary_en: Old Lu lived in a hut at the east end of 海晏堂, the source of Malone's oral details on the European buildings. The eunuchs Ho and Tung, still there in 1919, told him what was rebuilt after 1860 and destroyed again in 1900. Treat as oral: useful, unverified.

title: 刘阳, 《圆明园的故事》, excerpt on 西洋楼, 澎湃
summary_en: 刘阳: 海晏堂, 1759, largest of the group; behind it the water tower, an H-plan solid building with a gallery below and balconies above, and a spiral stone stair on the east.

title: 海晏堂东水车房
locator: 国家图书馆善本部 样094-4号
summary_en: Undated ink base sheet of the east water-wheel house at Haiyan Tang, 503x453 mm. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

title: 海晏堂蓄水楼 加固, 北京青年报 via 人民网
summary_en: The surviving water tower of 海晏堂 is a rammed-earth core like an inverted truncated pyramid, about 7.2 m high. Conservation in 2016 propped the four corners with about 160,000 bricks and added a concealed drain on top.

title: 远瀛观歌
locator: v4 p.122, under 西洋楼; source ref 1-239
excerpt_zh: 宇宙两戒渤海环，九州罗列四大间。西洋伊古谁得到，贡琛向化趋朝班。彼英吉利一郡小，航海恭献天文表。圣皇怜彼远人诚，荒服心坚物微渺。连延崇阁仿重洋，凿沼引水机运详。曲折灌注互荡激，三伏三见脉络藏。不宝异物旅獒志，薄来厚往古籍识。九袠又喜聚梯航，图开王会共球备。
summary_en: Poem 远瀛观歌 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1797, filed by the editors under 西洋楼.

title: 远瀛观
locator: v4 p.123, under 西洋楼; source ref 1-386
excerpt_zh: 楼式仿西洋，圣皇声教彰。远瀛咸向化，绝域尽来王。可识天威畅，同霑惠泽长。大清超万古，继序凛无遑。
summary_en: Poem 远瀛观 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1798, filed by the editors under 西洋楼.

title: 远瀛观: 嘉庆三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆三年 (1798), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 引机运水石池注，溅玉喷珠万斛雄。敬识圣皇声教广，流沙西海尽同风。
summary_en: Jiaqing, 1798: machine-raised water fills a stone basin, with jets of spray: a dated witness that the fountains worked.

title: 远瀛观: 嘉庆七年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆七年 (1802), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 室仿西洋式，寸心括远瀛。仁恩全浃洽，遐迩庆升平。驭世思图大，宅中念守成。怀柔先立极，抚字凛持盈。永保丕基巩，诞敷考泽宠。化期周渤澥，六合奉皇清。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 远瀛观, 1802, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 远瀛观歌
locator: v4 p.124, under 西洋楼; source ref 2-264
excerpt_zh: 石级参差列珠树，玻璃为牖佳境布。八窗洞开引清风，翠屏紫凤萦香雾。一室澄观备远瀛，圣念包罗九有宏。瞻临堂构切抚字，凛乎驭朽弥持盈。
summary_en: Poem 远瀛观歌 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1803, filed by the editors under 西洋楼.

title: 远瀛观: 嘉庆十三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十三年 (1808), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 圣皇声教被远方，东踰使鹿西氐羌。咭唎国来梯航，岂珍异物鉴心臧。爰修石室包贡藏，擘窠三字昭龙光。远瀛观额聿辉煌，后昆永念帝泽洋。中安外靖奕禩康，勤政爱民勉自强。凛承宝命敢怠遑，不愆不忘由旧章。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 远瀛观, 1808. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 远瀛观: 嘉庆十九年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十九年 (1814), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh:
圣化敷海洋，远人会中土。咭唎来
朝，仿式建数宇。不宝贡物奇，题额深意取。持盈保泰衷，观此思安抚。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 远瀛观, 1814. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 远瀛观: 嘉庆二十一年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆二十一年 (1816), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 中国驭外域，崇德化远陬。异物奚足贵，奇珍不妄求。结构仿洋式，娱情偶来游。如披画图景，悦目意漫留。达士必超越，沾滞皆凡俦。子帷务实政，敦俗安嚣浡。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 远瀛观, 1816. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 远瀛观: 嘉庆二十一年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆二十一年 (1816), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 本无招致心，突来咭唎。既来复不驯，巧言多诈伪。未能成礼还，庸臣实偾事。瞻额衷惭惶，艰哉在上位。训诲竟敢违，要名又任意。用人诚冣难，题壁述予志。（前据两广督臣等奏称咭唎固使臣呈请前来朝贡，予以其远隔重洋输诚纳赆不可虗其归戴之忱，是以准令由天津每口登岸，并非有心招致之也。不意夷情狡诈，反复不驯。予先复命苏楞额和世泰等赴当赐宴，令其演礼，谆谕以如能行礼方准带领入京。乃苏楞额广惠既违训诲于前，和世泰穆克登额又复妄行于后，以致届期不能成礼。种种愤事皆由庸臣贻误，用人之难如此。兹来斯地瞻言旧额，抚衷实增私恧，题此以述予志焉）
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 远瀛观, 1816, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 远瀛观: 嘉庆二十三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆二十三年 (1818), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 驭远从来贵严肃，彼咭唎性难伏。每来先蓄图利心，宽则无忌肆贪黩。强悍不循中国仪，辱其主命宜驱逐。大君岂贵贡珍奇，所宝惟贤慎司牧。（抚驭远人理贵严肃，余诗所谓中国有威仪，岂可少贬损是也。彼咭唎使臣鄙野无知，贪黩强悍，又复不循礼仪，辱其主命，是以却彼贡献，逐令回国。盖为国以礼所宝，惟贤人君之道理当如是云尔）
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 远瀛观, 1818, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 远瀛观: 嘉庆二十四年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆二十四年 (1819), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 远瀛渺漠阻世尘，彼咭唎隔大秦。五万余里孰招致，占风航海通天津。既来倔强失礼节，未可觐见随班列。仍施厚赏命回帆，外域羁縻示不绝。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 远瀛观, 1819, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 远瀛观: 嘉庆二十五年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆二十五年 (1820), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 圣化海隅被，来朝恩泽覃。近年虽晋谒，仪节未详谙。厚往从京北，护归自粤南。远瀛示宽大，六合一心含。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 远瀛观, 1820, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 远瀛观: 道光三年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
date: 道光三年 (1823), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 久仰高皇御世模，远人向化德巍乎。海西琛赆昭王会，天外帆樯萃帝都。垂示不须珍异物，绥徕只为焕鸿图（孙臣）。继绪增兢惕勉，竭精勤守不渝（皇祖圣武，远扬尧天，广覆流沙，西海重译来王，于兹楼仿西洋见远瀛之向化，而引机运水，亦以征怀柔至德，泽被无垠。予小子景仰鸿图，勉思绳武，益助精勤之素志，无忘声教之诞敷云尔）。
summary_en: Daoguang, 1823: his note reads the Western-style tower and its machine-raised water as signs of imperial reach. The view is the emperor's own.

title: Plate XIV: 远瀛观 Yuanying Guan, built for the Gobelins
excerpt_other: Ce palais qui n'est pas fort élevé, et qui n'a qu'un rez-de-chaussée, est composé d'un corps principal, flanqué de deux pavillons en avant-corps.
summary_en: "Bâtiment construit pour placer les tapisseries des Gobelins." On a terrace reached by a round double-ramp stair, simpler than the others. One storey only.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 远瀛观
summary_en: Jiaqing's poem of 1798 describes machine-raised water filling a stone basin and jets of spray, a dated sign that the fountains still ran. His poems of 1816 and after use the hall to reflect on the British embassy; a Daoguang note of 1823 reads the Western-style tower and its machine-raised water as signs of imperial reach. 远瀛观: 10 dated items, 1798-1823, of which 10 poems (Jiaqing, Daoguang); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1798, last dated 1823.

title: Engraving 14: 远瀛观 Yuanying Guan
excerpt_other: This large gray brick building was lavishly decorated with carved white marble around the doors and windows and with two elaborately and intricately carved marble pillars before the main door.
summary_en: On a terrace projecting north beyond the line of the park wall; faced the Great Fountains. Plate p.154: one pillar fallen.

title: 远瀛观总平面图 (图名: 远瀛观地盘样)
locator: 国家图书馆善本部 none shown
summary_en: Undated ground plan of Yuanying Guan; the record shows no shelf number. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

title: 远瀛观装修平面图
locator: 国家图书馆善本部 none shown
summary_en: Undated plan of Yuanying Guan's fittings; the extract shows no shelf number. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

title: 远瀛观遗址考古发掘简报, 北京市文物研究所
summary_en: Salvage dig for conservation of the ruin, 800 m2: main hall, storehouses behind, roads and wall footings, three early and late building phases, and many glazed fittings. The hall stood on a high platform, brick and stone with a glazed roof, its plan an inverted U. The text dates the hall later than 大水法 and 观水法 to its south.

title: Plate XV: 大水法 Da Shuifa
excerpt_other: au milieu duquel est un cerf en pied, dont le bois lance de l'eau par chacun de ses andouillers:
summary_en: Two high water pyramids. A mask at the top of the central piece fills a shell basin, then six basins in cascade, then a large basin with a stag whose antlers spout, hounds spouting at it from both sides.

title: Engraving 15: 大水法 Da Shuifa
excerpt_other: On the right and left stood excessively tall pyramidal fountains surrounded by numerous small jets.
summary_en: Two tall pyramids with small jets; a pool in the middle where jets played on animals, birds and fish, before the carved terrace of 远瀛观. Plate p.156: ruins in 1924.

title: Plates XVI to XIX: 观水法, 线法山门, 线法山, 螺蛳牌楼
excerpt_other: Montagne factice sur laquelle il y a un Ting-tsé,
summary_en: XVI throne facing the jets. XVII triumphal arch, the most Greek. XVIII an artificial hill with a 亭 on top. XIX another triumphal arch, less sober.

title: Engraving 16: 观水法 Guan Shuifa
excerpt_other: carved marble pannels representing European swords, spears, armor, drums, flags, cannon, and other arms.
summary_en: Throne with a canopy and a brick screen with five marble panels of European arms. Clipped hedges with two gateways right and left. The Jesuits compared it with the water buffets of Versailles and St Cloud.

title: Engraving 18: 线法山 Xianfa Shan
excerpt_other: Regularly intersecting circular paths led up to the pavilion on the top of this circular hill,
summary_en: Circular hill, intersecting circular paths, pavilion on top. Lu says the emperor rode up on horseback. N.20: 线法 means line method, perhaps the Jesuits' perspective.

title: Engraving 17: 线法山门 Xianfa Shan gate
excerpt_other: A triple gateway, resembling a European triumphal arch.
summary_en: Triple gateway like a triumphal arch.

title: Engraving 19: 线法山东门 / 螺蛳牌楼
excerpt_other: was a peculiar gateway of three arches with both side passages leading through side rooms, and with decorations of vine-like trees carved even over the faces of the pillars on the outside of the building.
summary_en: Three-arched gate, side passages through side rooms, carved vine ornament on the pillars.

title: Plate XX: 线法墙 Xianfa Qiang and 方河 Fanghe
excerpt_other: Il faut remarquer à l'entrée de la rue, les deux grandes portes placées sur le premier plan.
summary_en: The east end of the ground; two rows of houses forming a street, leading the eye to far mountains, cut off from the park by a wide water; two rustic Tuscan gates in the foreground. Called fit for a stage set.

title: Engraving 20: 线法墙 Xianfa Qiang (湖东线法画) and 方河 Fanghe
excerpt_other: To produce an illusion of distance by means of the European idea of perspective with a single central vanishing point houses were partly modeled and partly painted on walls, five on each side, set like the wings of a stage,
summary_en: A European town seen across a lake: five walls a side narrowing towards the back, with a city wall and mountains painted on the back wall. Plate p.159: the ruin of those walls. Note Q35 has six a side.

title: 线法墙平面图 (图名: 线法墙地样)
locator: 国家图书馆善本部 none shown
summary_en: Plan of the perspective walls, known from the 1933 Bulletin of the National Library of Peiping, original title 线法墙地样; the record gives no shelf number. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

title: 正大光明: 乾隆八年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆八年 (1743), date from the compilation
locator: p.29 item (10), under 正大光明
excerpt_zh: 筲三簸用精，圆融如意粒。甜滑自然秔，体借蟾蜍魄。竒传沆瀣英，常留春日意。恰称令宵名，的的星丸皎。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 正大光明, 1743, on banquets. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 御製正大光明殿詩（圓明園四十景詩）
excerpt_zh:
乾隆九年 御製正大光明殿詩
園南出入賢良門内為正衙不雕不繪得松軒茅殿意屋後峭石壁立玉筍嶙峋前庭虚敞四望牆外林木隂湛花時霏紅叠紫層暎無際
勝地同靈囿遺規繼暢春當年成不日奕代永居辰義府庭羅璧恩波水㵼銀草青思示儉山靜體依仁只可方衢室何湏道玉津經營懲峻宇出入引賢臣（出入賢良門扁額皇考御筆也）洞逹心常豁清凉境絶塵每移雲館蹕未費地官緡生意榮芳樹天機躍錦鱗肯堂彌厪念俯仰惕心頻
summary_en: The formal audience hall, inside 出入賢良門. Qianlong stresses it is uncarved and unpainted, like a pine-and-thatch hall. Tall rock stands behind it, the forecourt is open, and flowering trees beyond the walls fill the view.

title: 正大光明: 乾隆十三年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆十三年 (1748), date from the compilation
locator: p.31 item (25), under 正大光明
excerpt_zh: 青韶琼苑景，嫩日拂庐晨（每宴外藩武备院设武帐示优渥之意）。我有来朝客，群称守土臣。雕筵湑湛露，令节启光春。既许欢心洽，还遵礼数彬。鹓班陪济济，鹭羽乐振振。内外需和会，宗功逮后人。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 正大光明, 1748, on banquets. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 正大光明: 乾隆十三年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆十三年 (1748), date from the compilation
locator: p.32 item (28), under 正大光明
excerpt_zh: 载阳迟景荡晴空，雪色冰纹暖渐融。依旧东风来上苑，偶因佳节忆琳宫（燕九始于邱处机，都下长春宫至今为胜会焉）。流风遗俗追寻处，去岁今年想象中。只有烟花还恋赏，晩来强作耐时红（都下灯火自上元至燕九为盛，过此则皆收矣） 。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 正大光明, 1748, on the view and lanterns and fireworks. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 御製前湖詩
excerpt_zh: 乾隆二十八年御製前湖詩　御園之前本無湖而今疏濬胡稱乎石衢之右地下濕邇年遭潦水占諸衢左亦不大高衍徃來車馬愁泥塗因卑為澤事惟半取右益左功倍俱歉嵗受僱兼代賑三冬畚鍤集衆徒役成春水有所受路東濘去誠坦途一舉三得惠不費對敭來者咸歡娛蓋聞王者無私事有事皆應史筆書此非綴景漫修剔什用播告賢與愚
summary_en: Explains that no lake originally lay before the gate; low ground west of the road flooded, so in a famine-relief works earth was moved east to raise the road and the hollow became a lake.

title: 日下舊聞考 正大光明
excerpt_zh: 大宫門前輦道東西皆有湖是為前湖（圓明園冊）臣等謹按前湖西岸有石刻御製前湖詩
summary_en: The lake called 前湖 Front Lake lies east and west of the carriage road before the main gate; the compilers record a stone-cut poem on its west bank.

title: 日下舊聞考 正大光明
excerpt_zh: 大宫門内為出入賢良門五楹門左右為直房前跨石橋度橋東西朝房各五楹西南為茶膳房再西為繙書房東南為清茶房為軍機處（圓明園冊）臣等謹按出入賢良門額世宗御書是為二宫門凡武職侍衛引見御此門較射左右直房為各部院臣工入直之所東西設兩罩門各衙門奏事由東罩門逓進茶膳房太監人等由西罩門出入門前河形如月中駕石橋三其水自西來東注如意門閘口㑹東園各河而出出入賢良門内為正大光明殿七楹東西配殿各五楹後為壽山殿東為洞明堂（圓明園冊）臣等謹按圓明園四十景中世宗御題四字額者凡十有四正大光明殿其一也餘如牡丹臺今為鏤月開雲蓬萊洲今為蓬島瑶臺乃乾隆九年皇上恭依避暑山莊三十六景四字題額之例更鍚嘉名用昭畫一敬就各條下加按並恭載御製四十景詩至附近各景詩已載御製詩全集者兹不備録又按正大光明殿内聨曰心天之心而宵衣旰食樂民之樂以和性怡情為世宗御書又聨曰遹求寜觀成無逺弗届以對時育物有那其居為皇上御書東壁懸御書周書無逸篇西壁懸豳風圖東為洞明堂世宗御書額
summary_en: Through the five-bay 出入賢良門, the second gate with duty rooms and three stone bridges over a moon-shaped canal, are court offices, kitchens, the translation office and the 軍機處 Grand Council. Then 正大光明殿 of seven bays with five-bay side halls, 壽山殿 behind and 洞明堂 to the east. The notes explain the renaming of the fourteen Yongzheng titles under the 1744 four-character scheme, and record the couplets, the 無逸 text on the east wall and the 豳風 picture on the west wall.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 正大光明
locator: from p.27, under 正大光明
summary_en: The main audience hall: New Year banquets for Mongol and other princes, examinations of officials, weddings of princesses and birthday rites, with the Macartney gifts recorded in 1793 and the last banquet in the first month of 1860. 正大光明: 447 dated items, 1727-1860, of which 215 poems and 232 court records (Yongzheng, Qianlong, Jiaqing, Daoguang, Xianfeng); recurring themes: banquets, lanterns and fireworks, state papers. First dated 1727, last dated 1860.

title: Attiret: the emperor's residence
excerpt_other: This Palace for the usual Residence of the Emperor is just within the grand Gate of the Pleasure-ground. First are the Ante-chambers; then, the Halls for Audience: and then, the Courts, and Gardens belonging to them. The Whole forms an Island; which is entirely surrounded by a large and deep Canal.
summary_en: As big as the town of Dole. Audience halls, then courts and gardens, on an island within a deep canal. S02 p.136 n. takes the description of the rooms to mean scene 3.

title: Barrow: lodging near the hall, and how little he saw
excerpt_other: Even in the short distance between the hall of audience and our lodgings, which might be about three hundred paces, we were continually watched.
summary_en: Lodging about 200 yards from the hall, with bare walls. Claims the grounds reach ten English miles across, or sixty thousand acres, partly waste and woodland; far above the plan.

title: Six paintings, IV: an entrance compound, probably 正大光明
excerpt_other: On distingue l'entrée principale, précédée de deux pavillons, probablement destinés aux gardiens de cette entrée.
summary_en: A bridge over a walled canal to a range with two wings, a large paved court, the main isolated block joined by two galleries to side pavilions, side courts. Fits the audience compounds; 正大光明 or 勤政亲贤 unproven.

title: Varin: second and third throne halls
excerpt_other: On arriva, ensuite, devant un lac artificiel entouré de rochers et de montagnes rapportés, lequel était côtoyé par une route sablée ; on traversa un pont jeté sur le canal d'alimentation de ce lac, et on se retrouva dans une troisième salle du trône,
summary_en: A second, smaller and more elegant throne hall behind the first, then the lake and the third. Behind it salons; on the right the store of furs and robes, ahead the emperor's rooms, on the left the empress's. Varin's second hall lies before the lake, unlike Swinhoe's sequence.

title: Barrow in the garden, 1793 (quoted by Malone)
excerpt_other: The very dwelling of the Emperor and the grand hall in which he gives audience, when divested of the gilding and the gaudy colors with which they are daubed, are little superior and much less solid, than the barns of a substantial English farmer.
summary_en: Barrow, lodged about 200 yards from the hall and closely watched, saw only the part near it. Surface compared to Richmond Park, with canals and lakes, irregular banks and rock headlands. He heard of thirty residences. The presents stood before the throne. The birthday ceremony of 17 September with cups of tea, oil and rice on three tripods (Barrow p.116).

title: Later uses of the Main Audience Hall: Dutch embassy 1795, camp in 1860
excerpt_other: Apparently this hall was also used as camp by the British soldiers who burned the Yuan Ming Yuan in 1860 and was the last place to which they set fire.
summary_en: Dutch embassy ceremony of 3 February 1795 (Van Braam). British troops camped at the hall in 1860 and burned it last (M'Ghee pp.283-89, cited by Malone). Malone also reports that Gordon bought an imperial throne, not proven to be from this hall.

title: Macartney on the Presence Chamber, 1793 (quoted by Malone from Robbins)
excerpt_other: It is one hundred and fifty feet long and sixty feet wide; there are windows on one side only, and opposite to them is the Imperial Throne of carved mahogany, the logs of which were brought from England, and elevated by a few steps from the floor.
summary_en: Macartney's journal for 1793 as quoted by Malone: hall 150 x 60 ft (his estimate), windows on one side, throne facing them, chequered grey and white marble floor with mats, a musical clock by George Clarke of Leadenhall Street. Chosen for setting up the presents. Malone's n.24: the wood was probably Chinese redwood, not English. Note 22: Staunton puts the inside height above 20 ft.

title: Scene 1, 正大光明 Zhengda Guangming: courts, gate, moat and hall
excerpt_other: This Second Gate of the Palace led into the courtyard where the Main Audience Hall stood on a foundation 129 feet long, 63 feet wide, and 4 feet high, ascended by three sets of stone steps. It was a building of seven chien besides having a porch all around the outside, formed by an outer row of columns supporting the projecting eaves, so that the facade presented a colonnade of ten columns.
summary_en: Malone measured the site. Foundation 129 x 63 x 4 ft, three stairs, seven bays plus a surrounding porch, ten columns across the front, round column bases 2 ft 9 in across, floor of veined marble slabs on brick and lime. Plain under Yongzheng in 1725; before the end of Qianlong's reign columns red, capitals with dragons, gilt wire over the entablature. Pines and a rockery hill behind, a covered passage to the east.

title: Droiture et Clarté, Che Bing Chiu
locator: Studies in the History of Gardens 19, 364-375
summary_en: Article on the 正大光明 scene; the same author's 2000 book covers the whole garden. Citation only.

title: Site status table, about 2011: nothing visible, or built over
summary_en: Same table. In it the first group shows no visible remains; 得全阁, 流香渚, 凤麟洲, 涵秋馆, 蔚藻堂, 中和堂, 敷春堂 and 心镜轩 have service buildings on them, and 含晖楼, 澄心堂, 延寿寺, 清夏堂 and 喜雨山房 are occupied by other institutions. 澹泊宁静 and several others have been dug since, so this is out of date for them.

title: 圆明园中的正大光明殿 (单志刚)
summary_en: Traces the phrase to 朱熹 and notes four such plaques in Qing palaces, this one by Yongzheng. Reads the layout from the 1744 album: stepped galleries east of the hall, 寿山 behind; it says 日下旧闻考's 寿山殿 is an error.

title: 圆明园正大光明初探
summary_en: The whole front court district, built 1725, 370 x 310 m. 大宫门 and 出入贤良门 are five-bay gate halls with 卷棚歇山 roofs on the garden's south wall line. 正大光明殿: seven bays by three, all-round gallery, single eave, grey tile, high base, 36.45 x 16 m, with a terrace and four incense burners. Stresses its garden-like, less formal planning.

title: 论清代圆明园军机处 (何瑜)
summary_en: 何瑜 reviews the rival dates for the founding of the Grand Council and argues it began in spring 1729 and, by location, in 圆明园 itself, for the western campaign.

title: 《国家图书馆藏样式雷图档·圆明园卷初编》: 正大光明
date: mostly 道光, 咸丰, 同治 per the publisher
locator: 初编 目录: 正大光明, pp.13-31
summary_en: The printed facsimile of the National Library of China's Yangshi Lei sheets has a section on this place at pp.13-31 (19 pages, section length worked out from the next heading); sheet titles and numbers are in the volume, ordered from a library.

title: 正大光明殿平面图 (图名: 正大光明白差准底)
locator: 国家图书馆善本部 样001-4号
summary_en: Undated interior plan of the audience hall in ink, 520x210 mm, showing the throne canopy, splayed walls and bookcases. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

title: 正大光明区域考古勘探报告
locator: mhymy 档案史料 12324, free part
summary_en: Report's opening describes three successive courts from 大宫门 to 正大光明殿, 370 m north-south and 310 m east-west between the 如意门 gates, 114,700 m2 of site and 7,000 m2 of buildings, begun 1725. Gate hall of five bays on a base 21.57 x 11.33 m, 0.77 m high; screen wall 41.6 m long, 204.8 m south of the gate terrace.

title: 出入贤良门前射布靶三弟获中四支诗以志贺（233）
excerpt_zh: 四鍭叠中技超然，校射承欢禁籞前。早是精娴邀宠渥，都缘审固用工专。高标有裕欣连袂，同学无能媿比肩。自此更应增勉励，莫教一篑少攻研。
summary_en: Poem 出入贤良门前射布靶三弟获中四支诗以志贺（233） by the Qianlong Emperor, 1788, filed by the editors under 春熙院.

title: 日下舊聞考: 军机处
excerpt_zh: (二宮門外)東南為清茶房為軍機處

title: 養吉齋叢錄 卷四
locator: 卷四, line 250 of the corpus file
excerpt_zh: 圆明园章京直庐，一在挂甲屯，一在冰窖。
summary_en: Grand Council secretaries of the garden had two lodgings outside it, at 掛甲屯 and 冰窖.

title: 養吉齋叢錄 卷九
locator: 卷九, line 583 of the corpus file
excerpt_zh: 宗室乡、会试，中式后在正大光明殿覆试，自嘉庆十九年始。其试用一文一诗。
summary_en: From 嘉慶十九年 (1814) clansmen's examinations were re-checked in 正大光明殿.

title: 養吉齋叢錄 卷九
locator: 卷九, line 584 of the corpus file
excerpt_zh: 新进士向在干清官覆试。嘉庆六年后，改于保和殿。道光二十四年后，皆在圆明园正大光明殿，惟三十年在保和殿覆试，以圣驾在宫中也。咸丰辛亥[一]后，皆在保和殿。
summary_en: Palace re-examination of new graduates was held in 正大光明殿 from 道光二十四年 (1844), and moved to 保和殿 in 咸豐辛亥 (1851). A dated use in the later reign.

title: 養吉齋叢錄 卷十
locator: 卷十, line 617 of the corpus file
excerpt_zh: 圣祖驻跸阳春园时，则于隋车居散馆。世宗驻跸圆明园，则于吏部朝房散馆。至高宗时，命于正大光明殿散馆。今则在保和殿矣。圣祖于散馆时，每先引见。近时则大臣阅卷进呈，亲定等第，越日 [一]「吴拔」原误作「吴鼐」 ,据初稿本改。
summary_en: Hanlin leaving examinations: at the 吏部 office in the garden under Yongzheng and in 正大光明殿 under Qianlong.

title: 養吉齋叢錄 卷十五
locator: 卷十五, line 1032 of the corpus file
excerpt_zh: 上元正大光明殿筵宴，观庆隆舞，状八旗士马射猎破阵。旁列伶工，唱清字歌曲，皆陈王业艰难，与武始北出，再成而南之义相似。其曲译汉者，具载会典，甚古雅。
summary_en: The Lantern Festival banquet at 正大光明殿 with the 慶隆舞, a dance of Eight Banner riders in the hunt.

title: Barrow: 正大光明殿 described and measured
excerpt_other: The length of this room within was one hundred and ten feet, breadth forty-two, and height twenty feet: the ceiling painted with circles, squares, and polygons, whimsically disposed, and loaded with a great variety of colours. The floor was paved with grey marble flag stones laid chequer-wise.
summary_en: Granite platform about 4 ft high. Two rows of wooden columns; brick to about 4 ft between the inner ones, oiled-paper lattice above, opening entirely on public occasions. No capitals. Painted frieze in blue, red, green and gilt under wire netting against birds. Red-painted pillars at the throne recess, throne carved of wood like mahogany. Furniture: brass kettle drums, two large paintings, two pairs of blue vases, an old Clarke clock. A fine brick wall round the flower garden.

title: Hérisson: the throne hall, low trust
excerpt_other: Le toit est couvert de ces tuiles jaunes vernissées qu'on fabrique dans la petite ville où nous avons couché hier.
summary_en: Seven polished granite steps, two rows of ironwood columns carved with scenes, yellow glazed tile with green edges and green faience dragons at the corners. S02 p.185 n. calls him the least reliable. Other witnesses mention no carved columns. Keep only as a claim.

title: M'Ghee: burning of the audience hall, 19 October
excerpt_other: and all that now remained was the Hall of Audience already described, and the lodges and buildings between that and the grand entrance ; they were spared to the last, as in them the troops had been quartered.
summary_en: 60th Rifles and the Punjabis had burned far and wide. About three o'clock the hall was set alight, the roof fell in, then the gate and lodges. Pages 285-287 describe a palace among hills eight or nine miles off, also burned: outside this project, probably 静宜园.

title: M'Ghee: 正大光明殿 inside
excerpt_other: A large and most elaborate plan of the Palace Gardens nearly covered the wall at one end of the room.
summary_en: Separate building, length about 120 ft, breadth about 80 (his estimate). Doors on the gate side and on the imperial side behind. An enormous enamel bowl at each end. Dais with three steps about half way down one side, chair of dark carved wood. Deeply carved wooden ceiling. A passage behind between the hall and a large rockery.

title: Swinhoe: picture of the grounds
excerpt_other: The left side of the room was covered with one extensive picture, representing the grounds of the Summer Palace.
summary_en: Throne floor with a light red cloth, three low series of steps, the central one widest. Side tables with books in yellow silk.

title: Wolseley: painting of the gardens on the wall of the hall
excerpt_other: An immense painting covered the upper portion of the wall upon the left hand as we entered ; it was a representation of the summer palaces and surrounding gardens done in isometrical projection,
summary_en: Floor of polished marble in closely fitted geometric pieces. The picture is confirmed by Swinhoe p.295, M'Ghee p.204 and Varin p.233.

title: Wolseley: the throne
excerpt_other: To leave the hall and get into the gardens, you passed out behind a screen at the back of the throne.
summary_en: Rosewood throne on a platform about 18 in. high, carved open balustrade, a pole screen of blue enamel and peacock feathers each side, tables with enamels and china, French clocks, the year's decrees and classics piled by.

title: Wolseley: 正大光明殿 outside
excerpt_other: A neatly finished wire network was stretched along under the wood carvings of the roof eaves
summary_en: Long flagged court, the hall at the far side, carving, gilding and paint fresh, tile in perfect order. Same wire net as Barrow, Malone and Swinhoe report.

title: 養吉齋叢錄 卷六
locator: 卷六, line 350 of the corpus file
excerpt_zh: 按：曩时勾到之地，宫内在懋勤殿，圆明园在洞明堂，香山在勤政殿后、致远斋之东、正直和平楼下，避暑山庄在依清旷。国有大庆则停勾。康熙二十三年，以岁逢甲子停勾。乾隆九年、嘉庆九年，亦以甲子停勾。此开甲之初，特施霈泽也。
summary_en: Capital sentences were reviewed in 洞明堂 when the court was in the garden.

title: 日下舊聞考: 寿山
excerpt_zh: 屋後峭石壁立玉筍嶙峋

title: M'Ghee: the water before the imperial apartments
excerpt_other: and on the opposite side of this miniature lake stood the imperial apartments, entered by none save members of the imperial family.
summary_en: From the passage turning left and to the front, a small lake with rockeries, bridged at each end, and the apartments beyond. To the right of the passage courtyards full of stores.

title: Swinhoe: from the hall to the emperor's rooms
excerpt_other: Behind the grand hall was rockery, and in rear of that again a large pond, so that a pebbled path leading over a bridge and taking a semicircular sweep of half the water, had to be traversed before you visited the next hall.
summary_en: About 500 yards to a smaller hall with images of Buddha in rooms each side, then another reception hall and a third, and on the left the emperor's own rooms: one moderate room with a double-seated throne, chandelier, clocks; passage to two small rooms and a spiral stair to two upper rooms with books, whose windows look down into the hall; two retiring rooms and the bedroom. The 1858 treaty lay on a table. This fits the axis 圆明园殿, 奉三无私, 九洲清晏; the ids are my reading.

title: Wolseley: from the hall to the private apartments
excerpt_other: the walk opened out upon a tolerably sized pond, on the further side of which were the private apartments of his Majesty, surrounded by the houses of his many wives, concubines, eunuchs, and servants.
summary_en: Walks between high planted mounds behind the hall, stone benches and rock piles, dwarf trees, rustic bridges and steps, then the pond. Wardrobes of silk and fur, jade in chests. Small armed junks on the ponds for shows watched from a tea-house (p.237).

title: 御製勤政親賢詩（圓明園四十景詩）
excerpt_zh:
乾隆九年 御製勤政親賢詩
正大光明殿之東為勤政殿日於此披省章奏召對臣工亭午始退座後屏風書無逸以自朂又東為保合太和秀石名葩庭軒明敞觀閣相交林徑四逹
庭訓昭雲日欽承切式刑勅幾宵豈暇籲俊刻靡寜一念徴䝉聖羣言辨渭涇乾乾終始志無逸近書屏
summary_en: East of the audience hall stands 勤政殿, where he read memorials and saw officials until noon, with 無逸 written on the screen behind the seat. Further east is 保合太和, among rocks, flowers, bright courts and linked pavilions.

title: 静鉴室: 乾隆二十三年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十三年 (1758), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 一窗涵万象，十笏玩三余。不拟刘君室，还思周子书。摅情常课有，飬志欲冲虚。设以衡材论，返观祗慊如。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 静鉴室, 1758. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 勤政殿: 乾隆二十四年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十四年 (1759), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh:
奎题高掲
盖我皇考取鲁论，为君难语御书箴座者也。由一言兴道之几，见千圣传心之要。于以对扬榘训黙契，清衷视子玉铭。系有恒藴古篇，呈大宝瞠乎后矣。其奚足云爰凭乙夜，书绅敬藉五言缀简。宣尼著明训曾未试躬行身体，惟皇考手书示后生，絶胜铭几杖讵止。见墙羮辞约义，赅富思艰，图易亨勅。几所无逸保泰凛持盈，三字垂家法，万年奉永清。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 勤政殿, 1759, on state papers. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 御製賦得為君難六韻
excerpt_zh: 乾隆二十四年御製賦得為君難六韻　圓明園勤政殿後楹奎題高揭蓋我皇考取魯論為君難語御書箴座者也由一言興道之幾見千聖傳心之要於以對揚榘訓黙契清衷視子玉銘系有恒藴古篇呈大寳瞠乎後矣其奚足云爰憑乙夜書紳敬藉五言綴簡　宣尼著明訓曽未試躬行身體惟皇考手書示後生絶勝銘几杖詎止見牆羮辭約義賅富思艱圖易亨勅幾所無逸保㤗凛持盈三字垂家法萬年奉永清
summary_en: Six-rhyme poem on the plaque 為君難 at the rear of 勤政殿, which Yongzheng took from the 論語 and hung over his seat.

title: 芳碧丛: 乾隆二十四年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十四年 (1759), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 玲珑湖石逻㠝岏，视之茗邈即之闲。锦绣舒芳葩几簇，琅玕摇碧筠千竿。碧筠诘曲中得路，芳葩如屏后庭护。文轩五架虚且明，夏晓延凉咨政处。延凉缅想歌南薫，阜财解愠厪万民。每多旱甚盼雨候，亦有霖恒望霁辰。望霁较可盼雨必，一岁舒眉能几日。咄哉前言戏之耳，合是先忧凛无逸。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 芳碧丛, 1759, on state papers and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 飞云轩: 乾隆二十四年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十四年 (1759), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 高轩疎朗似飞云，无意书题著桂棼。却几烟花悦曾我，祗饶宵旰惕为君。即今正厌终风盛，镇日空愁散霭纷。云尔飞来慢飞去，闷増剧欲易其文。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 飞云轩, 1759. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 富春楼: 乾隆二十五年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十五年 (1760), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 园楼久额富春名，曾未题诗太懒生。拾级试观泰元德，拈毫敢忘体乾情。虽然红紫迟酣放，要识机关在始萌。色色形形从此鬯，凭栏次第待闲评。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 富春楼, 1760. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 飞云轩: 乾隆二十六年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十六年 (1761), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 春冀英英作势浓，秋希敛尽不遗踪。坐轩棘欲云飞去，轩笑不知何所从。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 飞云轩, 1761. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 静鉴室: 乾隆二十八年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十八年 (1763), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 鉴以照为德，更以静为用。惟其物不示，是故形随贡。既无妍丑见，亦免爱憎中。题室拟铭盘，甄心企空洞。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 静鉴室, 1763. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 无倦斋: 乾隆三十五年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十五年 (1770), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 先之更继以劳之，请教曰当无倦。为乾象正符不息义讵，惟姑使自深思。（末句反程子注语意即胡氏所云勇者，喜于有为而不能持久，亦未为契旨也。）
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 无倦斋, 1770. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 富春楼: 乾隆五十四年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆五十四年 (1789), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 保合太和（殿名）后，富春层有楼。顾名思义久，点笔著词酬， （是楼建于乾隆三年，至二十五年才一题句，兹阅三十年始再有诗，亦可谓疎矣）岂诩花木景，惟先民物忧。庶几守初志，永保万年庥。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 富春楼, 1789. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 怀清芬: 乾隆五十七年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆五十七年 (1792), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh:
经史清芬一室如，额题略已卌年余。春秋倐忽八旬逮，祝颂缤纷四得誉。论著两编申已愧， （前岁八旬万寿群臣献词颂者不可偻计，因著四得论，四得续论以为禄位，名寿胥因德而得之，予之得此四者乃荷天地黙佑祖宗延禧，非德之所致，岂肯蕼然自居方且引以为愧耳。）言殊累牍似他虚。即今不息强増昔，（计至归政之期尚有三年，兢业之
心不敢少懈，即昨年廓尔喀侵扰后蔵一事，早夜筹划尚觉精力堪副，惟有益加惕励，庶不负羲经自强不息之意云尔。）归政方称未负书。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 怀清芬, 1792. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 富春楼: 乾隆五十九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆五十九年 (1794), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 富春额署五旬年，（是楼在镂月开云之前，乾隆甲子始题此额，至今已五十年矣。）每欲题词輙忸然。物阜民安方谓可，衣丰食足倍怀牵。惭今盈六故吾耳，抚此初韶仍尔焉。诗匣懋勤排岁奉，（近年九月杪，自御园进宫，后因三冬多暇，命懋勤殿翰林等将次年新春所游咏之处，自大内及宁寿宫西苑并圆明园、万寿山、玉泉山各等处，酌检若干题，每日乘暇豫作数首。至开韶庆节宴赏频蕃，颇不得暇，即偶有所作，可以从容涉笔，亦凡事豫则立之意也。计甲寅、乙卯两年，尚须依例作之，逮丙辰归政后，吟兴偶至，即可随意所便，不必仍沿此例矣。）踟蹰未免懒摅笺。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 富春楼, 1794. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 无倦斋: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 六旬周甲丙辰春，天佑幸为符愿身。敢曰倦勤无事者，劳劳望捷正愁人。（去岁斋中口号有深慕天恩或符愿明年，即作倦勤人之句。今岁虽已传位，而子皇帝践阼之始，用人行政尚须训示。予幸精神强固，每日披览庶政不至倦勤，且楚南逆首石三保、石柳邓势已穷蹙，擒获在即，而捷报尚未奏到，盼望殷殷亦正劳念。）
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 无倦斋, 1796, on state papers. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 无倦斋: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 昨年七字谓明春，（去年题是斋诗，有明年即作倦勤人之句。）明忽为今倏至身。天锡倦勤亶符愿，仍勤敢倦作闲人。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 无倦斋, 1796, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 竹林清响: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation
locator: p.110 item (1), under 竹林清响
excerpt_zh: 万个筼筜罨翠深，七贤物外漫招寻。窗前清响凉飔送，日日平安报好音。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 竹林清响, 1796, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 后天不老: 嘉庆二年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆二年 (1797), date from the compilation
locator: p.111 item (1), under 后天不老
excerpt_zh: 昔日弦歌地，重来已来年。随兄怀雅训，勖弟勉成贤。师友三天聚，（御园皇子读书处前层檐额曰：“前垂天贶中层”。额曰：“中天景物后”。层额曰：“后天不老
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 后天不老, 1797, on reading and remembering his forebears. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 怀清芬: 嘉庆二年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆二年 (1797), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 四壁满图书，清芬素所慕。兴废鉴古人，千载恍相遇。政迹有本原，圣贤深意具。揽要探心傅，岂徒诵章句。辅德殷鉴存，无逸周书布。临民实艰哉，朽索渊冰惧。知难非空言，敕几谨尺度。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 怀清芬, 1797, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 竹林清响: 嘉庆二年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆二年 (1797), date from the compilation
locator: p.110 item (2), under 竹林清响
excerpt_zh: 浮筠绕亭榭，渐觉碧云深。烟羃筼筜色，风吹箫管音。吟怀千亩迹，思入五弦琴。晤坐聆清响，七贤忆竹林。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 竹林清响, 1797, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 怀清芬: 嘉庆三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆三年 (1798), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 清芬在古籍，披玩畅襟怀。圣学诚无际，文津漫得涯。琢磨惜阴速，探讨与时皆。仰止还思慕，游心艺苑佳。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 怀清芬, 1798, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 勤政殿: 嘉庆六年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆六年 (1801), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 三载日聆皇考训，悲含孺慕独临轩。心忧民瘼慈恩重，额仰君难祖泽存。（殿内恭悬皇祖御书为君难扁额，并皇考御书跋语横幅。）嘉树铺阴感风木，素楹示俭念先言。于斯听政仍如昔，勉继前猷永弗谖。（皇考御宇六十余年临幸御园时接见臣工，披览章奏措施诸大政皆御此殿，予寅承大宝日于此敬聆圣训。兹听政临轩追慕情何能巳，惟以顾名思义凛守前猷，弗敢暇逸为兢兢尔。）
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 勤政殿, 1801, on state papers. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 生秋庭: 嘉庆六年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆六年 (1801), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 经时溽暑望秋生，风爽天澄灏气清。指日嘉音至御苑，民安稍慰旰宵萦。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 生秋庭, 1801, on escaping the heat. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 飞云轩: 嘉庆九年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆九年 (1804), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 风漾平林木叶挥，仰瞻玉宇白云飞。沙汀飏影鸿余迹，石洞团香菊吐菲。省岁难期皆有岁，授衣更悯咏无衣。轩邻勤政咨诹切，宥密单心理万几。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 飞云轩, 1804. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 芳碧丛: 嘉庆十二年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十二年 (1807), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 圣制超品汇，竹春不知秋。和章承笔削，铭泐永率由。（乾隆甲辰春皇考六巡江浙，恭扈銮舆命和游龙井诗，当蒙于乙览之次。亲御丹毫为改十字曰泉雷忽疑雨，竹春不知秋，诗情物理曲尽灵区之妙。予今操觚托咏，悉本当年诗教之源。兹地丝筠参碧，阅岁滋深，抚景兴怀不觉，忆趋庭而述往事云。）庭前益繁茂，猗猗绿筱稠。夙沐化雨润，浮筠岁月修。劲节挺烟雾，清音戛琳球。静对有斐泽，缅怀贤哲俦。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 芳碧丛, 1807, on state papers and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 三友轩: 嘉庆十三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十三年 (1808), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 奇石嵯峨磴道连，日亲三友蜃窗前。松坚竹劲梅清洁，物外忘形几岁年。或咏诗词或写生，总由幻想结同盟。予心自有真三益，惟敬惟勤惟致诚。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 三友轩, 1808, on state papers. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 勤政殿: 道光三年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
date: 道光三年 (1823), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 为政先探本，承恩念在勤。箴言钦可法，忠告想多闻。（我皇祖于理事正殿皆颜勤政，皇考圣制勤政箴有曰，为政在勤，勤则不匮。又曰亮采寅清，竭忠尽智，探本之论允足垂法万禩。）问夜常虞晏，瞻楹每惜分。一诚诚不巳，贵实屏虚文。 （勤政之道本乎存诚，存诚之功征于不息，予小子绍闻衣德崇实黜浮，兹于三月三日御勤政殿听政，瞻仰云楣倍深，惟日孜孜之意焉。 ）
summary_en: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 勤政殿, 1823, on state papers. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 芳碧丛: 道光三年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
date: 道光三年 (1823), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh:
虚榭宽闲夏景凉，勅几听政晓批章。飘香幽径多佳卉，戛玉空阶满绿篁。每踞匡床非静憩，钦承大命凛当阳。一诚不息遵谟训，黾勉难期庶事康。（芳碧丛在勤政殿之东，长夏每于此阅折批章，傅膳办事敬念缵承，丕绪日理万几，想勉寸诚无时豫怠，庶几法天行之不息，致庶事之咸熙。虽新篁成韵密莜迎凉，未甞翫景物而耽清暇
也。）
summary_en: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 芳碧丛, 1823, on escaping the heat and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 日下舊聞考 勤政亲贤
excerpt_zh: 正大光明殿東為勤政親賢正殿五楹（圓明園冊）臣等謹按勤政殿額曰勤政親賢四十景之一也後楹額曰為君難皆世宗御書聨曰至治凛惟艱修和九叙大猷懐用乂董正六官後楹聨曰懋勤特喜書無逸攬勝還思賦有卷皆皇上御書寳座屏風上御書無逸一篇後楹東壁陳御製創業守成難易説臣梁詩正敬書西壁陳御製為君難䟦臣于敏中敬書
summary_en: 正大光明殿's eastern neighbour is 勤政親賢, a five-bay main hall. The note records its plaques (the rear one 為君難, by Yongzheng), Qianlong's couplets, his 無逸 on the throne screen, and two of his essays set out on the rear walls, written by 梁詩正 and 于敏中.

title: 日下舊聞考 勤政亲贤
excerpt_zh: 勤政親賢之東為飛雲軒東有閣為靜鑑其北為懐清芬又北為秀木佳䕃轉後為生秋庭靜鑑閣東為芳碧叢後為保合太和正殿三楹後為富春樓樓東為竹林清響（圓圓明園册）臣等謹按飛雲軒懐清芬秀木佳䕃生秋庭諸額皆御書保合太和殿壁恭懸御書聖訓四箴箴已載養心殿卷内不備録其西暖閣亦有勤政親賢額西暖閣内額曰叢雲曰養性北曰隨安室富春樓下額曰坐擁琳琅曰蔚然深秀曰無倦齋曰清風明月樓與竹林清響額皆御書
summary_en: East of 勤政親賢 stand 飛雲軒, the 靜鑑閣 pavilion, 懐清芬, 秀木佳䕃, 生秋庭 and 芳碧叢; then 保合太和殿 of three bays with 富春樓 and 竹林清響 behind. The note lists plaques, including a second 勤政親賢 plaque and a 隨安室 in the west warm room.

title: 圆明园内生秋庭等建筑名录
date: Qing, undated on the contents page
summary_en: List of buildings beginning with Shengqiu Ting. Printed in the facsimile volume; text not seen.

title: 御製創業守成難易説
excerpt_zh: 御製創業守成難易説　唐太宗與廷臣較創業守成孰難時房喬魏徴各以所見對太宗皆見其難獨岑文本則曰剏撥亂之業其功既難守已成之基其道不易踵其論者率無軒輊於其間葢以難即不易不易即難也而余則以為不然夫難與不易豈可同日而語哉今有二人焉甲則饑乙則不飽不飽者縱不果腹堪遲待焉而饑者一再不食將餒而僵矣以是喻難與不易其輕重不可立見耶或曰難亦不易也不易亦難也今必强為低昻是視死與不生為二也其可乎余曰是正所以為二也蓋不生者雖不得生而其實尚未至死其死者又安可復生乎以是喻難與不易其輕重不又可立見耶難與不易之説明則岑文本所云撥亂難守成不易之説余又以為不然蓋創業固難矣然以守成較之但可謂之不易而守成則實難耳何則創業之主捄焚拯溺危然後安其難可謂至矣然於制度紀綱時有未暇留俟後人未為不可守成者遺大投艱單心繼序苟無以光前烈啟後圖思凛然有不終畝之憂是創業者未竟之難亦守成者分内之難也所繋不愈重乎哉世之治産者或致億或致萬或致千百無不可也子若孫持其業者増之可耳少有所損於其間人將訾之然則嗣先王之基者不待失道失衆始為慙負前人但使式廓之版圖或有侵削垂裕之成憲或有廢弛是即無以覲耿光而揚大烈昔舜之稱禹曰克勤於邦克儉於家不自滿假君天下者勤儉尚已顧創業者櫛風沐雨不期勤而自無不勤蓽路籃縷不期儉而自無不儉至於守成之主席豐履厚易至於驕驕則怠生焉故陳宵旰於太平之時言茅茨於玉陛之世輙厭而不納是非安不忘危存不忘亡鮮有不盛滿中之者以此思難則所以持難者可知矣况乎守成之責固開國之主與繼體之君所同一仔肩者也夏之王也以禹為創業以啟為守成殷之王也以湯為創業以太甲三宗為守成周之王也以文武為創業以成康為守成然禹湯文武未聞不自守其所創者以貽後昆也我不可不監於有夏我不可不監於有商我不可不監於有周嚮使為子孫者咸知守成之難雖三代至今存可也惟世少守成之主而後有創業之君出焉故予之獨以難責夫守成者非敢忘創業者之難正以慰創業者之初心耳尚書五十八篇其渉創業者惟湯誓湯誥㤗誓武成諸篇其自二典三謨以至太甲説命立政周官罔不於致治保邦為兢兢無逸一篇蔡傳謂周公所舉三宗皆繼世之君一篇中凡七更端深嗟永歎其意深遠周禮為致太平之書所言體國經野皆守成之事古人惟深見其難故言之不厭其詳也如文本之説將以繼世而有天下者坐享成功視開剏為有間則古來守文令辟與䝉業而安者幾可等量而齊觀且使中才之主得所藉口謂昔之人既為其難我僅居其不易稍自暇逸亦無不可何用是汲汲為甚者溺於宴安弗克負荷棄厥基焉夫孰階之厲也故闡明其説如此既申儆於後且藉以自朂焉
summary_en: Essay on whether founding or keeping a dynasty is harder, argued against 岑文本: founding is hard but keeping is harder. It was hung on the rear east wall of 勤政殿.

title: 御製為君難跋
excerpt_zh: 御製為君難跋　予昔為創業守成難易説亦既反覆辨論難與不易之輕重懸殊不可同日而語以為岑文本之言非是而定之曰開創不易守成難矣此非在守成言守成蓋實有見其難也兹特引伸觸𩔖敬述勤政殿後楣皇考御書為君難之義而為之跋曰大哉王言示大清億萬斯年家法大訓歟夫為君難之言孔子道人之言耳而吾直以為皇考之言者何蓋耕當問僕織當問婢豈不以習焉安焉不見異物而遷之謂乎孔子非為君者也其云難亦不過思其理而度其勢究未身歴其境而心親其勞也皇考禀内聖之姿行外王之道質諸心得驗以躬行故取孔子之言而銘之梠端所以自警也所以訓予小子也所以詔世世孫曾常凛此志以迓天庥而基命宥宻永永無極也是故言政莫備於尚書而言難亦權輿於尚書放勲重華一再曰欽引而未發至於大禹祇承於帝首曰后克艱厥后艱者難也承於帝舜者舜實承於帝堯也惟帝其難之則益深切著明言之矣無輕民事惟艱伊尹之申誥也先知稼穡之艱難周公之作訓也五十八篇之中其於天命民碞之可畏暑雨祁寒之宜思誨之諄諄三致意焉甄古今之得失綜政典之治亂無知難而不興之世亦無不知難而不亡之朝然而知難非空言知其難而已其必勅命謹幾明徳修身以立其本懲忿窒慾親賢遠侫以正其施凜凜焉惴惴焉以謹對越而培永圖予故曰大哉王言示大清億萬斯年家法大訓也或曰為君難為臣不易孔子之言也今獨舉其一豈股肱交儆之義哉予曰向不云乎難與不易輕重懸殊不可同日而語則為臣之不易吾將俟為臣者自言其不易可耳未若為君之難也且也當其不易者恒多語有之衆擎易舉則不易者亦將成易而當其難者一人而已嗚呼豈不甚難
summary_en: Colophon to Yongzheng's plaque 為君難 'To Be Ruler Is Hard', hung on the rear west wall of 勤政殿: he traces the idea through the classics and claims it as family law.

title: 竹葉亭雜記
excerpt_zh: 圆明园召见，向在勤政殿。三楹桶扇洞开，殿中有横桶分前后焉。殿东有套间曰东书房，无前廊。夏日召见在殿中，春秋则在书房。书房门向东，前加牌杈。
summary_en: How audiences were held at 勤政殿: three bays with folding doors opened, a partition front to back, and a side room on the east called 東書房 used in spring and autumn. Gives the interior; the bay count differs from S05.

title: 清晖阁: 乾隆八年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆八年 (1743), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 春去春来客路辕，女夷雅解返花魂。柍桭旭影迟珠箔，燕雀风光猎网轩。䑕尾麝煤梧几静，松涛蟹眼茗炉喧。如酥脉起初耕便，消得恩膏自御园。 （入春雪泽沾足东作有赖，不似去岁有云汉之忧云。）
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 清晖阁, 1743, on daily residence there. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 御製九州清宴詩（圓明園四十景詩）
excerpt_zh:
乾隆九年 御製九州清宴詩
正大光明直北為㡬餘游息之所棼橑紛接鱗瓦參差前臨巨湖渟浤演漾周圍支汊縱横旁逹諸勝仿彿潯陽九𣲖騶衍謂禆海周環為九州者九大瀛海環其外兹境信若造物施設耶
昔我皇考宅是廣居旰食宵衣左圖右書園林游觀以適幾餘豈繄廊廟泉石是娱所志維何煌煌御書九州清宴皇心乃舒肯構孰責繼序在余業業兢兢奉此遺模一念之間敬肆攸殊作狂作聖繫彼斯湏謂天可畏屋漏與俱謂民可畏敢欺其愚六膳八珍牣乎御㕑念彼溝壑曷其飽諸水榭山亭天然畫圖瞻彼茅簷痌瘝切膚慎終如始前聖之謨嗚呼小子母渝厥初
summary_en: North of the audience hall is the place of daily rest: crowded roofs and rafters, a great lake in front and channels on every side. The nine land masses recall 鄒衍's nine continents within an encircling sea.

title: 池上居: 乾隆十二年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆十二年 (1747), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 槐日风清候，壶天池上居。润含新樾重，爽挹午窗虚。古调弹声鹤，天机唼浪鱼。底须费穿凿，水到自成渠。乍见锦绷勹，旋听绿玉敲。有堂如白傅，不雨度西郊。啭树莺求友，衔莎雀补巢。一泓相对处，无虑置杯胶。轩楹俯碧流，槛影座中浮。堪纳水云意，底论大小舟。风前饶乳燕，雨后尚鸣鸠。暇日无余事，新题每见投。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 池上居, 1747. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 画禅室: 乾隆十五年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆十五年 (1750), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 积素山逾远，寒侵夕益緐。节真应大雪，景恰媚名园。鹤讶翔松顶，蝗知避麦根。竹炉新仿得，（仿恵山制竹炉收雪水烹之）活火正温存。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 画禅室, 1750, on snow and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 御製題清暉閣四景
excerpt_zh: 乾隆三十年御製題清暉閣四景　閣前喬松已燬石壁獨存突兀横亘致不惬觀山以樹為儀新松長成復需嵗月乃因高就低㸃綴為樓齋若干間取其小無取其大取其樸無取其麗坐閣中頗似展倪黄横披小卷也　閣對横陳石壁修因高新築兩層樓隔牆延得松雲意（閣前松遭燬牆外者猶存喬柯此樓近之因以命名）小許居然勝一籌（右松雲樓）　假山有真樹秋露零瀼瀼高下綴枝葉沆瀣凝珠光寜湏詡其甘訝可裛其香玲瓏石竅間然疑即上皇硬黄待揮毫却愧米襄陽（右露香齋）　書屋剛容方丈寛慎修勤浴敢圖安其楶斧藻猶慙若漫擬東京八殿看（右涵徳書屋）　巖堂何所貯所貯惟縹緗雖非鄴侯多開卷益有方詎祗資詠吟將以騐幾康獲心在古人茹豈因柔剛（右茹古堂）
summary_en: The old pines before 清暉閣 had burned, leaving a bare rock wall. He built small plain rooms at varied heights instead: 松雲樓, 露香齋, 涵徳書屋, 茹古堂, one verse each. Useful for the dated change of 乾隆三十年 (1765).

title: 松云楼: 乾隆三十二年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十二年 (1767), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 假山之上峙真松，时蔚英英云态浓。青白由来投气味，便当为雨契从龙。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 松云楼, 1767, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 长春书屋: 乾隆三十二年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十二年 (1767), date from the compilation
locator: p.115 item (1), under 长春书屋
excerpt_zh: 清闲何为消，明窗芸编陈。耽书诚前縁，怡情谐常因。千秋于焉观，分阴良堪珍。汤盘铭曾言，予惟期其新。“临池怀前贤，抚古允我喜。虽常希颜筋，那有省可髓。孜孜勤悬针，草草哂累纸。佳言思公权，引以辅善理。” “匡床双金猊，焕灿护兽炭。氲氲檀芬烧，霭霭蕙篆散。褰帷薫心源，对座净鼻观。无然安清供，问政毖缔案。”“筠炉江南来，恰合设白屋。烹煎松风鸣，活泼雪色漉。竒吟输唐卢，佚乐学复陆。擎杯方无言，魄月䔩绿竹。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 长春书屋, 1767, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 涵德书屋: 乾隆三十五年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十五年 (1770), date from the compilation
locator: p.128 item (1), under 涵德书屋
excerpt_zh: 修己涵养德，践行固已艰。出治播淳风，民涵德倍难。即境思题额，鲜怡增赩颜。岂不景悦目，那无花娱观。耽此必忘彼，戒哉凛冰渊。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 涵德书屋, 1770, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 乐安和: 乾隆三十九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十九年 (1774), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 乐安和意虽一贯，义亦各具。昔汤之盘武之席，莫不各有铭，所以触目警心也。盘席祗日用物犹亟亟焉，而况朝夕所处之室乎，各成六韵以勑一躬。”“乐亦六情一，因而额寝斋。弗耽斯得正，从欲实为乖。花鸟引机绪，诗书藴道荄。当思不可亟，恒念与之偕。应在雨旸若，宁须丝竹排。山端姑彼置，五字识吾怀。（右乐）”“向祗随所遇， （旧颜所居书屋曰：“随安室”。取随遇而安之义。 ）今惟安在斯。朝乾实切矣，夕惕亦居之。适已非为合，图民乃得宜。礼经著和乐，尧典仰文思。建久贾生策，计情鼌氏辞。更殷深念者，永固万年基。 （右安）” “和者寛仁施，是诚得众縁。温而厉则可，柔以发斯偏。性命保合正，起居赡养便。莫惭衾影独，那溺景光妍。无欲心常泰，有为身弼肩。春台一气鬯，与物共誾然。 （右和）
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 乐安和, 1774, on daily residence there. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 御製賦得樂安和詩（有序）
excerpt_zh: 乾隆三十九年御製賦得樂安和詩（有序）　顔寢殿之額曰樂安和意雖一貫義亦各具昔湯之盤武之席莫不各有銘所以觸目警心也盤席祗日用物猶亟亟焉而况朝夕所處之室乎各成六韻以勅一躬　樂亦六情一因而額寢齋弗耽斯得正從欲實為乖花鳥引機緒詩書藴道荄當思不可亟恒念與之偕應在雨暘若寜湏絲竹排三端姑彼置五字識吾懐（右樂）　向祗隨所遇（舊額所居書室曰隨安堂取隨遇而安之義）今惟安在斯朝乾實切矣夕惕亦居之適已非為合圖民乃得宜禮經著和樂堯典仰文思建久賈生䇿計情鼂氏辭更深殷念者永固萬年基（右安）　和者寛仁施（去聲）是誠得衆縁温而厲則可柔以發斯偏性命保合正起居安養便莫慙衾影獨那溺景光妍無欲心常泰有為身弼肩春基一氣鬯與物共誾然（右和）臣等謹按九州清宴清暉閣樂安和御製詩㳟載首見之篇餘不備録
summary_en: Three poems on the words of the bedroom plaque 樂安和, explaining each word: Qianlong's reminders to himself of restraint, with a note on his earlier room name 隨安堂.

title: 清晖阁: 乾隆三十九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十九年 (1774), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 高阁清晖寝殿傍，多年恒与坐相羊。忧霖望雨题何伙，惕夕乾朝政每蘉。植绿蕉惟爱聴飒，（北方芭蕉至夏月乃可出坞植于庭）补新松亦渐成苍。（癸未，回禄后补松逮今又十二年矣）那辞两鬓添霜白，犹励初心勉未遑。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 清晖阁, 1774, on daily residence there. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 池上居: 乾隆四十年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆四十年 (1775), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 夏日宜居池上居，天光水态澹如如。望云愁早幸过彼，较雨量晴略慰予。祇有殷心盼捷至，（阿桂攻克木思工，噶克丫口可以直压噶尔丹，寺明亮则初克甲索，宜喜复自达尔图下至基木斯丹当噶，并日旁以前环山五十里内贼碉俱经焚毁已可渡河，与阿桂合兵会剿勒乌围，计日大功可成，盼望红旗较前倍切。 ）岂无逸兴遣几余。拈吟即景犹嫌惯，校勘欣翻四库书。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 池上居, 1775, on daily residence there. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 画禅室: 乾隆四十四年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆四十四年 (1779), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 己巳池上居，清暇消夏暑。画禅学香光，名迹収其五。逮今三十年，一瞬光阴数。又复得其二，三朝册集古。（室中续贮一册皆宋元明真迹，其一则李唐江山小景长巻，皆香光所评品也。）江山小景巻，李唐真迹覩。名画荟珎帧，则我新所聚。弗让其大观，（荟珎册较其昌所藏更多，彼一唐人余皆名人真迹，亦无让大观册也。 ）唐画乃双取。都弆一檀匣，新旧各分部。同为无上珍，短什识罗缕。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 画禅室, 1779, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 长春书屋: 乾隆四十六年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆四十六年 (1781), date from the compilation
locator: p.115 item (2), under 长春书屋
excerpt_zh: 又值孟之春，御园首祚誾。四年久阙咏，（自丁酉大事过二十七月后，昨岁南巡自京起程至今忽四年矣。）一室永怡神。依例行时旧，不堪得句新。西南望仙馆（此书屋乃九州岛清晏别室之名，长春仙馆乂西南别一区，为昔日奉圣母驻御园度新正之处也。 ）益觉怅怀频。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 长春书屋, 1781, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 乐安和: 乾隆五十四年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆五十四年 (1789), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 御园乐安和，夏日每以居。山园乐安和，肖其式为诸。一游即返跸，诚似驰驿如。（予遇佳山水輙过而不留，昔年南巡尹继善有驰驿，游山之喻正契予意，诗中因屡及之。 ）然乐安与和，在民非在吾。民失和与安，吾乐岂良图。是则居与游，此意何处无。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 乐安和, 1789, on daily residence there. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 池上居: 乾隆六十年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆六十年 (1795), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 池上年年例有诗，较晴量雨鲜逢宜。历观题壁多愁者，何幸拈毫值若时。遇顺却虞心有放，戒盈惟励志无移。箕畴恒忆曰忧句，望捷弗宁正在兹。（日前据福康安、和琳奏现在永绥之围虽解，而附近山坳岩洞甚多贼匪不时窥伺，随即分路攻克焚烧苗寨，殱戮贼众，无筭其鸦酉、黄瓜寨等处紧要隘口山梁、木栅林立贼首石柳邓等自知罪不可遣自必并力抵御，官兵正欲藉其并力一处方可聚族殱灭，谅不日即可悉数擒获，迅蒇大功，惟盼望捷音日益悬切耳。 ）
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 池上居, 1795. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 奉三无私: 嘉庆三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆三年 (1798), date from the compilation
locator: p.113 item (1), under 奉三无私
excerpt_zh: 本支百世荷皇恩，前夕家筵启御园。星灿兰膏悬锦幙，月辉云网漾珠旛。连床晋爵称纯嘏，接席傅柑近笑言。遍览图书谁得似，九旬太上见来孙。（皇父庆开九裹行健，符天德福之隆莫能飏颂，今春元孙载锡卜吉成婚即可，冀得来孙再阅六七岁期颐开庆之年遇此韶辰又可承恩入宴，自古称太上皇帝优蒙昊眷锡羡延洪者，循蜚疏仡以来实未之见也。 ）
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 奉三无私, 1798, on banquets. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 九洲清晏: 嘉庆六年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆六年 (1801), date from the compilation
locator: p.111 item (5), under 九洲清晏
excerpt_zh: 六十余年寝兴处，栋隆协吉寸诚钦。治民常念茅檐苦，勤政宁耽广厦深。松茂竹苞承世泽，衣宵食旰继慈心。瞻依敬勉肯堂志，日月光中永照临。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 九洲清晏, 1801, on daily residence there and visits to the dowager. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 松云楼: 嘉庆七年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆七年 (1802), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 虬干郁葱结翠云，天涛披拂座中闻。几闲淡晤忘年友，心识岁寒领静芬。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 松云楼, 1802, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 涵德书屋: 嘉庆七年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆七年 (1802), date from the compilation
locator: p.128 item (2), under 涵德书屋
excerpt_zh: 德业蕴于衷，涵养守其素。明镜必藏辉，来照随所遇。仁心在滋培，本性原自具。水月相印中，真空不常住。鸢鱼乐岂同，活泼天机露。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 涵德书屋, 1802, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 露香斋: 嘉庆七年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆七年 (1802), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 九霄沆瀣本清凉，芳接荷盘潄异香。佳茗烹调沁心腑，餐霞岂更有仙方。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 露香斋, 1802, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 长春书屋: 嘉庆八年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆八年 (1803), date from the compilation
locator: p.115 item (4), under 长春书屋
excerpt_zh:
万汇生于春，仁为众善首。大德遍含容，引长岁月久。我考额书斋，淳化洽九有。渥泽溥黎元，感沐栽培厚。
继统凛艰难，深虞弗克负。兢业念持盈，先言衷敬守。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 长春书屋, 1803, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 九洲清晏: 嘉庆十一年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十一年 (1806), date from the compilation
locator: p.112 item (9), under 九洲清晏
excerpt_zh: 福地寝兴六十年，日瞻堂构凛承先。九州岛清晏愿难遂，兆姓繁多治未宣。 （九洲清晏为御园寝兴之地，予小子仰承堂构仍之，而不敢轻易者也。日瞻楣梠敬绎璇题，未尝不勤勉缉熙，思敷化治于九寓，而垂姓繁庶，未能家给人足风俗之漓者，尚未悉返于淳，抚衷深切欿然耳。）岂恋园林供悦目，总因宵旰重仔肩。后湖冰鉴玉壶澈，朗印寸田养浩然。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 九洲清晏, 1806, on daily residence there and visits to the dowager. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 九洲清晏: 嘉庆十二年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十二年 (1807), date from the compilation
locator: p.112 item (10), under 九洲清晏
excerpt_zh: 祖考贻福地，继承凛鸿猷。顾名必思义，抚字怀九州岛。勅政主勤敬，事理以诚求。庶不负庭训，永图勉进修。（御园福地为祖考留贻，予继承居此未尝稍有更易。当日命字题颜已寓启迪后人之意，此寝兴处曰九洲清宴。九州岛赅寰宇而言，清宴致太平之象。而疆域宏恢，抚御不易。予一人克艰时念，主敬存诚以期治理之当，庶几恪守贻谋不忘庭训也。 ）
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 九洲清晏, 1807, on daily residence there and visits to the dowager. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 乐安和: 嘉庆十四年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十四年 (1809), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 圣人治世凛，先忧年和民。安理庶事，寅承大宝守训。言思其艰以图其易，生齿繁多悯困穷愚顽，罹法每作伪未能同乐。皆小康吁嗟，此愿何时遂。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 乐安和, 1809, on daily residence there. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 万象涵春: 道光三年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
date: 道光三年 (1823), date from the compilation
locator: p.114 item (1), under 万象涵春
excerpt_zh: 清明甫过沐甘膏，敬感时和昊眷叨。袅袅含青添碧柳，枝枝著色助绯桃。最欣宿麦滋千亩，伫看新波长半篙。淅沥无声沾既足，北窗静对润丹毫。
summary_en: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 万象涵春, 1823, on rain and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 万象涵春: 道光三年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
date: 道光三年 (1823), date from the compilation
locator: p.114 item (2), under 万象涵春
excerpt_zh: 风静湖光好，迎凉坐北窗。游鳞冲细浪，驯鹤立平矼。药圃留珠蕾，松林挂玉釭。寂然群动息，隔水晚钟撞。
summary_en: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 万象涵春, 1823, on daily residence there. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 奉三无私: 道光三年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
date: 道光三年 (1823), date from the compilation
locator: p.113 item (3), under 奉三无私
excerpt_zh: 由来君道贵无私，法祖承天日敬之。赞化流形归至教，春荣秋肃尽隆施。公诚接物情须顺，衡鉴平心理必随。朴素檐楹钦俭德，亿龄苞茂渥恩贻。（奉三无私乃九洲清晏前殿规制，朴素不事雕华，予小子式缵鸿基，永怀天法俭德敬祖，敢不朂哉。）
summary_en: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 奉三无私, 1823. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 养正书屋: 道光四年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
date: 道光四年 (1824), date from the compilation
locator: p.128 item (1), under 养正书屋
excerpt_zh: 养正彦楣承考泽，圣功景仰理含宏。松阴满院阶除静，旭影当窗几案明。新岁时临心永慕，昔年日课集初成。皇哉堂构衷常凛，育德端居系寸情。（皇考御极之初，即书赐养正书屋扁，额勉以育德示以圣功手泽如新心传。若揭予小子渥蒙提命常目在兹，堂构丕承冰渊滋惕，而回忆芸窗日课端居多，暇之时又不觉情为之往矣。）
summary_en: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 养正书屋, 1824, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 养正书屋: 道光五年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
date: 道光五年 (1825), date from the compilation
locator: p.128 item (2), under 养正书屋
excerpt_zh: 御园常占四时春，明暖窗栊净点尘。谡谡松声初霁后，曈曈日影上元辰。牙籖悦性天然趣，彩炬迎年分外新。养正精微心永慕，深恩钦感合书绅。
summary_en: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 养正书屋, 1825, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 清晖阁: 道光七年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
date: 道光七年 (1827), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 驱炎何所适，高阁展芸编。幽卉飘清馥，长松锁碧烟。非关尘外赏，自得静中缘。冲淡含真趣，凉飔一室延。
summary_en: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 清晖阁, 1827, on escaping the heat and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 万象涵春: 道光十年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
date: 道光十年 (1830), date from the compilation
locator: p.115 item (11), under 万象涵春
excerpt_zh: 虚室春光喜静便，苍苍松柏荫阶前。冰湖一鉴含斜日，冻柳千条惹暮烟。冲淡吾怀防俗念，观摩往迹鉴陈编。盆梅座右清芬袭，古干新葩雪后天。
summary_en: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 万象涵春, 1830, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 奉三无私: 道光十一年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
date: 道光十一年 (1831), date from the compilation
locator: p.113 item (4), under 奉三无私
excerpt_zh:
五旬初度沛恩宜，首重亲亲固本支。晋爵更兼荣翠羽，章身乍睹耀金芝。同登寿㝢承先泽，永睦宗藩荷考慈。春雪更欣呈瑞景，福延奕叶大清基。（朕五旬庆节嘉惠，宗亲、
仪亲王之孙奕絪封为入八分辅国公，成郡王载锐赏戴三眼花翎，庆郡王绵慜之弟绵悌封为不入八分辅国公，定亲王奕绍赏给金黄朝服蟒袍，载铨封为不入八分镇国公，惇亲王绵恺赏银三千两，惠郡王绵愉赏银二千两，奕约赏银一千两。所以敷思衍庆，敦睦懿亲也。际兹肆筵授几，情洽欢联，洵为天家乐事。庶几赓雅歌于行苇，非徒酬令节于传柑云尔。 ）
summary_en: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 奉三无私, 1831. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 慎德堂: 道光十一年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
date: 道光十一年 (1831), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 崇俭去奢，慎修思永，孰不知其所当然哉！非知之艰，行之惟艰，在士大夫犹患其位不期骄而骄、禄不期侈而侈，膺天命绍大统者，可不兢兢焉、惴惴焉？懔夫皇天无亲，惟无是辅，念夫祖功宗德创垂不易，后世子孙坐享承平之福，纵不尚奢华、无所加增，自问已觉不安矣！若败度败礼，视富贵为己所应有，是直不可与言者也，又奚能常保厥位耶？况我大清龙兴东土，首重朴实，列圣丕承，凡心法治法，无非以勤俭训后，诚以世变风移，敝化放心。有不期然而然之势，苟非操之固。审之精朴素自甘，慎终如始难与言俭也。至于饮食勿尚珍异，冠裳勿求华美，耳目勿为物欲所诱，居处勿为淫巧所惑，此犹俭德之小者。不作无益害有益，不贵异物贱用物，一丝一粟皆出于民脂民膏，思及此，又岂容逞欲妄为哉？所谓无为而治，俾天下阴受其福而民不知者，是也。然行俭责在一人，不以天下自奉非概从悭悋也，若救饥拯溺、去暴安良，国用之常经、民生之休戚，正措施之不遑，又何可稍存吝惜于其辨也！是以修身务存俭约之心，以期永久图治之道，可不加慎而切记之乎？道光十一年岁次辛卯季春月御制。
summary_en: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 慎德堂, 1831. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 慎德堂: 道光十二年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
date: 道光十二年 (1832), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 为爱新堂远俗缘，不雕不绘喜安便。面开松嶂涛初起，背映冰湖月正圆。永戒骄奢心勿放，时操勤俭力须坚。清虚静泰承天语（奉三无私殿内恭悬皇祖御书“清虚静泰”扁额），气志由中悟浩然。
summary_en: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 慎德堂, 1832, on daily residence there. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 养正书屋: 道光十三年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
date: 道光十三年 (1833), date from the compilation
locator: p.128 item (3), under 养正书屋
excerpt_zh:
三十年前手自栽，无人
管领恐残摧。新花老干须珍护，昔日风光眼底来。数年阔别理谁参，得地从兹雨露涵。人事变迁真可慨，树犹如此我何堪。
summary_en: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 养正书屋, 1833, on reading and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 基福堂: 咸丰五年 poem of the Xianfeng Emperor
date: 咸丰五年 (1855), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 御园钟粹两颜楣，生我劬劳念在兹。（子于辛卯六月九日生于御园之湛静斋，即今基福堂也。）考妣恩深何以报，敬勤志最敢时遗。修身身立诚艰矣，基福福臻倍惕之。孝心存如赤子音，容莫睹祇余悲
summary_en: Xianfeng, 1855: his note says he was born on the 9th day of the sixth month of 1831 in 湛静斋, the present 基福堂.

title: 基福堂: 咸丰五年 poem of the Xianfeng Emperor
date: 咸丰五年 (1855), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 诞育辛年曾此地，慈颜已十五春远。聊因怀旧寝兴所，那复承欢膝下依。父母俱存恸不胜，未能继志愧多增。何堪乐境成忧境，惟敬惟勤考眷承。
summary_en: Poem of the Xianfeng Emperor at 基福堂, 1855, on daily residence there. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 慎德堂: 咸丰七年 poem of the Xianfeng Emperor
date: 咸丰七年 (1857), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 巍峨广殿月偏多，绕树栖鸟三两过。慎宪省成子意切，朝朝勤政引鸣珂。经营尚忆我生年，（慎德堂落成于道光辛卯）受命恩深倍惕乾。 （庚戌春宣谕立储在兹殿之寝宫）往事何堪重回首，多情惟有月知圆。
summary_en: Poem of the Xianfeng Emperor at 慎德堂, 1857, on the view and daily residence there. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 日下舊聞考 九洲清晏
excerpt_zh: 正大光明後有湖亦稱前湖湖正北為圓明園殿五楹後為奉三無私殿七楹又後為九州清宴殿七楹東為天地一家春西為樂安和又西為清暉閣閣前為露香齋左為茹古堂為松雲樓右為涵徳書屋（圓明園冊）臣等謹按九州清宴額世宗御書四十景之一也前第一層殿恭懸聖祖御書圓明園額聨曰每對青山緑水㑹心處一邱一壑總自天恩浩蕩常從霽月光風悦目時一草一木莫非帝徳高深世宗藩邸時書聨曰恤小民之依所其無逸稽古人之徳彰厥有常皇上御書第二層為奉三無私殿内恭懸皇上御書聖祖仁皇帝聖訓曰天下之治亂休咎皆係人主之一身一心政令之設必當遠慮深謀以防後悔周詳籌度計及久長不可為近名邀利之舉不可用一已偏執之見採羣言以廣益合衆志以成城始為無偏無黨之道孝者百行之原不孝之人斷不可用義者萬事之本非義之事必不可為孝以立身義以制事無是二者雖君臣父子不能保也世宗憲皇帝聖訓曰敬天法祖勤政親賢愛民擇吏除暴安良勿過寛柔勿過嚴猛同氣至親實為一體誠心友愛休戚相闗時聞正言日行正事弗為小人所誘弗為邪説所惑聖祖所貽之宗室宜親國家所用之賢良宜保自然和氣致祥綿宗社萬年之慶額曰清虚靜泰聨曰澗泉無操琴泠然善也風竹有聲畫顧而樂之寳座聨曰所無逸而居動靜適徴仁智體有常以治照臨並叶清寜皇上御書九州清宴殿後額曰蔚然深秀聨曰紅篆爐烟看氣直緑苞庭竹愛心虛與樂安和清暉閣諸額皆御書清暉閣北壁懸圓明園全圖乾隆二年命畫院郎世寜唐岱孫祐沈源張萬邦丁觀鵬恭繪御題大觀二字並題聨曰稽古重圖書義存無逸三宗訓勤民咨稼穡事著豳風七月篇
summary_en: North across the lake behind the audience hall: 圓明園殿 (five bays), 奉三無私殿 (seven), 九州清宴殿 (seven), with 天地一家春 to the east, 樂安和 to the west, then 清暉閣 with 露香齋, 茹古堂, 松雲樓 and 涵徳書屋. The note gives the plaques and full text of the Kangxi and Yongzheng instructions on the second hall's wall. On the north wall of 清暉閣 hung the 圓明園全圖 painted in 乾隆二年 (1737) by 郎世寜 Castiglione, 唐岱, 孫祐, 沈源, 張萬邦 and 丁觀鵬.

title: Qing record: 慎德堂
excerpt_zh: 崇俭去奢，慎修思永，孰不知其所当然哉！非知之艰，行之惟艰，在士大夫犹患其位不期骄而骄、禄不期侈而侈，膺天命绍大统者，可不兢兢焉、惴惴焉？懔夫皇天无亲，惟无是辅，念夫祖功宗德创垂不易，后世子孙坐享承平之福，纵不尚奢华、无所加增，自问已觉不安矣！若败度败礼，视富贵为己所应有，是直不可与言者也，又奚能常保厥位耶？况我大清龙兴东土，首重朴实，列圣丕承，凡心法治法，无非以勤俭训后，诚以世变风移，敝化放心。有不期然而然之势，苟非操之固。审之精朴素自甘，慎终如始难与言俭也。至于饮食勿尚珍异，冠裳勿求华美，耳目勿为物欲所诱，居处勿为淫巧所惑，此犹俭德之小者。不作无益害有益，不贵异物贱用物，一丝一粟皆出于民脂民膏，思及此，又岂容逞欲妄为哉？所谓无为而治，俾天下阴受其福而民不知者，是也。然行俭责在一人，不以天下自奉非概从悭悋也，若救饥拯溺、去暴安良，国用之常经、民生之休戚，正措施之不遑，又何可稍存吝惜于其辨也！是以修身务存俭约之心，以期永久图治之道，可不加慎而切记之乎？道光十一年岁次辛卯季春月御制。
summary_en: 道光 Daoguang's own essay on thrift for the hall, 慎德堂记, dated spring 1831.

title: Qing record, overview item 90
excerpt_zh: 御制记曰：予自践阼以来，于今十有七年，兢兢业业。惟虑政治之未修，民生之未裕，一切兴作，概从简略，非慕卑宫之名，惜露台之费。盖事必权其缓急，心必戒夫逸豫，惟怀永图，不敢不慎也。若今者，圆明园三殿之重修，盖有说焉。三殿者，前曰圆明园，中曰奉三无私，后曰九洲清晏，溯自圣祖赐额，世宗定居，皇祖皇考因淳守朴，不改成规。
summary_en: Daoguang's record on rebuilding the three halls of the 九洲清晏 axis, 1837; the first part reprinted here says little was built in his reign, but this repair was needed.

title: 宣宗實錄 御製重修圓明園三殿記
link: https://github.com/garychowcmu/daizhigev20/blob/master/史藏/别史/清实录道光朝实录.txt
excerpt_zh: 癸巳。重修圆明园三殿成。御制记曰。予自践阼以来。于今十有七年。兢兢业业。惟虑政治之未修。民生之未裕。一切兴作。概从简略。非慕卑宫之名。惜露台之费。盖事必权其缓急。心必戒夫逸豫。惟怀永图。不敢不慎也。若今者圆明园三殿之重修。盖有说焉。三殿者。前曰圆明园。中曰奉三无私。后曰九洲清晏。溯自圣祖赐额。世宗定居。皇祖皇考。因淳守朴。不改成规。爰逮藐躬。德輶任重。亦惟祗承基绪。曷敢不念□荷之艰。乃以丙申九月二十六日戌亥之交。融风告警。郁攸从之。虽绠缶有备。而涂彻已多。予心怵惕。不遑启处。惟兹三殿。乃祖宗缔构所诒。居御园之中。为寝兴之所。非若山茨水槛。仅备游观。若不及时修复。何以自安。爰命内府诸臣。庀材鸠功。缮完补阙。惟期示俭于后。不敢增美于前。工未逾年。制已复旧。于以昭不雕不斲之风。亦以守不愆不忘之志版筑之兴。洵不得己也。抑予之说。更有进焉。周书大诰梓材。两言作室。既底法矣。继之曰肯堂肯构。既勤垣墉矣。继之曰涂塈茨。自古帝王。肇造丕基。规模远大。匪第令后世无以加也。亦谓数传而后。其张弛损益。因乎时。存乎人焉。故创业务期可继。而守成亦贵有为。若因循玩泄。有废莫举。所谓堂构涂塈者安在耶。然非值必不可缓之事。有必不得已之心。动辄更张。矜言改作。则前人厎法之善。必至纷然失其所守。其弊更有不可胜言者。是举也。惟愿我后人念作室之不易。则图易而思艰。睹寝成之孔安。则居安而虑殆。慎宪省成。庶几乎无废事焉。且知宫室之制度已备。国家之经费有常。工不可以创兴。役不可以轻举。持盈保泰。庶几乎无侈心焉。夫无废事。勤也。无侈心。俭也。勤者治之本。俭者福之源也。继自今以引以翼。攸芋攸跻。监成宪以无愆。巩洪图于勿替。是则予之厚望也夫。工既竣。乃述颠末而为之记。
summary_en: The Daoguang emperor's account of the rebuilding. A fire on 丙申九月二十六日 (1836) struck the three halls 圓明園殿, 奉三無私 and 九洲清晏, his living quarters. He had them restored to the old form in under a year, with nothing added.

title: 同治十二年 上谕: 九洲清晏 halls renamed (as quoted in S220)
locator: S220 section 五; archive not seen
excerpt_zh: 绮春园改名万春园，敷春堂改名天地一家春，悦心园改名和春园，清夏斋改名清夏堂，圆明园九州清晏同道堂改名福寿仁恩，基福堂改名思顺堂，天地一家春改名承恩堂。清夏堂西宫门改名南宫门。
summary_en: The decree of 1873 gives the new names of Tongzhi's repair: 同道堂 becomes 福寿仁恩, 基福堂 becomes 思顺堂, the old 天地一家春 becomes 承恩堂. All three new names are written on the plan S01 at 九洲清晏, where its older names are not. So those labels cannot be earlier than this decree, and they are not names of the target state of 1860.

title: M'Ghee: the imperial apartments
excerpt_other: and a spiral staircase, the only one in the building, led to a similar suite of apartments overhead,
summary_en: Courtyard plan. State room with dark carved furniture and wainscot, then a court about 50 ft square flagged in marble, a larger room with jade, china, enamel, clocks, mirrors, chandeliers. Rooms of the court ladies on the extreme left, with the only spiral stair. Front on another sheet of water with large planted rockeries. To the right the buildings ran about half a mile: officials, servants, stores with shelved rooms of labelled objects. Swinhoe p.297 also has a spiral stair. 慎德堂 is my guess for the emperor's rooms under Xianfeng.

title: Fire already during the looting (Favier, per Malone)
