title: 方壶胜境平面图 (图名: 方壶胜境北路)
locator: 国家图书馆善本部 样042-2号
summary_en: Late-Daoguang presentation plan of the north range of Fanghu Shengjing, ink and light colour. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

title: 方壶胜境铜龙、凤立样底图
summary_en: Elevation base sheet for the bronze dragons and phoenixes at Fanghu Shengjing, title seen as a related item; own page URL, shelf number and date not seen. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

title: 《圆明园四十景》图的价值: 方壶胜境 leaf
summary_en: Says the 方壶胜境 leaf also shows its neighbours: 蕊珠宫 east, the three small stone pagodas and pavilions of 三潭印月 west, 天宇空明 north, two timber bridges south. So one leaf can witness several objects.

title: 琼华楼对雨
locator: v2 p.329, under 方壶胜境; source ref 2-533
excerpt_zh: 飒爽檐帷生薄寒，梧桐枝上玉阑干。云飞别岫当轩暗，雨过前溪隔座看。声泻池荷吟凤管，点催檐瓦弄珠丸。西山拟望秋晴黛，烟屿鸥波正渺漫。
summary_en: Poem 琼华楼对雨 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1742, filed by the editors under 方壶胜境.

title: 御製澡身浴徳詩（圓明園四十景詩）
excerpt_zh:
乾隆九年 御製澡身浴徳詩
福海西壖平漪鏡淨黛蓄膏停竹嶼蘆汀極望瀰瀰浴鳬飛鷺游泳翔集王司州云非惟使人情開滌亦覺日月清朗
芩香含石髓秋水長天色不竭亦不盈是惟君子徳我來俯空明鏡已黙相識魚躍與鳶飛如如安樂國
summary_en: The west shore of 福海: water calm as a mirror, bamboo islets and reed banks, ducks and egrets. He cites 王司州 on how such a view clears both the feelings and the very sun and moon.

title: 澄虚榭: 乾隆二十四年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十四年 (1759), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 朗榭临碧湖，漭沆不计里。因居岸之西，待月恒于此。罗落迤东林，掩暎金盘子。须臾升其杪，翻影漾湖水。天水月胥虚，谁与分别是。三闲独无言，了然洞妙理。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 澄虚榭, 1759, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 望瀛洲: 乾隆二十九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十九年 (1764), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 湖心构舎䂓三岛，湖岸开亭号望瀛。标榜莫猜出想象，便真壶峤也虚名。早觉真痴鄙汉帝，那更幻乐羡唐臣。可知名利场中客，不是神仙队里人。东海金波一缕丝，须臾玉镜大千披。仙家日月迅如此，望彼瀛洲亦底为。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 望瀛洲, 1764, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 解愠书屋: 乾隆二十九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十九年 (1764), date from the compilation
locator: p.262 item (1), under 解愠书屋
excerpt_zh: 书屋樾凉多，偏宜夏节过。问名惟解愠，抚序正南讹。匪悦一躬适，所期万姓和。仪型在心法，讵曰五弦歌。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 解愠书屋, 1764, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 解愠书屋: 乾隆二十九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十九年 (1764), date from the compilation
locator: p.262 item (2), under 解愠书屋
excerpt_zh: 选题额柍桭，虞帝昔闻遵。解愠言何易，民碞畏是真。稍欣暑雨过，披得爽风新。万宝西成后，庶几鲜馑贫。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 解愠书屋, 1764, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 望瀛洲: 嘉庆三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆三年 (1798), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh:
渤海之东有蓬莱，方丈瀛洲三岛开。祥麟威凤共翔集，琪英瑶草连琼台。道书敷衍总虚诞，谁见骖鸾次玉管。驻颜炼药事荒唐，食德饮和路平坦。四得堂记圣意申，求仙自昔皆痴人。位禄名寿天所赐，九旬纯嘏万福臻。（人君统御万方，位禄名皆可自主，所
不能必者惟寿。是以英君谊辟多有惑于方士长生久视之术恣意求仙者，不知寿与位禄名皆申命。自天惟德是，视我皇父克天德以作元命，不惟深斥求仙。即服饵引导之说，亦摈而不用圣制四得论。谓五福寿居首明福之所。先四得寿居，后明德之能。久惟圣能之惟，圣受之兹寿。近期颐康疆纯，嘏方引于亿万，万年而无量。御园游望，瀛洲延览之余深有会乎，寓境而弗滞于境也。 ）
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 望瀛洲, 1798, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 望瀛洲: 嘉庆十年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十年 (1805), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 方亭临福海，百顷漾晴澜。天阔闲云远，波深夏画寒。涵霞浮密樾，倒影印虚峦。即境心神谧，蓬瀛画里看。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 望瀛洲, 1805, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 解愠书屋: 嘉庆十年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十年 (1805), date from the compilation
locator: p.263 item (6), under 解愠书屋
excerpt_zh: 清风解暑气，烦热可顿除。民艰恐难达，心愠无时舒。尘市何湫隘，自愧居广居。藐躬承孝训，永念授玺初。庶姓苦贫乏，衣食未饶余。变时待天眷，大有丰年书。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 解愠书屋, 1805, on reading and escaping the heat. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 澄虚榭: 嘉庆十三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十三年 (1808), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh:
时若雨旸感昊慈，御园度节守前规。所欣三辅逢年兆，
偶阅九龙竞渡嬉。昆弟协心国有庆，君臣一德政咸宜。联情行赏宴同乐，云岫风箫念岂移。（端阳日于福海中龙舟竞渡，并命诸王大臣等预观锡以宴赉，亦系先朝旧规，不过例陈节事，共庆佳辰。然皆于办事后定时观览，从未竟日留连。且亦须雨旸时若之年，方始循例饬办。予事事敬承家法不敢稍渝，本年春夏以来感沐天慈三辅，频叨两泽兆丰有象。故兹堂升联情，用示慈惠至。于所陈各戏正如云岫风箫，适然相值而已。 ）
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 澄虚榭, 1808. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 澄虚榭: 嘉庆二十三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆二十三年 (1818), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 千顷波光绕榭澄，蜃窗小憩得临凭。风含锦縠往还叠，日射金鳞远近乘。杨柳披熏碧条漾，楼台倒影翠奁凝。凌虚可望三山境，福被寰瀛勉敬承。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 澄虚榭, 1818, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 日下舊聞考 澡身浴德
excerpt_zh: 澡身浴徳之北度河橋為望瀛洲其北為深桞讀書堂堂北為溪月松風（圓明園册）臣等謹按望瀛洲額皇上御書深桞讀書堂溪月松風額皆世宗御書
summary_en: North over a bridge from 澡身浴徳: 望瀛洲, then 深桞讀書堂 and 溪月松風.

title: 日下舊聞考 澡身浴德、福海
excerpt_zh: 澡身浴徳在福海西南隅即澄虛榭正宇三楹東嚮南為含清暉北為涵妙識折而西向為静香館又西為解愠書屋西南為曠然閣（圓明園册）臣等謹按福海亦稱東湖周廣凡數頃澡身浴徳四十景之一也額為皇上御書聫曰好雨知時岑巒添逺碧薰風叶奏殿閣有餘清亦御書
summary_en: In the south-west corner of 福海: 澡身浴徳, the three-bay 澄虛榭 facing east, with 含清暉, 涵妙識, 静香館, 解愠書屋 and 曠然閣. The note calls 福海 also 東湖 East Lake, several qing around.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 澄虚榭
locator: from p.259, under 澡身浴德
summary_en: 澄虚榭: 20 dated items, 1759-1818, of which 20 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1759, last dated 1818.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 望瀛洲
locator: from p.261, under 澡身浴德
summary_en: 望瀛洲: 7 dated items, 1764-1805, of which 7 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1764, last dated 1805.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 解愠书屋
locator: from p.262, under 澡身浴德
summary_en: 解愠书屋: 6 dated items, 1764-1805, of which 6 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: reading, escaping the heat. First dated 1764, last dated 1805.

title: Scenes 30, 31, 33, 36, 37: the shores of 福海
excerpt_other: These scenes show scattered houses, pavilions, terraces, and bridges which occupied the narrow strip of shore and the surrounding hills on the north, east, and west of the Happy Sea.
summary_en: 澡身浴德, 平湖秋月, 接秀山房, 涵虚朗鉴, 廓然大公: scattered houses, pavilions, terraces and bridges on the shore strip and hills north, east and west of 福海. Malone gives no more for these five.

title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v2, editors' note on 澡身浴德
summary_en: A three-bay hall 澄虚榭 facing east at the south-west of 福海, with 含清晖, 涵妙识, 静香馆, 解愠书屋, 旷然阁 near. North are 延真院, 溪山罨画, the square 望瀛洲, 深柳读书堂, 溪月松风. Emperors watched the dragon boats from here.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 澡身浴德
locator: from p.258, under 澡身浴德
summary_en: The compiler describes 澄虚榭, a three-bay hall facing east at the south-west of 福海, and the square shore pavilion 望瀛洲 from which Qianlong watched dragon boats; Jiaqing watched from 澄虚榭. 澡身浴德: short note in the compilation, no dated items.

title: 三幅样式雷圆明园河道全图辨析: earth moved
summary_en: One listed change between plans: the hill at 澡身浴德 was removed and earth was added beside 藏舟坞, south-east of 方壶胜境, and east of 三潭印月, spoil from dredging being the usual source. Useful for the hills layer on the east shore.

title: 澄虚榭
locator: v2 p.345, under 澡身浴德; source ref 14-474
excerpt_zh: 惟虚故能澄，是乃言乎水。春寒冰未消，而榭亦对此。然无碍其澄，冰水原一理。照影静弗动，更觉此
summary_en: Poem 澄虚榭 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1781, filed by the editors under 澡身浴德.

title: 澄虚榭
locator: v2 p.346, under 澡身浴德; source ref 14-595
excerpt_zh: 水榭俯平湖，澄虚在眼前。循名今略殊，以犹结冰坚。责实邻无当，而予有进焉。冰下非水乎，其虚自依然。更协中孚义，即景悟羲编。
summary_en: Poem 澄虚榭 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1782, filed by the editors under 澡身浴德.

title: 含清晖室咏【乾】
locator: v2 p.354, under 澡身浴德; source ref 19-289
excerpt_zh: 清晖含得一轩中，四季虽同致不同。幸是逢年心略慰，依然盼捷意犹忡。满窗暖爱赵衰日，三面雄辞宋玉风。旧咏新题一瞬目，三年惭愧迅无穷。
summary_en: Poem 含清晖室咏【乾】 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1798, filed by the editors under 澡身浴德.

title: 静香馆
locator: v2 p.341, under 澡身浴德; source ref 8-808
excerpt_zh: 回廊多曲折，闲馆致幽深。药蕊飘清馥，桐柯布翠阴。鱼飞常入镜，蝉韵自调琴。嗅复翳根静，云香何处寻。
summary_en: Poem 静香馆 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 澡身浴德.

title: 静香馆
locator: v2 p.343, under 澡身浴德; source ref 9-323
excerpt_zh: 曲廊偏有趣，闲馆致无华。可以消清暇，於焉味静嘉。砌花常递馥，林鸟亦非哗。新筍才抽叶，墙头几个斜。
summary_en: Poem 静香馆 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1767, filed by the editors under 澡身浴德.

title: 解愠书屋
locator: v2 p.341, under 澡身浴德; source ref 8-825
excerpt_zh: 选题额柍枨，虞帝昔闻遵。解愠言何易，民碞畏是真。稍欣暑雨过，披得爽风新。万宝西成后，庶几鲜馑贫。
summary_en: Poem 解愠书屋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 澡身浴德.

title: 解愠书屋作歌
locator: v2 p.342, under 澡身浴德; source ref 9-102
excerpt_zh: 我思虞廷，去尧之世未曰遥。不识不知，其民淳朴之风犹应饶。云何舜帝挥五弦，尔日乃有“南风谣”。愠者不平之气或致怨，而胡有于重华之际，欲借薰风消。是知昊代不如羲年，非虚语。大禹下车泣罪，心诚焦。何况三千载，递降于斯时也。岂可与古相较，风俗之淳浇。吁哉，民碞实可畏，愠岂易解哉。吾惟对此惭旰宵。
summary_en: Poem 解愠书屋作歌 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1765, filed by the editors under 澡身浴德.

title: 旷然阁
locator: v2 p.340, under 澡身浴德; source ref 8-808
excerpt_zh: 室里那知更有楼，拾梯登喜俯沧洲。春秋风月因心会，上下水天与目谋。籁爽每从窗处度，波光常向座间浮。旷然设问相宜句，顺应惟兹任物酬。
summary_en: Poem 旷然阁 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 澡身浴德.

title: 旷然阁
locator: v2 p.346, under 澡身浴德; source ref 14-599
excerpt_zh: 层阁高临冻浦边，嫩阳积素玉生烟。沿堤细柳犹迟放，纵目真教意旷然。
summary_en: Poem 旷然阁 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1782, filed by the editors under 澡身浴德.

title: 望瀛洲亭子
locator: v2 p.337, under 澡身浴德; source ref 5-155
excerpt_zh: 骤雨过河源，碧天爽气来。落景照东宇，赤城赩崔嵬。非烟亦非云，如楼复如台。虹桥若可蹑，佺羡相追陪。亭子琳池西，望瀛名久哉。今朝乃领要，俨然见蓬莱。可望不可即，劳者非仙才。
summary_en: Poem 望瀛洲亭子 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1753, filed by the editors under 澡身浴德.

title: 恭和御制望瀛洲歌元韵（106）
excerpt_zh: 蓬瀛競侈谈，缥缈何人到。安期与羡门，海峤空诱导。垂裳远屏不经词，轩榭楼台聊试为。清波万顷涵上下，景光瀰漫纹沦漪。福海之中树金阙，轻风吹浪看滂渤。遥峰倒映漠漠云，平林低蘸亭亭月。空明镜澈四面环，始信神山在世间。圣人几闻舒茂对，中流放櫂超尘寰。仁智娱情亦云偶，观澜察理撝谦受。泽润生民寿宇恢，丰稔盈宁欢九有。
summary_en: Poem 恭和御制望瀛洲歌元韵（106） by the Qianlong Emperor, 1788, filed by the editors under 春熙院.

title: 養吉齋叢錄 卷十四
locator: 卷十四, line 954 of the corpus file
excerpt_zh: 自后遇午日，宫中每以龙舟酬节。圣祖御制有五日泛舟赐大臣侍卫宴诗。乾隆间，五日则奉慈舆至御园观龙舟。圣驾在望瀛洲，亭名。王公大臣及内廷诃臣亦得与宴赏。其东则蓬岛、瑶台，皇太后观竞渡处也。嘉庆间，移于澄虚榭宴赏。高宗诗云：「中流九龙舟，谁肯相参差。」仁宗诗云：「九龙顺轨原无竞。」据此可识龙舟之数。又按：北地四、五月往往少雨，如届节未沛甘霖，即罢此戏。道光初年，尚沿竞 渡故事。其后停止。
summary_en: Dragon boat day on 福海: the emperor in the 望瀛洲 pavilion under Qianlong with his mother on the 蓬島瑶臺 to the east; moved to 澄虛榭 under Jiaqing; stopped under Daoguang. Nine boats by the poems.

title: 世宗 深栁讀書堂 (園景十二詠)
date: before 1723 (雍邸集, printed as written while a prince)
excerpt_zh:
深栁讀書堂
欝欝千株栁隂隂覆草堂飄絲拂硯石飛絮㸃琴牀鶯囀春枝暖蟬鳴秋葉凉夜來窓月影掩映簡編香
summary_en: One of Yongzheng's twelve garden poems written while a prince: a thatched hall under a thousand willows, with catkins on the inkstone and the qin. Rixia j82:15a puts 深桞讀書堂 at 澡身浴徳, while Qianlong's 1755 note says 雙鶴齋 was once called this, so the place is not settled.

title: 深柳读书堂
excerpt_zh: 郁郁千株柳，阴阴覆草堂。飘丝拂砚石，飞絮点琴床。莺啭春枝暖，蝉鸣秋叶凉。夜来窗月影，掩映简编香。
summary_en: Poem 深柳读书堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1788, filed by the editors under 春熙院.

title: 世宗 深栁讀書堂消夏
excerpt_zh:
深栁讀書堂消夏
麴塵綠染萬條絲窣地濃隂暑暗移旋漬霜毫鋪玉版細研荷露寫新詩一天月色畵圗古兩部蛙聲鼓吹竒瀟灑樓臺臨碧水夜深倒影静垂垂
summary_en: Summer at 深栁讀書堂: willow shade, and a tower reflected in clear water at night.

title: 世宗 深栁讀書堂避暑
excerpt_zh:
深栁讀書堂避暑
三庚節届祝融臨閒對明忩閲古箴樹杪鶯喉調妙曲檻邉蝶翅舞芳襟嫩荷香逺風頻逓深栁隂重暑不侵移榻簾前何所思要賡觧阜入虞琴
summary_en: Escaping the heat at 深栁讀書堂: birds, butterflies, scented lotus and a couch by the blind.

title: 深柳读书堂消夏（348）
locator: v2 p.336, under 澡身浴德
excerpt_zh: 曲尘绿染万条丝，窣地浓阴暑暗移。旋渍霜毫铺玉版，细研荷露写新诗。一天月色画图古，雨部蛙声鼓吹奇。潇洒楼台临碧水，夜深倒影静垂垂。
summary_en: Poem 深柳读书堂消夏（348） by the  Emperor, filed by the editors under 澡身浴德.

title: 赋得溪月松风叠旧作韵
locator: v2 p.339, under 澡身浴德; source ref 8-790
excerpt_zh: 松风四季总相宜，溪月三间常映楣。云似画时偏惬照，欲吟诗际恰摅思。天行浩浩几余乐，圣仰循循从末悲。虽曰瞠乎宁不懋，况兹精义示贻遗。
summary_en: Poem 赋得溪月松风叠旧作韵 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 澡身浴德.

title: 御製平湖秋月詞（調寄浣溪紗）（圓明園四十景詩）
excerpt_zh:
乾隆九年 御製平湖秋月詞（調寄浣溪紗）
倚山面湖竹樹䝉密左右支板橋以通步屐湖可數十頃當秋深月皎㶑灧波光接天無際蘇公隄畔差足方兹勝概
不辨天光與水光結璘池館慶宵涼蓼煙荷露正蒼茫　白傅蘇公風雅客一杯相勸舞霓裳此時誰不道錢塘
summary_en: Set against a hill and facing the lake, with dense bamboo and plank bridges on either side. The lake runs to tens of qing, and on deep autumn nights moon and water merge, close to the view by 蘇公隄 Su Causeway.

title: 君子轩: 乾隆二十四年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十四年 (1759), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 吾亦爱箖箊，琅玕绕砌除。自将俗事远，如与善人居。古月度时白，清风拂处虚。从来戒旨酒，嵇阮岂希渠。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 君子轩, 1759, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 藏密楼: 乾隆二十四年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十四年 (1759), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 屋里通云磴，檐头出月轩。往来悦神智，阖辟具乾坤。真得壶中趣，堪忘象外言。俯凭千顷碧，是我洗心源。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 藏密楼, 1759, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 夏隐亭: 乾隆二十五年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十五年 (1760), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 小亭名夏隐，叶密藏檐宇。匪慕彼黄公，乃自我作古。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 夏隐亭, 1760, on escaping the heat. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 藏密楼: 乾隆二十五年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十五年 (1760), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 丹梯拾级因高迥，绿牖凭虚纳远通。闭户恰宜读周易，庶几津逮洗心同。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 藏密楼, 1760. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 君子轩: 乾隆二十六年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十六年 (1761), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 万个围三间，过雨翠如洗。入秋意已凉，筛月光犹美。风度曲江张，潇洒山东李。更有胜人处，自不道君子。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 君子轩, 1761, on rain and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 夏隐亭: 乾隆四十七年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆四十七年 (1782), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 四山秃树阴未鎻，亭故翼然当面呈。 （夏隐者谓四面皆树，至夏则亭隐而不见也。 ）设使质之夏小海，此时其隐恐难成。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 夏隐亭, 1782, on escaping the heat. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 夏隐亭: 乾隆五十八年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆五十八年 (1793), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 一亭四面绕林枝，常见惟应隐夏时。设以风流人比拟，是诚灵宝贾希之。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 夏隐亭, 1793, on escaping the heat. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 藏密楼: 乾隆五十八年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆五十八年 (1793), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 委宛得层居，遂以蔵密名。斯虽述易言，而吾更有评。潜修贵洗心，明扬要通情。大公而顺应，夫岂独善能。吉凶同民患，继言理实明。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 藏密楼, 1793, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 君子轩: 乾隆六十年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆六十年 (1795), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 曲径琅玕步以徐，书轩片刻适闲居。植中底合称君子，有节依然心复虚。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 君子轩, 1795, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 镜远洲: 嘉庆十五年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十五年 (1810), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 百顷平湖印素秋，新成芳墅镜清流。霞光迭绮白苹渚，波影含风红蓼洲。细飏菊香低砌下，高翻雁字远峰头。天澄时洽田功毕，佳景欣从物外求。
summary_en: Jiaqing, 1810, on the rebuilt part of 平湖秋月 with its new plaque.

title: 镜远洲: 嘉庆十五年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十五年 (1810), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 千顷苍茫秋水清，开奁宝铙现光明。远含洲渚一庭纳，高印云霞九宇莹。林外峰峦舒右臂，波心台榭即东瀛。游观适可娱几睱，习字拈题养性情。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 镜远洲, 1810, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 镜远洲: 嘉庆二十五年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆二十五年 (1820), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 春水波涵远，光浮一鉴中。风添细缯绿，日叠锦鳞红。澄澈心源印，虚明眼界融。韶华满上苑，丽景蔼长空。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 镜远洲, 1820, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 平湖秋月: 道光三年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
date: 道光三年 (1823), date from the compilation
locator: p.263 item (1), under 平湖秋月
excerpt_zh: 平湖日午泛轻航，飒飒南风喜送凉。鸣籁青松遮碧嶂，含芳紫槿映虚堂。倏看雨脚疎还密，乍听雷声隐复扬。四望溟蒙涵妙景，瀛洲图书水中央。
summary_en: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 平湖秋月, 1823, on rain and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 平湖秋月: 道光四年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
date: 道光四年 (1824), date from the compilation
locator: p.263 item (2), under 平湖秋月
excerpt_zh: 已欣春雪遍沾濡，何幸甘霖润似酥。近户点波声淅沥，隔溪羃树影模糊。新正嘉泽真难遇，开岁鸿慈沐更殊。预庆来牟兆丰稔，虚窗对处寸心愉。
summary_en: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 平湖秋月, 1824, on rain and the harvest. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 平湖秋月: 咸丰七年 poem of the Xianfeng Emperor
date: 咸丰七年 (1857), date from the compilation
locator: p.263 item (7), under 平湖秋月
excerpt_zh:
鹜望平湖雨似麻，丝丝作势趁
风斜。一痕湿霭横林幄，无限凉飔透户纱。饼饵添香田畔麦，臙脂挹润槛前花。屡膺吴眷弥增惕，从此旬沾徧迩遐。
summary_en: Poem of the Xianfeng Emperor at 平湖秋月, 1857, on rain and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 日下舊聞考 平湖秋月、福海
excerpt_zh: 平湖秋月在福海西北隅正宇三楹西為流水音東北出山口臨河為花嶼蘭皋折而東南度橋為兩峯挿雲又東南為山水樂其北為君子軒為藏密樓（圓明園册）臣等謹按平湖秋月四十景之一額為世宗御書流水音花嶼蘭皋諸額為皇上御書
summary_en: In the north-west corner of 福海: 平湖秋月, three bays, with 流水音, 花嶼蘭皋, 兩峯挿雲, 山水樂, 君子軒 and 藏密樓.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 平湖秋月
locator: from p.263, under 平湖秋月
summary_en: 平湖秋月: 8 dated items, 1744-1857, of which 7 poems and 1 court records (Qianlong, Daoguang, Xianfeng); recurring themes: the view, rain, the harvest. First dated 1744, last dated 1857.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 君子轩
locator: from p.264, under 平湖秋月
summary_en: 君子轩: 6 dated items, 1759-1795, of which 6 poems (Qianlong); recurring themes: the view, rain. First dated 1759, last dated 1795.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 藏密楼
locator: from p.264, under 平湖秋月
summary_en: 藏密楼: 4 dated items, 1759-1793, of which 4 poems (Qianlong); recurring themes: reading, the view. First dated 1759, last dated 1793.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 夏隐亭
locator: from p.265, under 平湖秋月
summary_en: 夏隐亭: 6 dated items, 1760-1793, of which 6 poems (Qianlong); recurring themes: escaping the heat, the view. First dated 1760, last dated 1793.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 镜远洲
locator: from p.265, under 平湖秋月
summary_en: In 1810 Jiaqing rebuilt part of 平湖秋月 and gave it this new plaque; he wrote on the lake view here every year to 1820. It has no row in the building list. 镜远洲: 12 dated items, 1810-1820, of which 12 poems (Jiaqing); recurring themes: the view, snow, escaping the heat. First dated 1810, last dated 1820.

title: 《国家图书馆藏样式雷图档·圆明园卷初编》: 平湖秋月
date: mostly 道光, 咸丰, 同治 per the publisher
locator: 初编 目录: 平湖秋月, p.441
summary_en: The printed facsimile of the National Library of China's Yangshi Lei sheets has a section on this place at p.441 (1 pages, section length worked out from the next heading); sheet titles and numbers are in the volume, ordered from a library.

title: 流水音
locator: v2 p.371, under 澡身浴德; source ref 1-280
excerpt_zh: 叠石注溪汇碧浔，坐听流水出清音。琮琤韵激波仍活，戛击声连池更深。玩世漫论巢父耳，怀人思入伯牙琴。澄潭玉宇光相印，一室空明契静心。
summary_en: Poem 流水音 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1797, filed by the editors under 澡身浴德.

title: 流水音
locator: v2 p.372, under 澡身浴德; source ref 1-322
excerpt_zh: 叠石崚嶒泉细注，泠然岩底出清音。静聆逸调来空外，一洗筝琶俗韵侵。
summary_en: Poem 流水音 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1798, filed by the editors under 澡身浴德.

title: 君子轩
locator: v2 p.367, under 澡身浴德; source ref 6-729
excerpt_zh: 吾亦爱箖箊，琅玕饶砌除。自将俗事远，如与善人居。古月度时白，清风拂处虚。从来戒旨酒，嵇阮岂希渠。
summary_en: Poem 君子轩 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1759, filed by the editors under 澡身浴德.

title: 君子轩
locator: v2 p.369, under 澡身浴德; source ref 8-763
excerpt_zh: 一迳入琅玕，三间藏宛委。众芳尚迟迟，万个只如此。标形皆玉亭，作响乃金止。雅宜风月契，宁藉龙凤比。惟斯不改度，信足称君子。
summary_en: Poem 君子轩 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 澡身浴德.

title: 藏密楼
locator: v2 p.368, under 澡身浴德; source ref 7-303
excerpt_zh: 丹梯拾级因髙迥，绿牖凭虚纳远通。闭户恰宜读周易，庶几津逮洗心同。
summary_en: Poem 藏密楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1760, filed by the editors under 澡身浴德.

title: 藏密楼
locator: v2 p.368, under 澡身浴德; source ref 8-422
excerpt_zh: 宣尼十翼称藏密，艺祖诸门乃洞开。诠易求心不求迹，田何阳叔可能哉。
summary_en: Poem 藏密楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1761, filed by the editors under 澡身浴德.

title: 御製蓬島瑶臺詩（圓明園四十景詩）
excerpt_zh:
乾隆九年 御製蓬島瑶臺詩
福海中作大小三島仿李思訓畫意為仙山樓閣之狀岧岧亭亭望之若金堂五所玉樓十二也真忘一如小大一如能知此是三壺方丈便可半升鐺内煮江山
名葩綽約草葳㽔隠映仙家白玉墀天上畫圖懸日月水中樓閣浸琉璃鷺拳淨沼波翻雪燕賀新巢棟有芝海外方蓬原宇内祖龍鞭石竟奚為
summary_en: Large and small islands in 福海, made after 李思訓's paintings as immortal towers on peaks; they look like the 'five golden halls and twelve jade towers'. Size is an illusion, he says: know that, and these are the sacred isles.

title: 蓬岛瑶台雪中即景
locator: v2 p.389, under 蓬岛瑶台; source ref 5-187
excerpt_zh: 瑞景离奇宝镜开，镜中楼阁是瑶台。三壶玉积长青柏，万树花装不馥梅。徐福漫驱千户去，子登常按八琅来。纽芽莩甲知何许，验取心田茁道荄。
summary_en: Poem 蓬岛瑶台雪中即景 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1754, filed by the editors under 蓬岛瑶台.

title: 御製 端陽日奉皇太后觀龍舟
excerpt_zh:
端陽日奉皇太后觀龍舟
麥臨芒種蔚禾田應莭亶宜侍糉筵沅浦寜須問芳芷湯泉恰已貢新蓮欣陪鳯扇如恒月訝指龍舟忽隔年蓬島瑶䑓（在福海中為圓明園四十）（景之一嵗嵗扵此奉皇太后觀龍舟）仙樂奏董雙成至按氷絃
summary_en: Dragon boat day. His note says that every year he brought his mother to 蓬島瑶臺 to watch the boats.

title: 畅襟楼: 乾隆三十二年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十二年 (1767), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 湖心轩榭写蓬瀛，旁有书楼俯碧清。岂是虚无候仙侣，居然经史乐平生。远堤四面柳桃绘，春水一泓鳬雁鸣。设问畅襟真畅处，端惟时雨与时晴。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 畅襟楼, 1767. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 御製 蓬島瑤臺
excerpt_zh:
蓬島瑤臺
蓬島瑶臺福海中（蓬島瑶臺圓明圍四十景之一福海亦舊名也）往來祇藉舟相通昨近冰脆魚陟負拕床弗可舟艱衝還宮四日倐瞥眼再來春水呈溶溶鳴榔直到鏡中閣（臺南門也）迴看畫舫浮雲空若臺若榭皆熟境庭松峙翠盆花紅不如可望不可即引人企思翻無窮
summary_en: Reached only by boat, and over ice when the water is frozen. His note calls 鏡中閣 the south gate of the terrace, and he mentions courtyard pines and potted flowers.

title: 畅襟楼: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 楼据湖中央，（是湖为园中最广廓者向名福海）四面雅宜望。因有畅襟名，画意镜面漾。是实还是虚，胸襟原可畅。而我值盼捷，南瞻益惆怅。似楼隐笑人，底须拾级访。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 畅襟楼, 1796, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 蓬岛瑶台
locator: v2 p.396, under 蓬岛瑶台; source ref 1-114
excerpt_zh: 福海御园东，瑶台峙水中。三山连阁迥，万顷漾波融。映日辉珠阙，凌霞接阆风。玉京欣可到，灵境一舟通。
summary_en: Poem 蓬岛瑶台 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1796, filed by the editors under 蓬岛瑶台.

title: 畅襟楼: 嘉庆八年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆八年 (1803), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 千顷碧波绕蓬岛，层楼高出凌苍颢。四面沧浪心镜舒，尘虑于兹可暂扫。登临岂独畅襟怀，虑澹清漪天水浩。西峰云气接遥林，静俟甘霖起枯槁。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 畅襟楼, 1803, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 日下舊聞考 蓬岛瑶台、福海
excerpt_zh: 蓬島瑶臺在福海中央門三楹南嚮正殿七楹殿前東為暢襟樓西為神洲三島東偏為隨安室西偏為日日平安報好音由蓬島瑶臺東南度橋為東島有亭為瀛海仙山西北度橋為北島正宇三楹（圓明園册）臣等謹按蓬島瑶臺四十景之一舊名蓬萊洲後易今名額為皇上御書門額曰鏡中閣與暢襟樓隨安室額皆御書神洲三島日日平安報好音瀛海仙山諸額皆世宗御書
summary_en: Centre of 福海: a three-bay gate facing south and seven-bay main hall, with 暢襟樓, 神洲三島, 隨安室 and 日日平安報好音; bridges to an east isle with the pavilion 瀛海仙山 and a north isle with a three-bay range. Formerly 蓬萊洲.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 畅襟楼
locator: from p.256, under 蓬岛瑶台
summary_en: 畅襟楼: 6 dated items, 1767-1803, of which 6 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1767, last dated 1803.

title: Six paintings, I: 蓬岛瑶台 Pengdao Yaotai
excerpt_other: offre une vaste étendue d'eau qui embrasse trois îles liées l'une à l'autre par deux ponts.
summary_en: Delatour owned six Chinese paintings of the garden, described by the garden writer Morel. Identifications here are mine, by form. Three islands, two bridges; large island with four building ranges round a square court on a stone plinth, one pavilion with an upper floor; smaller island with two ranges and walls; smallest with a mound and an open hexagonal kiosk on six columns; water lilies.

title: Scene 32, 蓬岛瑶台 Pengdao Yaotai
excerpt_other: The central island was occupied by a little palace courtyard, decorated with glazed tile, and connected by bridges with the smaller islands lying to the northwest and east.
summary_en: Central island with a small palace court and glazed tile; bridges to the north-west island, also built over, and the east island, a rustic retreat with pavilion, rocks and trees. Decorated after a painting by the Tang artist 李思训 Li Sixun.

title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v2, editors' note on 蓬岛瑶台
summary_en: Yongzheng's 蓬莱洲, on the islands in 福海. Gate 镜中阁, seven-bay two-roll main hall with a five-bay annex, 畅襟楼, 神洲三岛, 留春殿, 日日平安报好音; an east island with a hexagonal pavilion and a north island. The editors say being in the water spared it in 1860, and it burned in the seventh month of 1870.

title: 御製 題暢襟樓
excerpt_zh:
題暢襟樓
湖心軒榭寫蓬瀛（是䖏在福海中央即蓬島瑶臺為圓眀園四十景之一）旁有書樓俯碧清豈是虚無候仙侣居然經史樂平生逺隄四面栁桃繪春水一泓鳬雁鳴設問暢襟真暢䖏端惟時雨與時晴
summary_en: In the middle of the lake 福海: a tower for books looking over the water, with willows and peach on the far dykes.

title: 畅襟楼
locator: v2 p.392, under 蓬岛瑶台; source ref 11-257
excerpt_zh: 拾级上书楼，新波眼底浮。茁犹勒蒲芷，浴已下凫鸥。菱格斜窗展，柳丝远岸柔。须臾襟畅耳，难忘是先忧。
summary_en: Poem 畅襟楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1772, filed by the editors under 蓬岛瑶台.

title: 题畅襟楼
locator: v2 p.392, under 蓬岛瑶台; source ref 12-671
excerpt_zh: 高楼耐可纵遐观，日丽风和了不寒。试问吾襟何以畅，曰惟物阜与民安。
summary_en: Poem 题畅襟楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1775, filed by the editors under 蓬岛瑶台.

title: 御製 暢襟樓
date: c. 1795, inferred from the last dated heading (御製詩五集)
excerpt_zh:
暢襟樓
石梯拾級試登臨舊有樓題曰暢襟小坐七年迅瞥眼（樓在蓬島瑶臺之側丁亥始顔此額題以句并自後壬辰乙未丙午戊申共詩五首懸之楣間閲今又七年矣）㡬曽一暢本来心
summary_en: Note: the plaque went up in 丁亥 1767, and his five earlier poems hang on its lintel. Reached by a stone stair.

title: 御製 暢襟樓
excerpt_zh:
暢襟樓
樓據湖中央（是湖為園中㝡廣廓者向名福海）四面雅宜望因有暢襟名畫意鏡面漾是實還是虚胸襟原可暢而我值盼捷南瞻益惆悵似樓隠笑人底須拾級訪
summary_en: Written in retirement. The tower stands in the middle of the lake that the note calls the widest in the garden, 福海.

title: 瀛海仙山（133）
locator: v2 p.408, under 蓬岛瑶台
excerpt_zh: 仙瀛偶访步层峦，半月高台夏亦寒。入望烟岚云外赏，凌虚楼阁画中看。穿林窈窕青松磴，护岸周遭白石栏。雨霁空明澄万象，畅观只觉水天宽。
summary_en: Poem 瀛海仙山（133） by the Daoguang Emperor, 1823, filed by the editors under 蓬岛瑶台.

title: 瀛海仙山口号（173）
locator: v2 p.410, under 蓬岛瑶台
excerpt_zh: 天光云影湛晴波，习习南薰静里过。知命乐天慎修德，长生仙药竟如何。
summary_en: Poem 瀛海仙山口号（173） by the Daoguang Emperor, 1824, filed by the editors under 蓬岛瑶台.

title: 御製接秀山房詩（圓明園四十景詩）
excerpt_zh:
乾隆九年 御製接秀山房詩
平岡縈迴碧沚停蓄虛館閒閒境獨夷曠隔岸數峯逞秀朝嵐霏青返照添紫氣象萬千真目不給賞情不周玩也
烟霞供潤浥朝暮㸔適興户接西山秀窻臨北渚澄琴書吾所好松竹古之朋仿彿雲林衲攜笻共我豋
summary_en: Low ridges and a green-water pool make a quiet, open place. Across the water peaks show their beauty, blue-green at morning and purple at dusk, more than the eye can take in.

title: 接秀山房: 乾隆十八年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆十八年 (1753), date from the compilation
locator: p.272 item (1), under 接秀山房
excerpt_zh: 雨足诸凡好，西山送秀来。爽真在襟袖，润直到根荄。圣日常悬照，薫风正阜财。徘徊瞻宝额，讶似过庭纔。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 接秀山房, 1753, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 接秀山房: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation
locator: p.272 item (2), under 接秀山房
excerpt_zh: 山房得地崇，径曲巧相就。近览一湖清，遥接千峰秀。明霞衬疎林，秋高净宇宙。颢气下松风，翠影仍繁茂。极浦印征鸿，飞鸣问古堠。喜趁片时闲，看云出远岫。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 接秀山房, 1796, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 接秀山房
locator: v3 p.7, under 接秀山房; source ref 1-229
excerpt_zh: 远接西山秀，晴空印翠螺。窗虚延列嶂，柳细荫平坡。梅雨期须继，花风信早过。抚时念耕作，农事近如何。
summary_en: Poem 接秀山房 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1797, filed by the editors under 接秀山房.

title: 接秀山房
locator: v3 p.7, under 接秀山房; source ref 1-280
excerpt_zh: 山房舒眺景高爽，福海凭临印影峩。日映金波冲岸角，林飘锦叶下岩阿。遥辉绝壁翻红树，直接群峰滴翠螺。鼓棹还过前浦去，东篱花事问如何。
summary_en: Poem 接秀山房 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1797, filed by the editors under 接秀山房.

title: 接秀山房: 嘉庆三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆三年 (1798), date from the compilation
locator: p.272 item (4), under 接秀山房
excerpt_zh: 掩映西峰秀相接，山房高敞挹虚峦。冥冥花雾云边合，落落松风天半寒。霞绘三霄青嶂表，日烘五色翠崖端。游神八极归冲漠，漫挟飞仙驾彩鸾。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 接秀山房, 1798. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 观澜堂: 嘉庆二十四年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆二十四年 (1819), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh:
福海新波千顷宽，
堂开东岸对漪澜。金鳞映日轻霞漾，碧浪含风薄縠攒。和蔼韶光明远岫，微茫云影印遥滩。田功肇始仲春届，观我观民得大观。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 观澜堂, 1819, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 观澜堂: 嘉庆二十四年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆二十四年 (1819), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 八窗印晴晖，空明临碧沼。远岭写春霞，绮影绘天表。蓬岛水中央，金碧浮㵿渺。漪澜送暖飔，岸角迭环绕。昨岁驻渝关，沧溟观浩淼。心境养虚明，眼界随大小。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 观澜堂, 1819, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 观澜堂: 咸丰七年 poem of the Xianfeng Emperor
date: 咸丰七年 (1857), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 御苑东偏蓬岛南，山妆翠髻水拖蓝。连云远树分浓淡，点浪轻鸥见两三。鼓枻湖心波皛皛，停桡岸角柳毶毶。虚堂旷览足怡悦，霁景澄鲜上下含。
summary_en: Poem of the Xianfeng Emperor at 观澜堂, 1857, on boating. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 日下舊聞考 接秀山房、福海
excerpt_zh: 接秀山房在福海東隅正宇三楹西嚮後稍東為琴趣軒其北方樓為尋雲東南為澄練樓樓後為怡然書屋尋雲樓稍東佛室為安隠幢接秀山房之南為攬翠亭（圓明園册）臣等謹按接秀山房四十景之一與攬翠亭額皆世宗御書琴趣軒尋雲諸額皆皇上御書
summary_en: East of 福海: 接秀山房, three bays facing west, with 琴趣軒, the square tower 尋雲, 澄練樓, 怡然書屋, the Buddha room 安隠幢 and 攬翠亭.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 接秀山房
locator: from p.272, under 接秀山房
summary_en: 接秀山房: 4 dated items, 1753-1798, of which 4 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1753, last dated 1798.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 观澜堂
summary_en: The compiler says 观鱼跃 was pulled down about 1817 for a new south-facing hall of five bays in three rolls, like 慎德堂 and the largest on 福海. 观澜堂: 13 dated items, 1819-1857, of which 13 poems (Jiaqing, Daoguang, Xianfeng); recurring themes: the view, boating, rain. First dated 1819, last dated 1857.

title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 接秀山房
summary_en: Begun 1731 on the south-east shore of 福海, a three-bay west-facing hall, with 琴趣轩, 寻云楼, 云锦墅, 澄练楼, 怡然书屋 and 揽翠亭 under Qianlong. Late Jiaqing replaced the main hall with five bays in three rolls, 观澜堂. The editors say that hall survived 1860, Cixi came in 1898, and it was lost around 1900.

title: 观澜堂平面图
date: 咸丰五年 (1855) 八月初十日
locator: 国家图书馆善本部 样042-11-2号
summary_en: Survey base plan of the Guanlan Tang hall dated 10th of the 8th month, 1855. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

title: 《国家图书馆藏样式雷图档·圆明园卷初编》: 接秀山房
date: mostly 道光, 咸丰, 同治 per the publisher
locator: 初编 目录: 接秀山房, pp.446-459
summary_en: The printed facsimile of the National Library of China's Yangshi Lei sheets has a section on this place at pp.446-459 (14 pages, section length worked out from the next heading); sheet titles and numbers are in the volume, ordered from a library.

title: 琴趣轩
locator: v3 p.2, under 接秀山房; source ref 8-676
excerpt_zh: 不学陶家弦亦无，底夸李氏宝称孤。暗泉滴处声同调，只有徵招意廑吾。
summary_en: Poem 琴趣轩 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1763, filed by the editors under 接秀山房.

title: 琴趣轩口号
locator: v3 p.3, under 接秀山房; source ref 8-747
excerpt_zh: 无弦亦不壁间悬，琴趣居然在目前。小矣高山流水志，企之解愠阜财篇。
summary_en: Poem 琴趣轩口号 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 接秀山房.

title: 题澄练楼
locator: v3 p.2, under 接秀山房; source ref 8-682
excerpt_zh: 湖上乘舟至，登楼更望湖。一层高位置，万象顿形殊。岂藉天孙织，分明少女铺。今朝宜有喜，喜在稻苗腴。
summary_en: Poem 题澄练楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1763, filed by the editors under 接秀山房.

title: 题澄练楼
locator: v3 p.3, under 接秀山房; source ref 8-775
excerpt_zh: 乘舟偶至临湖楼，不爱舟中爱楼上。于楼为静舟为动，一例澄湖披荡漾。是时春仲景方明，况当雨后波新涨。倒影花光漪浅纹，冰夷窃得天孙样，设如拟议浣纱溪，洗尽越吴机械障。
summary_en: Poem 题澄练楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 接秀山房.

title: 怡然书屋偶题
locator: v3 p.2, under 接秀山房; source ref 8-673
excerpt_zh: 架是琳琅笥，床非玳瑁筵。识名探义府，玩象汲神渊。少暇惭茧纸，多愁忆麦田。甘膏渥盈尺，今日始怡然。
summary_en: Poem 怡然书屋偶题 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1763, filed by the editors under 接秀山房.

title: 怡然书屋
locator: v3 p.4, under 接秀山房; source ref 8-792
excerpt_zh: 好春倏度箭催弦，候入清和宜雨天。问我迩来心所托，即时膏澍始怡然。
summary_en: Poem 怡然书屋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 接秀山房.

title: 观澜堂
locator: v3 p.14, under 接秀山房; source ref 7-161
excerpt_zh: 冰奁雪沼映银澜，堂挹虚明欣畅观。北峙群峰印云素，西排列岫染霞丹。境开琼岛心源澈，春满瑶京画幅宽。徒倚回廊舒远目，东风料峭不知寒。
summary_en: Poem 观澜堂 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1819, filed by the editors under 接秀山房.

title: 观澜堂
locator: v3 p.14, under 接秀山房; source ref 7-203
excerpt_zh: 堂临福海岸东偏，坐对晴澜得景全。远叠金鳞涵锦浪，平铺碧縠趁澄渊。霞烘遥渚涤余霭，风度繁林卷密烟。眼界无遮清旷极，又欣快澍润原田。
summary_en: Poem 观澜堂 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1819, filed by the editors under 接秀山房.

title: 别有洞天: 乾隆九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆九年 (1744), date from the compilation
locator: p.274 item (1), under 别有洞天
excerpt_zh: 几席绝尘嚣，草木清且淑。即此凌霞标，何须三十六
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 别有洞天, 1744. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 御製别有洞天詩（圓明園四十景詩）
excerpt_zh:
乾隆九年 御製别有洞天詩
苑牆東出水闗曰秀清村長薄疎林映帶莊墅自有塵外致正不必傾岑峻磵阻絶恒蹊罕得津逮也
几席絶塵囂草木清且淑即此凌霞標何須三十六
summary_en: Beyond the water gate on the east wall lies 秀清村, with thin woods and farmhouses. It has an air of being outside the world without the need for steep cliffs and blocked paths.

title: 延藻樓, 竹宻山齋
excerpt_zh: 延藻樓……假山含峭蒨層室納烟雲……竹宻山齋……愛竹縁他君子節搆房疑此渭川濵
summary_en: Two consecutive poems of 1762, in a run on garden halls. S381 places both at 别有洞天. They settle the plan labels ?漾楼 and 竹??山斋.

title: 活画舫: 乾隆二十七年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十七年 (1762), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 堂高廉远屋之常，近水廉卑偶学航。深广恰依欧永叔，沿洄何异米襄阳。春风秋月有真趣，波态烟容无定方。朅展石渠弃几暇，清河仿佛品题张。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 活画舫, 1762, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 活画舫: 乾隆三十九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十九年 (1774), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 近水斋称活画舫，舣来冰岸却成孤。欲矜藏坞真舫者，可得平湖浮漾无。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 活画舫, 1774, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 别有洞天
locator: v3 p.38, under 别有洞天; source ref 1-116
excerpt_zh: 春日辉暖波，兰桡放遥岸。容与舟徐移，荡桨縠纹乱，溯洄过前溪，隐约有台观。堤柳绿渐披，山桃红始灿。转渚度小桥，境界欣乍换。水静镜开奁，山明云卷幔。仁智乐会心，芳时畅游衎。
summary_en: Poem 别有洞天 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1796, filed by the editors under 别有洞天.

title: 别有洞天: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation
locator: p.274 item (2), under 别有洞天
excerpt_zh: 水村山郭碧溪连，试放兰桡访洞天。石奏泉琴舟可接，岸开花幔径斜穿。波浮藻荇风漪叠，磴挂藤萝日影悬。几暇偶来问清景，所欣雨后意安便。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 别有洞天, 1796, on boating and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 别有洞天
locator: v3 p.39, under 别有洞天; source ref 1-281
excerpt_zh: 漫拟武陵境，缘溪路不遐。一池萦碧浪，三径遍黄花。地僻情欣适，冬初景益嘉。寻幽得胜概，还过竹廊斜。
summary_en: Poem 别有洞天 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1797, filed by the editors under 别有洞天.

title: 活画舫: 嘉庆十六年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十六年 (1811), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 凿木为舟利涉川，象形石舫体弥坚。柔能载重妙相济，艮止坎流义理宣。不动刚坚如是观，中流砥柱定波澜。君犹舟也民犹水，作楫勉思盘石安。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 活画舫, 1811, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 别有洞天: 道光三年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
date: 道光三年 (1823), date from the compilation
locator: p.275 item (15), under 别有洞天
excerpt_zh: 云消气爽喜秋中，山崦花关一水通。别有洞天含秀古，非时卉木闲青红。轻飔飒爽穿虚阁，彩旭熹微映绮栊。徒倚回栏清兴惬，寒蛩唧唧聒幽丛。
summary_en: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 别有洞天, 1823, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 日下舊聞考 别有洞天
excerpt_zh: 接秀山房之南有敞宇北依山南臨河為别有洞天五楹西為納翠樓西南為水木清華之閣閣西稍北為時賞齋（圓明園册）臣等謹按别有洞天四十景之一額與納翠樓水木清華之閣諸額皆皇上御書
summary_en: South of 接秀山房, hill behind and stream before: the five-bay 别有洞天, with 納翠樓, 水木清華之閣 and 時賞齋.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 别有洞天
locator: from p.274, under 别有洞天
summary_en: 别有洞天: 15 dated items, 1744-1823, of which 15 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing, Daoguang); recurring themes: the view, boating, escaping the heat. First dated 1744, last dated 1823.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 活画舫
locator: from p.275, under 别有洞天
summary_en: 活画舫: 5 dated items, 1762-1811, of which 5 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1762, last dated 1811.

title: Scene 34, 别有洞天 Bieyou Dongtian
excerpt_other: It led, as through a cave, to "another sky" and to a small lake surrounded by houses called Hsiu Ch'ing Ts'un, or Beautiful Pure Village.
summary_en: A fortified water gate over the stream behind the hill at the south-east corner of 福海, leading to a small lake and 秀清村 Xiuqing Cun.

title: 别有洞天: 竹密山斋, 延藻楼 and the list of plaques
summary_en: 延藻楼: five-bay east-west building against the wall north-east of 竹密山斋, poem from 1762; gallery windows altered 1778. 竹密山斋 rebuilt 1791 with its east gallery. Xianfeng-era lists give 36 plaques here, half of them unknown earlier: this scene was much altered.

title: 岩水澄华
summary_en: Five-bay hall facing north with a three-bay porch; the area east and west of it was much rebuilt in late Qianlong or early Jiaqing; platform remains can be seen today on the blog's photographs.

title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 别有洞天
summary_en: Begun under Yongzheng, a place of Daoist alchemy. Named halls: main hall five bays in three rolls, 纳翠楼, 水木清华之阁, 时赏斋 with the rock 青云片, the stone-boat 活画舫 of seven bays, 眺爽楼, 秀清村门 to 绮春园. Jiaqing added a five-bay 岩水澄华 and others on the south bank.

title: “洞天福地”说与圆明园“别有洞天”之景观构造
summary_en: Links 别有洞天 Bieyou Dongtian to Daoist cave-heaven ideas and to Yongzheng's alchemy here. 100 x 170 m, 2,050 m2 of buildings, the figures of 百景图志.

title: 老北京的记忆(133): 圆明园别有洞天遗址, quoting 《圆明园百景图志》
summary_en: Scene by scene history and sizes. 1751 main hall rebuilt as three linked rolls and 纳翠楼 added; about 1761 the west side redone after 保定 莲池书院, naming Qianlong's own note. 水木清华之阁 two storeys, 时赏斋 a raised hall. Second-hand: blog quoting 百景图志.

title: 《国家图书馆藏样式雷图档·圆明园卷初编》: 别有洞天
date: mostly 道光, 咸丰, 同治 per the publisher
locator: 初编 目录: 别有洞天, pp.462-470
summary_en: The printed facsimile of the National Library of China's Yangshi Lei sheets has a section on this place at pp.462-470 (9 pages, section length worked out from the next heading); sheet titles and numbers are in the volume, ordered from a library.

title: 别有洞天总平面图
locator: 清华大学建筑学院图书馆 T0063号
summary_en: Overall plan of Bieyou Dongtian, late Qianlong to Jiaqing, 800x500 mm. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

title: 题纳翠楼
locator: v3 p.24, under 别有洞天; source ref 6-692
excerpt_zh: 楼名纳翠岂虚言，苑树虽凋松竹存。迩日雪中饶别致，绿琼天雨汞珠繁。
summary_en: Poem 题纳翠楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1759, filed by the editors under 别有洞天.

title: 水木清华之阁
locator: v3 p.30, under 别有洞天; source ref 9-409
excerpt_zh: 阁凭水木号清华，气味由来本一家。阳夏西池真足赏，简文濠濮岂须夸。
summary_en: Poem 水木清华之阁 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1768, filed by the editors under 别有洞天.

title: 时赏斋作歌
locator: v3 p.29, under 别有洞天; source ref 9-218
excerpt_zh: 一年惟四时，时各九十日。一日十二时，昼夜分半疾。丁丁莲漏无停声，积日为月积月年。又成及时行乐有，其语设如其语斯，非所无逸而凛旦。明旸时旸兮雨时雨，始得纾烦忧兮惬怀绪，时赏之意实在兹，讵曰珍禽奇卉罗庭宇。
summary_en: Poem 时赏斋作歌 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1766, filed by the editors under 别有洞天.

title: 题时赏斋
locator: v3 p.29, under 别有洞天; source ref 9-266
excerpt_zh: 庶征有五要惟时，省岁殷勤念在兹。又用咸休协心赏，艰哉夫岂易言之。
summary_en: Poem 题时赏斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1767, filed by the editors under 别有洞天.

title: 秀清村即景书怀
locator: v3 p.38, under 别有洞天; source ref 1-110
excerpt_zh: 春山润而秀，春水澄且清。泽透景物丽，普遍卉木荣。风静尘不起，波影含空明。泛舟坐天上，俯仰多怡情。眺览见仁智，集虚鲜外营。四郊农务起，土润宜新耕。耤田欲将事，终亩偕公卿。勤勤始东作，切切望西成。游观聊寓目，民瘼中心萦。
summary_en: Poem 秀清村即景书怀 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1796, filed by the editors under 别有洞天.

title: 秀清村
locator: v3 p.39, under 别有洞天; source ref 1-227
excerpt_zh: 近水楼台境秀清，满庭花木益敷荣。疏帘风静燕来睇，曲沼波新鸥结盟。柳扬长条汀畔舞，兰舒雅馥座前萦。授时最喜甘霖足，趁润郊原恰始耕。
summary_en: Poem 秀清村 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1797, filed by the editors under 别有洞天.

title: 日下舊聞考: 秀清村
excerpt_zh: 苑牆東出水闗曰秀清村

title: 日下舊聞考: 城关 水关
excerpt_zh: 苑牆東出水闗

title: 御製夾鏡鳴琴詞（調寄水仙子）（圓明園四十景詩）
excerpt_zh:
乾隆九年 御製夾鏡鳴琴詞（調寄水仙子）
取李青蓮兩水夾明鏡詩意架虹橋一道上搆傑閣俯瞰澄泓畫欄倒影旁厓懸瀑水衝激石罅琤琮自鳴猶識成連遺響
垂絲風裏木蘭船拍拍飛鳬破渚煙臨淵無意漁人羡空明水與天　琴心莫説當年移情逺不在絃付與成連
summary_en: After 李白's line on two waters holding a bright mirror: an arched bridge with a tall pavilion looks down on clear water. A cascade from the cliff beside rings on the rock, and he recalls the music of 成連.

title: 日下舊聞考 夹镜鸣琴
excerpt_zh: 别有洞天迤西為夾鏡鳴琴南為聚逺樓東為廣育宫前建坊座後為凝祥殿宫東為南屏晚鐘又東度橋為西山入畫為山容水態夾鏡鳴琴之西為湖山在望為佳山水為洞裏長春（圓圓明園册）臣等謹按夾鏡鳴琴四十景之一額為皇上御書廣育宫奉碧霞元君殿額曰恩光仁照與西山入畫湖山在望佳山水洞裏長春諸額皆世宗御書廣育宫前坊額曰含𢎞光大曰品物咸亨與凝祥殿南屏晩鐘諸額皆皇上御書凝祥殿聫曰茂育恩覃昭聖感資生徳溥配坤元亦御書
summary_en: West of 别有洞天: 夾鏡鳴琴, with 聚逺樓, 廣育宫 (to 碧霞元君) and its arch and 凝祥殿, 南屏晚鐘, 西山入畫, 山容水態, 湖山在望, 佳山水 and 洞裏長春.

title: Scene 35, 夹镜鸣琴 Jiajing Mingqin
excerpt_other: A deep well can still be found on the top of this hill where the water was drawn by workmen to supply the music of the waterfall.
summary_en: A pavilion on a bridge on the south side of 福海, overlooking water both ways, near a waterfall running down from a temple-crowned hill. A deep well on the hilltop, seen by Malone, supplied the fall by hand.

title: Site status table, about 2011: scattered remains only
summary_en: Scenes with only scattered, incomplete building remains in the same table. 方壶胜境 is listed separately as the one with fairly complete remains not yet tidied up. 紫碧山房, 舍卫城 and 如园 have been dug since.

title: 夹镜鸣琴; 平湖秋月, yaffin 系列11
summary_en: Lead: 夹镜鸣琴, 4,000 m2, south shore of 福海, Yongzheng date, from a Li Bai line on two waters and twin bridges. 平湖秋月, 20,000 m2, north shore, named after the West Lake view, Yongzheng date, three-bay main hall.

title: 广育宫 (S47 section 2.12)
summary_en: On a hill east of 夹镜鸣琴, in pines, facing north in its own court: a pailou, gate hall and the three-bay hip-and-gable main hall 凝祥殿 with side halls. Yellow tile on the album, rare among the shrines. Its goddess 碧霞元君 was prayed to for children; palace women crossed 福海 by boat to it, and a 过皇会 was held nearby on her birthday.

title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 夹镜鸣琴
summary_en: A Yongzheng scene on the south shore: a double-eaved square bridge-pavilion, with 聚远楼 across the water, and 广育宫 to the east for the goddess 碧霞元君. Then 南屏晚钟, 西山入画 (rebuilt about 1763 as the five-bay 开鉴堂, later 渊渟镜澈), 湖山在望 and others.

title: 夹镜鸣琴亭平面图 (图名: 十二年二月二十一日改准夹镜鸣琴)
date: 道光十二年 (1832) 二月二十一日
locator: 国家图书馆善本部 样031-3号
summary_en: Ink design sheet for altering the Jiajing Mingqin pavilion, dated February 1832. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

title: 《国家图书馆藏样式雷图档·圆明园卷初编》: 夹镜鸣琴
date: mostly 道光, 咸丰, 同治 per the publisher
locator: 初编 目录: 夹镜鸣琴, pp.460-461
summary_en: The printed facsimile of the National Library of China's Yangshi Lei sheets has a section on this place at pp.460-461 (2 pages, section length worked out from the next heading); sheet titles and numbers are in the volume, ordered from a library.

title: 日下舊聞考: 夹镜鸣琴桥亭
excerpt_zh: 架虹橋一道上搆傑閣

title: 湖山在望
locator: v3 p.57, under 夹镜鸣琴; source ref 1-178
excerpt_zh: 草亭虚敞近湖滨，旷览澄潭玉镜陈。山影印川晴旭叠，波光罨画晚风皴。白云几缕萦峰额，红叶一林绘岸漘。福地豫游蒙圣泽，仙寰驻景小阳春。
summary_en: Poem 湖山在望 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1796, filed by the editors under 夹镜鸣琴.

title: 湖山在望
locator: v3 p.58, under 夹镜鸣琴; source ref 1-238
excerpt_zh: 南北界湖山向背，傍汀移棹境全更。目谋心赏奚同异，有触成因幻想生。山色如如原不动，水含叠叠浪花催。何虚何实强分别，过眼烟云是本来。
summary_en: Poem 湖山在望 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1797, filed by the editors under 夹镜鸣琴.

title: 御製涵虛朗鑑詩（圓明園四十景詩）
excerpt_zh:
乾隆九年 御製涵虛朗鑑詩
結宇福海之西左右雲堤紆委千章層青面前巨浸空澄一泓淨碧日月出入雲霞卷舒逺山烟嵐近水樓閣來不迎而去不距莫不落其度内如如焉亦無如如者吾得之於濠上也
涵虛斯朗鑑朗鑑在虛涵即此契元理悠然對碧潭雲山同妙盡魚鳥適清酣天水相忘處空明共我三
summary_en: Placed here on the west of 福海, with cloud-like dykes and thousands of trees on either side and a vast clear sheet of water in front. Sun, moon and clouds come and go unsought, and he sets this beside 莊子's musing above the Hao river.

title: 涵虚朗鉴: 乾隆二十七年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十七年 (1762), date from the compilation
locator: p.271 item (1), under 涵虚朗鉴
excerpt_zh: 天水涵虚处，襟怀朗鉴余。际空常澹澹，照物祇如如。目远随飞鸟，心闲玩戏鱼。碧犹喜云敛，纹不藉风舒。信是得神画，堪通论政书。慿阑适几暇，絜矩每开予。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 涵虚朗鉴, 1762, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 涵虚朗鉴
locator: v3 p.62, under 涵虚朗鉴; source ref 4-30
excerpt_zh: 轩鉴碧池光朗映，水天一色遍涵虚。乔松百尺临汀立，细柳千条倚岸舒。风飏疏帘穿小燕，旭晖浅浪跃游鱼。静观生趣欣咸若，䌷绎芸编勉味余。
summary_en: Poem 涵虚朗鉴 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1808, filed by the editors under 涵虚朗鉴.

title: 涵虚朗鉴
locator: v3 p.62, under 涵虚朗鉴; source ref 4-41
excerpt_zh: 滉漾波光印碧穹，川渟林秀景熙融。心悬朗鉴辉尘世，风送浮云度太空。涵远自微惟克己，集虚得实总由衷。卷阿游览仍求治，敢懈持盈未致中。
summary_en: Poem 涵虚朗鉴 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1808, filed by the editors under 涵虚朗鉴.

title: 涵虚朗鉴: 嘉庆十九年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十九年 (1814), date from the compilation
locator: p.271 item (2), under 涵虚朗鉴
excerpt_zh: 节度中元颢景清，北窗坐对镜虚明。澄波涵渚一川净，朗鉴悬霄万里晴。柳荫密垂映帘幙，荷香远送满檐楹。拏舟重泛赤栏外，林际微茫崖翠横。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 涵虚朗鉴, 1814, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 涵虚朗鉴: 嘉庆二十五年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆二十五年 (1820), date from the compilation
locator: p.271 item (5), under 涵虚朗鉴
excerpt_zh: 秋令纔临灏景舒，水天一色净涵虚。林光密隐栖枝雀，波影低翻在藻鱼。汀畔浮游浴鸥鹭，槛前灼烁冒芙蕖。心悬朗鉴物咸若，随遇怡和妄念除。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 涵虚朗鉴, 1820, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 日下舊聞考 涵虚朗鉴、福海
excerpt_zh: 涵虛朗鑑在福海東即雷峯夕照正宇其北稍西為惠如春又東北為尋雲榭又北為貽蘭庭為會心不逺其南為臨衆芳為雲錦墅為菊秀松㽔為萬景天全（明圓園册）臣等謹按涵虛朗鑑四十景之一額為皇上御書舊懸湖西澄虛榭後移置湖東雷峯夕照軒宇内惠如春尋雲榭諸額亦御書
summary_en: East of 福海: 涵虛朗鑑, the main range of 雷峯夕照, with 惠如春, 尋雲榭, 貽蘭庭, 會心不逺, 臨衆芳, 雲錦墅, 菊秀松㽔 and 萬景天全. The plaque first hung at 澄虛榭 on the west shore and was moved here, which explains why the 1744 preface places the scene on the west.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 涵虚朗鉴
locator: from p.271, under 涵虚朗鉴
summary_en: 涵虚朗鉴: 5 dated items, 1762-1820, of which 5 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1762, last dated 1820.

title: 老北京的记忆(125): 涵虚朗鉴 and 接秀山房, quoting 《圆明园百景图志》
summary_en: Gives scene sizes and hall by hall measures: 涵虚朗鉴 200 x 60 m, 接秀山房 250 x 50 m. 接秀山房 became 观澜堂 in late Jiaqing. 1855 interior drawing at the NLC. Notes the names of the east-shore scenes were swapped around 1744, and that some modern plans mislabel the halls.

title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 涵虚朗鉴
summary_en: Begun 1738 on the north-east shore, a three-bay hall facing west, plaques 雷峰夕照 outside and 涵虚朗鉴 inside. It gives the order of halls along the shore, north and south of that hall: compare the conflict logged by archaeo (S338).

title: 圆明园福海东岸历史建筑方位考, 圆明园研究 78期
summary_en: Shows that plans disagree on which hall is which along the east shore of 福海: the 1936 Beiping survey, the 1979 He and Zeng plan and the 2010 百景图志 each label differently. Checking Yangshi Lei drawings and texts against the sites, it reads the surviving bases north to south as 贻兰亭, 会心不远, 寻云榭, 惠如春, 雷峰夕照, 临众芳, 云锦墅, 观澜堂. It notes no scientific dig has been done here.

title: 《国家图书馆藏样式雷图档·圆明园卷初编》: 涵虚朗鉴
date: mostly 道光, 咸丰, 同治 per the publisher
locator: 初编 目录: 涵虚朗鉴, pp.442-445
summary_en: The printed facsimile of the National Library of China's Yangshi Lei sheets has a section on this place at pp.442-445 (4 pages, section length worked out from the next heading); sheet titles and numbers are in the volume, ordered from a library.

title: 寻云榭漫题
locator: v3 p.61, under 涵虚朗鉴; source ref 16-739
excerpt_zh: 散闷步岸傍，遂至寻云榭。寻云有二义，五字言非诈。一为绿林深，入云喻假借。斯则缘畅游，非我所云者。一为望雨际，切盼云生夏。荟蔚跻天中，风随散而罢。寻之总未得，伫立愁以讶。
summary_en: Poem 寻云榭漫题 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1787, filed by the editors under 涵虚朗鉴.

title: 赋得会心不远
locator: v3 p.60, under 涵虚朗鉴; source ref 8-585
excerpt_zh: 琳池围绮榭，镜影澹涵空。曲以云廊达，翳然岩木笼。遥情归静寄，造物是良工。结念休三岛，传神有六通。华林漫相拟，钜野讶堪同。曰我会心处，羲经无妄中。
summary_en: Poem 赋得会心不远 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1762, filed by the editors under 涵虚朗鉴.

title: 云锦墅
locator: v3 p.7, under 接秀山房; source ref 1-229
excerpt_zh: 春华敷锦绣，花墅彩连云。落蕊眼前漾，余香鼻观闻。良时全若绘，大块总成文。试放兰桡去，回溪桃李纷。
summary_en: Poem 云锦墅 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1797, filed by the editors under 接秀山房.

title: 云锦墅晴眺
locator: v3 p.8, under 接秀山房; source ref 2-403
excerpt_zh: 百顷风潭一鉴收，蜃窗倒影印清流。涵溶霞彩朱澜卷，澄澈天光碧浪浮。西岭列屏蘸波洁，北汀连阁映林稠。平湖坐挹心神畅，试写吟笺佳境酬。
summary_en: Poem 云锦墅晴眺 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1804, filed by the editors under 接秀山房.

title: 御製廓然大公詩（圓明園四十景詩）
excerpt_zh:
乾隆九年 御製廓然大公詩
平岡迴合山禽渚鳥逺近相呼後鑿曲池有蒲菡蓞長夏高啓北窻水香拂拂真足開豁襟顔
有山不讓土故得高㠖㠖有河不擇流故得寛瀰瀰是之謂大公而我以名此偶值清晏間慿眺誠樂只識得聖人心聞諸程夫子
summary_en: Low hills enclose it and birds call from far and near. A winding pool of reeds and lotus is dug behind; in high summer the north window opened on the scent of the water.

title: 廓然大公: 乾隆二十年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆二十年 (1755), date from the compilation
locator: p.257 item (3), under 廓然大公
excerpt_zh: 一泓涵碧，颇有物来。顺应之趣，深柳偏宜。羽客嬉会心，恰当读书时。 （是处昔又名深柳读书堂）在阴能和宁吾谓，好爵还思与尔縻。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 廓然大公, 1755, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 廓然大公八景 有序
locator: v3 p.68, under 廓然大公; source ref 5-336
excerpt_zh: 圆明园四十景，皆取四字为题。各景之中，一轩一峰，具有幽致。日涉成趣，正复不穷。题以八景，系之七言。
summary_en: Poem 廓然大公八景 有序 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1755, filed by the editors under 廓然大公.

title: 御製廓然大公八景詩（有序）
excerpt_zh: 乾隆二十年御製廓然大公八景詩（有序）　圓明園四十景皆取四字為題各景之中一軒一峯具有幽致日涉成趣正復不窮題以八景系之七言　前接陌桞後臨平湖軒堂翼然虛明洞徹皇考御書題額時有卿雲䕶之廓然大公扁即在後室一泓涵碧頗有物來順應之趣　深桞偏宜羽客嬉會心恰當讀書時（是處昔又名深栁讀書堂）在隂能和寧吾謂好爵還思與爾縻（右雙鶴齋）　循雙鶴齋而西跨湖為橋圓如半璧暎水則為滿月繚以長廊悠然濠濮間想　拖如玉帶曲如鈎上置行廊又似舟仙術何須倩法善往來常作廣寒游（右規月橋）　性之介立為峭文之藻蔚為蒨太沖詩意良足會心　石秀松𬎼各出羣不同同處挹清芬太沖豈務多竒者五字全拈大塊文（右峭蒨居）　面東為樓杜陵句曰半陂以南純浸山動影窈窕沖融間斯樓有焉因迥為高結搆清層樓因得影山名窻中峯作波中態上下明漪最有情（右影山樓）　竒石㟏岈迴互徑出其中烟雲往來披拂襟袖　緑雲叢翠徑縈紆面面深竒步步殊倩得仇英冩生筆定須為作採芝圖（右披雲徑）　機政之餘拈吟適興每遇佳景不覺綺思濬發　逢源左右足深資適興無非把筆時設使古人癖誠有吟之一字我何辭（右綺吟堂）　曲澗奔泉琤琮作金石聲韻出天然是謂雲山韶濩　迸水摐摐下石磯八音繁會太音稀輞川漫擬王家畫虞陛高懐舜手揮（右韻石淙）　山巔笠亭孤標秀出左顧飛瀑右挹雲林盡得此間勝概　詭石蒼松扶翼然氤氲朝暮幻雲烟林光泉韻無非秀都付山亭秀占全（右啟秀亭）
summary_en: Eight poems on 廓然大公's parts, each with a preface giving form and place: 雙鶴齋 once called 深桞讀書堂, 規月橋 as a half-moon covered bridge, 峭蒨居, 影山樓, 披雲徑, 綺吟堂, 韻石淙 and 啟秀亭 on the peak.

title: 廓然大公: 乾隆三十九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十九年 (1774), date from the compilation
locator: p.258 item (11), under 廓然大公
excerpt_zh: 古柳笼堂合抱围，（是处昔又名深柳读书堂）胎仙驻此欲忘飞。昔诚是矣今何敢，对立居然二老归。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 廓然大公, 1774, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 廓然大公
locator: v3 p.82, under 廓然大公
excerpt_zh: 五架书斋虚且朗，不教花树植前墀。廓然明示大公意，我亦物来顺应之。
summary_en: Poem 廓然大公 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1794, filed by the editors under 廓然大公.

title: 廓然大公: 道光八年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
date: 道光八年 (1828), date from the compilation
locator: p.258 item (16), under 廓然大公
excerpt_zh: 前朝巳优渥，昨夜复沾濡。仰见天心顺，临轩讯逆俘。欧刀伸国法，摘祭快人心。除逆安边圉，都由昊眷深。
summary_en: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 廓然大公, 1828. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 日下舊聞考 廓然大公、福海
excerpt_zh: 福海西北隅平湖秋月之西為廓然大公正宇七楹前為雙鶴齋西北為規月橋東北為綺吟堂又北為採芝徑又北徑巖洞而西為峭蒨居北垣門外有樓為天真可佳峭蒨居西為披雲徑又西亭為啟秀又西稍南為韻石淙西北平臺臨池為芰荷深處垣外為影山樓雙鶴齋西為環秀山房西北為臨湖樓（圓明園册）臣等謹按廓然大公四十景之一額為皇上御書雙鶴齋採芝徑天真可佳芰荷深處影山樓環秀山房臨湖樓諸額皆世宗御書峭蒨居披雲徑諸額皆皇上御書
summary_en: West of 平湖秋月: 廓然大公, seven bays, with 雙鶴齋 in front, the 規月橋, 綺吟堂, 採芝徑, 峭蒨居, 天真可佳, 披雲徑, 啟秀, 韻石淙, 芰荷深處, 影山樓, 環秀山房 and 臨湖樓.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 廓然大公
locator: from p.257, under 廓然大公
summary_en: 廓然大公: 17 dated items, 1755-1828, of which 16 poems and 1 court records (Qianlong, Jiaqing, Daoguang); recurring themes: reading, the view, escaping the heat. First dated 1755, last dated 1828.

title: 双鹤斋 吕祖亭 (采芝径) (S47 section 2.13)
summary_en: A square one-bay pavilion with surrounding gallery, 6.72 m overall, on a high platform, facing west, named 采芝径, built by early Yongzheng as a mere view. Xianfeng ordered altars for 吕祖 and two companions in February 1858, and it was called 吕祖亭 from then. A Yangshi Lei elevation of its shrine survives. It still received offerings in 1861.

title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 廓然大公
summary_en: Begun under Yongzheng, later a favourite residence: a seven-bay hall with a five-bay annex 双鹤斋. 规月桥, 绮吟堂, 采芝径, 峭蒨居, 影山楼, 环秀山房 follow. Qianlong's rebuild copied 寄畅园, and the rockwork copied his Panshan villa. It survived 1860 and was lost around 1900, say the editors.

title: 廓然大公总平面图
locator: 故宫博物院图书馆 样1702号
summary_en: Overall plan of Kuoran Dagong, also called Shuanghe Zhai, on the west shore of Fuhai; the record dates it only as before 1860. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

date: mostly 道光, 咸丰, 同治 per the publisher
locator: 初编 目录: 廓然大公, pp.330-353

title: 圆明园廓然大公 烫样
summary_en: Paper model of Kuoran Dagong shown at the National Library in 2007 as held by the Palace Museum; the report gives no date.

title: 题双鹤斋
locator: v3 p.70, under 廓然大公; source ref 5-366
excerpt_zh: 翯翯松阴复竹边，双来疑是下青田。参军赋句无须读，弄影奔机意总仙。
summary_en: Poem 题双鹤斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1755, filed by the editors under 廓然大公.

title: 双鹤斋
locator: v3 p.72, under 廓然大公
excerpt_zh: 讵是寻常恋稻粱，仙禽雅合驻仙乡。形容不拟轻为赋，明远佳辞已擅场。
summary_en: Poem 双鹤斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1761, filed by the editors under 廓然大公.

title: 规月桥
locator: v3 p.72, under 廓然大公
excerpt_zh: 枕岸看如上下弦，影波原见一轮圆。是为规月是真月，照彻三千与大千。
summary_en: Poem 规月桥 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1761, filed by the editors under 廓然大公.

title: 规月桥
locator: v3 p.74, under 廓然大公
excerpt_zh: 规成圆圆莫如月，月自先天规后天。试看卧波分上下，却因半故体常全。
summary_en: Poem 规月桥 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 廓然大公.

title: 绮吟堂
locator: v3 p.73, under 廓然大公
excerpt_zh: 美景良辰奚遣兴，铺笺点笔每敲吟。是予结习非予善，要亦不因此放心。
summary_en: Poem 绮吟堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1761, filed by the editors under 廓然大公.

title: 绮吟堂
locator: v3 p.74, under 廓然大公
excerpt_zh: 成吟寓目只斯须，工拙何烦更计乎。五字设当髭捻断，卢家笑欲作髡徒。
summary_en: Poem 绮吟堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 廓然大公.

title: 峭蒨居
locator: v3 p.69, under 廓然大公
excerpt_zh: 性之介，立为峭。文之藻，蔚为蒨。太冲诗意，良足会心。石秀松蕤各出群，不同同处挹清芬。太冲岂务多奇者，五字全拈大块文。
summary_en: Poem 峭蒨居 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1755, filed by the editors under 廓然大公.

title: 峭蒨居
locator: v3 p.71, under 廓然大公; source ref 6-705
excerpt_zh: 雨后晴和碧藓滋，破颜桃朵笑嶔崎。今年二月停行跸，欲阅园庭春所宜。
summary_en: Poem 峭蒨居 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1759, filed by the editors under 廓然大公.

title: 披云径
locator: v3 p.76, under 廓然大公
excerpt_zh: 一片如从龙井移，滃然时向锐尖披。湿衣不识缘底事，徐悟伯高曾有诗。
summary_en: Poem 披云径 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1769, filed by the editors under 廓然大公.

title: 披云径
locator: v3 p.79, under 廓然大公
excerpt_zh: 磵户云封亦可欣，往来循径必披云。然因人与安名耳，云者那知聚及分。
summary_en: Poem 披云径 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1776, filed by the editors under 廓然大公.

title: 启秀亭
locator: v3 p.73, under 廓然大公
excerpt_zh: 水木澄华竹石清，于于屧步足怡情。如从六艺嫩芳润，先获我心是士衡。
summary_en: Poem 启秀亭 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1761, filed by the editors under 廓然大公.

title: 启秀亭
locator: v3 p.75, under 廓然大公
excerpt_zh: 已觉芳茵衬步青，东风有脚善形形。朝葩夕蘤行看启，解报先声是此亭。
summary_en: Poem 启秀亭 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 廓然大公.

title: 韵石淙
locator: v3 p.73, under 廓然大公
excerpt_zh: 石将水本寂然物，韵出无端两相遭。一切有为法如是，心源定处不生涛。
summary_en: Poem 韵石淙 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1761, filed by the editors under 廓然大公.

title: 韵石淙
locator: v3 p.75, under 廓然大公
excerpt_zh: 流泉石上似琴调，讵是寻常爨尾烧。莫讶宫声非漏越，五弦当日叶箫韶。
summary_en: Poem 韵石淙 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 廓然大公.

title: 影山楼
locator: v3 p.72, under 廓然大公; source ref 6-712
excerpt_zh: 潇洒山楼号影山，毎来消得片时闲。难拈七字征名象，为在虚无缥缈间。
summary_en: Poem 影山楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1759, filed by the editors under 廓然大公.

title: 影山楼
locator: v3 p.73, under 廓然大公
excerpt_zh: 楼俯清波波影山，文窗棐几称高闲。是忧勤匪高闲者，只觉赧然于此间。
summary_en: Poem 影山楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1761, filed by the editors under 廓然大公.

title: 环秀山房对月（347）
locator: v3 p.67, under 廓然大公
excerpt_zh: 暑退林泉爽，新秋景物佳。蛩吟依藓砌，鹤迹印溪沙。搁笔评山色，擎杯对月华。坐深群籁寂，竹树影横斜。
summary_en: Poem 环秀山房对月（347） by the  Emperor, filed by the editors under 廓然大公.

title: 御製坐石臨流詩（圓明園四十景詩）
excerpt_zh:
乾隆九年 御製坐石臨流詩
仄澗中潨泉奔滙竒石峭列為坻為碕為嶼為奥激波分注潺潺鳴籟可以潄齒可以泛觴作亭據勝處泠然山水清音東為同樂園
白石清泉帶碧蘿曲流貼貼泛金荷年年上已尋歡處便是當時晉永和
summary_en: Waters race together in a narrow gully, past sharp rocks. The stream's divided flow sings, good for rinsing the mouth or floating wine cups. A pavilion stands at the best spot, with 同樂園 to the east.

title: 养和室: 乾隆三十二年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十二年 (1767), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh:
啬神非吾希，种秫非吾怡。发而皆中节，闻之吾子思。是必有所养，其和匪矜持。不为内欲扰，不为外物移。
如元首万善，如春冠四时。冲融去安排，位育庶可几。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 养和室, 1767. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 抱朴草堂: 乾隆三十二年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十二年 (1767), date from the compilation
locator: p.221 item (1), under 抱朴草堂
excerpt_zh:
轩楹近觉厌华庨，洁治书堂覆草茅。欲拟幽人犹未得，敢言古帝恐成淆。闲披芸简窗前朗，静聴松风户外敲。津逮漫言由李葛，仙家与我却无交。”抱朴草堂是乾隆皇帝依照承德狮子园草房改建而成。乾隆在诗中有云：“抱朴草堂之构以皇考热河狮子园有草房，因仿
效为之，用昭示俭深意
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 抱朴草堂, 1767. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 抱朴草堂: 乾隆三十二年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十二年 (1767), date from the compilation
locator: p.222 item (2), under 抱朴草堂
excerpt_zh: 洁治数间屋，匪华以朴胜。曲篱堂后围，横溪阶下映。插架富芸编，汲古颐神性。清暇偶憩坐，窗明几亦净。惜阴意有永，体物心无竞。绮镫方在楹，微觉弗相称。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 抱朴草堂, 1767, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 养和室: 乾隆三十五年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆三十五年 (1770), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 交养由来内外通，春和一室趣无穷。便如九十韶光富，也在冲容酝酿中。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 养和室, 1770, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 养和室: 乾隆五十四年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆五十四年 (1789), date from the compilation
excerpt_zh: 一室冲融号养和，窗前春物未婆娑。诸凡未发先为蓄，吾亦于斯所得多。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 养和室, 1789. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 坐石临流
locator: v3 p.97, under 坐石临流; source ref 1-123
excerpt_zh: 修禊清游晋永和，仿成亭子俯平坡。山屏镂刻图全展，石柱周环帖遍罗。曲水纡回通别渚，茂林幽邃荫崇阿。岂同觞咏怀今昔，几暇肩舆偶一过。
summary_en: Poem 坐石临流 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1796, filed by the editors under 坐石临流.

title: 抱朴草堂: 嘉庆十一年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆十一年 (1806), date from the compilation
locator: p.222 item (10), under 抱朴草堂
excerpt_zh: 心非黄屋念茅茨，数架草堂碧水湄。欲使民风返淳朴，雕梁画栋又奚为。纸窗藤榻欣清雅，静觉田家风味宜。渚畔停桡偶临憩，半瓯芳茗一章诗。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 抱朴草堂, 1806, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 日下舊聞考 坐石临流
excerpt_zh: 坐石臨流在水木明瑟東南澹泊寧靜之東溪水周環軒宇三楹西嚮（圓明園册）臣等謹按坐石臨流四十景之一額為皇上御書
summary_en: South-east of 水木明瑟, east of 澹泊寧静, ringed by stream: three bays facing west. The note says only that the plaque is Qianlong's.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 养和室
locator: from p.222, under 坐石临流
summary_en: 养和室: 4 dated items, 1767-1789, of which 4 poems (Qianlong); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1767, last dated 1789.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 抱朴草堂
locator: from p.221, under 坐石临流
summary_en: 抱朴草堂: 10 dated items, 1767-1806, of which 10 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: reading, the view. First dated 1767, last dated 1806.

title: Scene 38, 坐石临流 Zuoshi Linliu, and 舍卫城 Shewei Cheng
excerpt_other: Not far west of the Happy Sea a granite road between two rows of buildings, which included a theater and which looked like a business street in a city, crossed a bridge over a canal, and led up to a gate in a fortified wall like the entrance of a city.
summary_en: Granite road with shops and a theatre, a bridge, then the gate of 舍卫城 (Sravasti) in a walled enclosure with a pailou before it, red-walled temples inside, a similar gate on the north. The small pavilion over a rocky stream gave the scene its name. N.45: yellow glazed tile pieces found by Malone, inscribed She Wei Ch'eng and "made in the 15th year"; probably the 佛城 being built in 1740. The fair of the court was held on this street.

title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 坐石临流
summary_en: An overview of a four-part district with the shop street in the middle. 坐石临流 is the cup-floating pavilion; 抱朴草堂 a six-bay reverse hall. It gives 舍卫城 hall by hall (多宝阁, 寿国寿民, 仁慈殿, 普福宫, 最胜阁), and 同乐园: a theatre with towers of five bays, three-bay link, the emperor below and dowager above, facing the three-storey stage 清音阁.

title: 坐石临流 scene card
summary_en: North-east of 后湖; copies the 兰亭 of Shaoxing, with its winding-stream gathering of 王羲之.

title: 清宮詞 note
summary_en: Note: the old 蘭亭 of the garden (taken to be the pavilion of 坐石臨流; the note does not name the scene) had a stone with a picture and imperial poem, and eight pillars with famous copies. After the ruin the stone went to the Central Park and the pillars were found at 頤和園.

title: 《国家图书馆藏样式雷图档·圆明园卷初编》: 坐石临流
date: mostly 道光, 咸丰, 同治 per the publisher
locator: 初编 目录: 坐石临流, pp.229-262
summary_en: The printed facsimile of the National Library of China's Yangshi Lei sheets has a section on this place at pp.229-262 (34 pages, section length worked out from the next heading); sheet titles and numbers are in the volume, ordered from a library.

title: 同乐园平面图
summary_en: Plan of the great theatre garden, part of Zuoshi Linliu, facing Shewei Cheng to the north; shelf number and date not seen in the extract. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

title: 御製麴院風荷詩（圓明園四十景詩）
excerpt_zh:
乾隆九年 御製麴院風荷詩
西湖麴院為宋時酒務地荷花最多是有麴院風荷之名兹處紅衣印波長虹摇影風景相似故以其名名之
香逺風清誰解圖亭亭花底睡雙鳬停橈隄畔饒真賞那數餘杭西子湖
summary_en: The name comes from the place on 西湖 West Lake that was a Song state brewery, thick with lotus. This place, with red lotus and a long bridge's reflection, looks the same and takes the name.

title: 曲院风荷: 乾隆九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
date: 乾隆九年 (1744), date from the compilation
locator: p.256 item (1), under 曲院风荷
excerpt_zh: 香远风清谁解图，亭亭花底睡双凫。停桡堤畔饶真赏，那数余杭西子湖。
summary_en: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 曲院风荷, 1744. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 曲院风荷: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation
locator: p.257 item (2), under 曲院风荷
excerpt_zh: 显迹传东土，如来平等观。西方常住锡，南海永安澜。法律三车演，庄严七宝攒。长称圣人寿，普被福田宽。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 曲院风荷, 1796, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 曲院风荷: 嘉庆七年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
date: 嘉庆七年 (1802), date from the compilation
locator: p.257 item (4), under 曲院风荷
excerpt_zh: 海南卓锡畅宗风，应感随声示现同。人我尽包四生转，慈悲原在一心通。六时钟磬真仍幻，三月莺花色即空。若向个中寻住脚，痴人说梦总愚蒙。
summary_en: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 曲院风荷, 1802, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

title: 日下舊聞考 曲院风荷
excerpt_zh: 坐石臨流東南當碧桐書院正東為麴院風荷五楹南嚮其西佛樓為洛迦勝境（圓明園册）臣等謹按麴院風荷四十景之一額為皇上御書洛迦勝境額亦御書
summary_en: East of 碧桐書院: 麴院風荷, five bays facing south, with the Buddha tower 洛迦勝境 to its west.

title: 日下舊聞考 曲院风荷
excerpt_zh: 麴院風荷之南跨池東西橋九空坊楔二西為金鼇東為玉蝀金鼇西南河外室為四圍佳麗玉蝀東有亭為飲練長虹又東南度橋折而北設城闗為寧和鎮其東南為東樓門（圓明園册）臣等謹按飲練長虹寧和鎮諸額皆御書
summary_en: South of 麴院風荷, a nine-opening bridge across the pool with archways 金鼇 to the west and 玉蝀 to the east; 四圍佳麗 and the 飲練長虹 pavilion nearby; further south-east the walled mock town 寧和鎮 and the 東樓門.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 曲院风荷
locator: from p.256, under 曲院风荷
summary_en: 曲院风荷: 4 dated items, 1744-1802, of which 4 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1744, last dated 1802.

title: Scene 39, 曲院风荷 Quyuan Fenghe
excerpt_other: The building at the Yuan Ming Yuan which bore this name faced south on a pretty lotus pond crossed by a great curved bridge supported by nine arches and leading nowhere in particular.
summary_en: Hall facing south on a lotus pond with a nine-arch curved bridge.

title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 曲院风荷
summary_en: Modelled on the West Lake scene. Five-bay hall, Buddhist tower 洛伽胜境, a nine-arch bridge with archways 金鳌 and 玉蝀, 四围佳丽, 饮练长虹, then 宁和镇, renamed 春和镇 early in Daoguang's reign to avoid a name taboo. West of it the village 村庄房.

title: 《国家图书馆藏样式雷图档·圆明园卷初编》: 曲院风荷
date: mostly 道光, 咸丰, 同治 per the publisher
locator: 初编 目录: 曲院风荷, p.228
summary_en: The printed facsimile of the National Library of China's Yangshi Lei sheets has a section on this place at p.228 (1 pages, section length worked out from the next heading); sheet titles and numbers are in the volume, ordered from a library.

title: 曲院风荷样式雷图
summary_en: Older record of a drawing of Quyuan Fenghe; the archived copy has a scene description only, no shelf number or date. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

title: 圆明园曲苑风荷保护工程考古勘探报告
summary_en: Survey of a concave strip of about 13,500 m2 at 曲院风荷 Quyuan Fenghe, about 355 m north-south and 11-17 m wide, southwest of 福海. The printed figures do not multiply out to that area, so the area is doubtful. Results paywalled.

title: 御製洞天深處詩（圓明園四十景詩）
excerpt_zh:
乾隆九年 御製洞天深處詩
縁溪而東徑曲折如蟻盤短椽陿室於奥為宜雜植卉木紛紅駭緑幽巖石厂别有天地非人間少南即前垂天貺皇考御題予兄弟舊時讀書舎也
幽蘭泛重阿喬柯幕憩榭牝壑既虛寂細瀑時淙㵼瑟瑟竹籟秋亭亭松月夜對此少淹留安知嵗月流願為君子儒不作逍遥遊
summary_en: East along the stream by a path as twisting as an ant's track: small rooms in a secluded spot, with mixed plants and caves. A little south is 前垂天貺 with his father's plaque, the school where he and his brothers read as boys.

title: 洞天深处
locator: v3 p.115, under 洞天深处; source ref 2-690
excerpt_zh: 缘溪而东，径曲折如蚁盘。短椽陿室，于奥为宜。杂植卉木，纷红骇绿，幽岩石厂，别有天地非人间。少南即前垂天贶，皇考御题，予兄弟旧时读书舍也。幽兰泛重阿，乔柯幕憩榭。牝壑既虚寂，细瀑时淙泻。瑟瑟竹籁秋，亭亭松月夜。对此少淹留，安知岁月流。愿为君子儒，不作逍遥游。
summary_en: Poem 洞天深处 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1744, filed by the editors under 洞天深处.

title: 日下舊聞考 洞天深处
excerpt_zh: 洞天深處在如意館西稍南前宇乃諸皇子所居為四所東西二街南北一街前為福園門四所之西為諸皇子肄業之所前有前垂天貺中為中天景物東宇為斯文在兹後為後天不老（圓明園册）臣等謹按洞天深處四十景之一額為皇上御書前垂天貺中天景物後天不老及如意館諸額皆世宗御書斯文在兹額恭懸至聖先師神龕上聫曰道統集成歸至徳聖功養正仰微言皆御書
summary_en: West and a little south of 如意館, near the 福園門: four courts where the imperial princes lived, with streets between; west of them the princes' school with 前垂天貺, 中天景物, 斯文在兹 (shrine to Confucius) and 後天不老.

title: Scene 40, 洞天深处 Dongtian Shenchu
excerpt_other: Adjacent to the four dwellings was located the Ju I Kuan, or Sceptre Lodge, where the European artists, clock makers, and machinists worked in Ch'ien Lung's day.
summary_en: Palace School on two islands on the west, four residences of princes in a square, 如意馆 next to them. 福园门 in the outer wall just south, 300 yards directly east of 大宫门 (Benoist's letter of 1773 cited). A pasted sheet on the Official Map shows a later arrangement here.

title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 洞天深处
summary_en: Built under Yongzheng for the princes' study and lodging: four courts on two east-west lanes and one north-south lane, the three study rooms 前垂天贶, 中天景物, 后天不老, a Confucius shrine, and 如意馆, the court painters' workshop where Castiglione and Attiret worked.

title: 乐道堂: a lead to 奕訢
summary_en: Prince Gong's style includes 乐道堂主人. As 洞天深处 housed the Emperor's sons, this label may be his study. No text on disk places a 乐道堂 in the garden.

title: 圆明园“如意馆”中的西洋人
summary_en: Describes the missionary painters' workplace in 洞天深处 and how they entered under escort.

title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 洞天深处
locator: from p.182, under 洞天深处
summary_en: 洞天深处: short note in the compilation, no dated items.

title: 《国家图书馆藏样式雷图档·圆明园卷初编》: 洞天深处
date: mostly 道光, 咸丰, 同治 per the publisher
locator: 初编 目录: 洞天深处, pp.66-114
summary_en: The printed facsimile of the National Library of China's Yangshi Lei sheets has a section on this place at pp.66-114 (49 pages, section length worked out from the next heading); sheet titles and numbers are in the volume, ordered from a library.

title: 洞天深处平面图
summary_en: Plan of the princes' study quarter inside Fuyuan gate; shelf number and date not seen in the extract. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

title: 洞天深处样式雷图
summary_en: An older record of a drawing of Dongtian Shenchu; shelf number and date not seen in the extract. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

title: 二月廿四日出福园门启程（94）
excerpt_zh: 卖餳天气近清明，路指渔阳纪首程。春露关心随雁序，时风拂面听莺鸣
summary_en: Poem 二月廿四日出福园门启程（94） by the Qianlong Emperor, 1788, filed by the editors under 春熙院.

title: 偕三弟自福园门启程作（125）
excerpt_zh: 西风下平皋，飒爽欣秋仲。并辔历长途，蹀躞青骢控。年来上塞过，笑语常相共。山川入画图，赏心由此众。禾稼有丰盈，闾阎无聚讼。一带列青峦，游目时时纵。霮䨴束山腰，云浓如结冻。行行秋景清，好倩新诗送。
summary_en: Poem 偕三弟自福园门启程作（125） by the Qianlong Emperor, 1788, filed by the editors under 春熙院.

title: 恭和御制至后天不老书房作元韵（405）
excerpt_zh: 芸窗风日永，典学忆当年。逊志希先哲，崇文重昔贤。来游宸藻丽，惇叙圣恩全。庆洽春韶普，承欢岁月緜。
summary_en: Poem 恭和御制至后天不老书房作元韵（405） by the Qianlong Emperor, 1788, filed by the editors under 春熙院.

title: 至后天不老书房作
locator: v3 p.116, under 洞天深处; source ref 1-207
excerpt_zh: 昔日弦歌地，重来已隔年。随兄怀雅训，勖弟勉成贤。师友三天聚，儿孙五代全。都蒙皇父泽，惇叙国恩绵。
summary_en: Poem 至后天不老书房作 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1797, filed by the editors under 洞天深处.

title: Attiret: where the painters worked
excerpt_other: The Place usually assign'd us to paint in, is in one of those little Palaces above-mentioned; where the Emperor comes to see us work, almost every Day:
summary_en: Painters and clockmakers only among the Europeans entered. He moved under eunuch guard when he had to paint elsewhere, and says this is how he saw the garden. Emperor there ten months a year; the Jesuits had a house near the entrance. 如意馆 per S02 p.96 for Qianlong's day.

title: 日下舊聞考 大宫门
excerpt_zh: 大宫門五楹門前左右朝房各五楹其後東為宗人府内閣吏部禮部兵部都察院理藩院翰林院詹事府國子監鑾儀衛東四旗各衙門直房東夾道内為銀庫又東北為南書房東南為檔案房西為户部刑部工部欽天監内務府光禄寺通政司大理寺鴻臚寺太常寺太僕寺御書處上駟院武備院西四旗各衙門直房西夾道之西南為造辦處又南為藥房
summary_en: The main gate has five bays with five-bay court offices left and right. Behind them the duty rooms of the boards and offices are set out east and west by name, with the silver vault, 南書房 Southern Study and archive room to the east and the 造辦處 Imperial Workshops and pharmacy to the south-west.

title: 竹葉亭雜記
excerpt_zh: 圆明园宫门内正月十五放和盒，例也。即烟火盒子，大架高悬。一盒三层：第一层“天下太平”四大字；二层鸽雀无数群飞，取放生之意；三层小儿四人击秧歌鼓，唱秧歌，唱“太平天子朝元日，五色云中驾六龙”一首。惟其时余观之朝阳满地，不见灯光矣。后停止。
summary_en: Inside the main gate on the 15th of the first month, firework boxes of three tiers were hung on a tall frame, and the practice later stopped.

title: Lucy: the layout before the gate, 6 October
excerpt_other: Sur la droite de ce prolongement était, au fond d'un vaste hémicycle, la grande porte du Palais Impérial.
summary_en: Letter: small lake and wood on the left, where they camped; road blocked by a wall, turning at a right angle to a plain grilled door; to the right, at the back of a vast half circle, the great gate.

title: M'Ghee: the two courts
excerpt_other: Inside the first entrance-gate there is a large, flagged courtyard, some hundred yards wide by eighty deep ; at each side, both within and without, are guard-rooms.
summary_en: Causeway through a sheet of water to the outer gate. A second gate of the same form, then a second court about the same size with the hall on its far side.

title: Swinhoe: entry of 7 October and the hall
excerpt_other: On the centre of the pavement, and facing the gate, stood the grand reception hall, a large Chinese building, well adorned exteriorly with paint and gilding, and netted with iron wire under the fretted eaves to keep the birds off.
summary_en: Smooth marble floor. Throne carved with dragons, which he found on close look to be lesser wood painted as ebony.

title: Varin: the night reconnaissance through the courts
excerpt_other: et on s'engagea dans une cour immense traversée dans sa dernière partie par un canal revêtu en marbre blanc, et couvert d'un pont, également en marbre, soutenant deux galeries latérales en bois.
summary_en: A large space with trees and a lake on one side and the palace on the other, a bare esplanade with regular side buildings, chevaux-de-frise at the entry. Centre gate barred, side doors used. Second enclosure, then a big court crossed by the marble-lined canal and bridge with two wooden galleries. Third enclosure with a wall about 4 m high and two small side doors.

title: Wolseley: approach by the eastern and western entrances
excerpt_other: There are two entrances to the Imperial residence ; one eastward, the other westward of the bridge.
summary_en: East entrance like any yamen, in front a large square with chevaux-de-frise made for show and bridges over a small river, not impressive. The west one, by the river and lofty trees, was the grand one. The eastern one may be 福园门; that is my guess.

title: Wolseley: causeway and ponds before the gate
excerpt_other: disclosing an open expanse of water, through which the road was carried along a raised causeway, edged upon both sides by rows of trees.
summary_en: Artificial ponds with lilies and lotus at the edges, fed by the stream. A temple at the far end of the causeway under lofty trees with mandarin poles before it, General Jamin's headquarters in 1860; the French camp in a grove opposite.

title: Wolseley: court and gate of 大宫门
excerpt_other: The gateway was at one end of a courtyard, enclosed upon three sides with ranges of guard-houses, handsomely ornamented outside with curious carving, and roofed with variegated tiling.
summary_en: Eaves with small birds and beasts, red, white, green, blue and gilt. Beam ends carved and painted. Red doors picked out in gold. Gate sills 2 or 3 ft above the pavement with granite ramps, so no wheeled traffic. Guard-room right and left within.

title: 6 October 1860: arrival at the Great Palace Gate
excerpt_other: A company of French marines scaled the outer wall and occupied the outer gate and courtyard on the night of October 6th, killing one or two of the defenders and suffering a few wounds themselves.
summary_en: French troops arrived at seven in the evening with a British cavalry brigade under Pattle. A few eunuchs defended the gate. From Cordier, quoting Montauban.

title: 7 October 1860: entry, the audience hall and the emperor's rooms
excerpt_other: We entered the central gateway upon a large paved courtyard, whereon the bodies of two Chinese officials were lying dead.
summary_en: Swinhoe, with Montauban at the entry of 7 October (n.17 identifies the dead as the eunuchs of the night before). Through the audience hall to the emperor's bedroom, the English treaty of 1858 on a table; looting began with officers. Foley saw the rooms at 6 and at 11:30 a.m. and the collections much reduced.

title: Amherst at the gate, 1816
excerpt_other: He had just arrived at daybreak, travel-worn and tired after an all-night ride over the stone road from T'ung Chou to Peking and thence, unexpectedly, on to the gate of the Yuan Ming Yuan.
summary_en: Amherst reached the gate at daybreak, refused the immediate audience and left without seeing the garden.

title: Grant's first view, 7 October 1860
excerpt_other: We passed the park walls by a fine old stately gateway, and proceeding up an avenue, came to a range of handsome dwellings roofed over with yellow tiles, turned up at the ends, Chinese fashion.
summary_en: Grant: forty small palaces in the grounds, paths in order, ornamental water, the French camped at the entrance of the Great Audience Hall. Main palace held jade, jars, enamels, bronzes, clocks; in a building near it two howitzers from Woolwich given by Macartney. 8 October: gold and silver found in one of the temples and a room of silks and furs, shared between the armies.

title: Spirit wall south of the Great Palace Gate, measured by Malone
excerpt_other: On the north side of the Fan Lake and directly south of the gate stood an ornamented spirit wall 137 feet long, over five feet thick, and about 15 feet high.
summary_en: 大影壁 Da Yingbi, the spirit wall: 137 ft long, over 5 ft thick, about 15 ft high, from Malone's own measurements before it was torn down for its materials. The road ran from it straight north to the gate, between the Fan Lakes; Qianlong's monument of 1763 stood on the west bank.

title: The Great Palace Gate and the offices before it
excerpt_other: The Great Palace Gate was a roofed building in which hung a tablet inscribed with the name of the garden, Yuan Ming Yuan, written by the Emperor K'ang Hsi.
summary_en: 大宫门 Da Gongmen: waiting rooms beside the road, behind them offices of the boards and the Eight Banners, the Grand Council, the 南书房 imperial school, treasury, dispensary and kitchens. Note 15 on p.70 lists the offices east and west of the gate by name.

title: The tea-house Garden of Peace before the Great Gate, Daoguang
excerpt_other: The book of views of various parts of China in which this description appears shows a picture of the tea-house, called the Garden of Peace, standing beyond the Fan Lake and just opposite to the Great Gate of the Palace.
summary_en: From 鸿雪因缘图记 (Hung Hsueh Yin Yuan T'u Chi) vol.3 part 2, by a Manchu official. Yellow earth on the road, curtains over side streets, shops closed as the emperor rode by towards the Empress Dowager's garden.

title: 圆明园大宫门区历史文脉调查研究
summary_en: Park study of about 2 km2 south of the garden wall: 挂甲屯, 西马厂, the 八旗 drill ground and princes' gardens that served the court, their fall after 1860. Abstract on the page, the full text is an attachment.

title: 圆明园银库：清朝兴衰晴雨表
summary_en: Traces the 圆明园 treasury as one of three in the Imperial Household's finances: its growth as a measure of Qing strength and of the garden's rise, and its decline to the plunder of 1860 by British and French troops.

title: 大宫门 河道: 2014 gilt bronze elephant head
summary_en: The park's archaeologist recalls that a heavy lump of mud from the channel side at 大宫门 in 2014 turned out, once cleaned in the lab, to be a gilt bronze elephant head. It was first shown in the 2017 圆明园考古展.

title: 大宫门考古成果 announced 2019-01-28, 中新网 via 中国日报网
summary_en: The park announced that the dig at 大宫门 Da Gongmen had found the gate hall, the east and west wing gates, the 金水桥 bridge and the river channel, and that the area would be conserved and opened in three display parts.

title: 圆明园遗址公园大宫门区域考古发掘简报, 北京市文物研究所, 12 pp.
locator: mhymy 档案史料 12331, title only
summary_en: Listed brief report on the 大宫门 dig; only the title and author are readable here. Marked as a wish.

title: Varin: lions, dragons and the first throne hall
excerpt_other: Le mur de gauche de la salle était recouvert, dans son entier, par un seul tableau peint sur soie et représentant des vues des palais impériaux.
summary_en: Lions in bronze on white marble pedestals 3 m high, too heavy to carry off. Two gilt bronze dragons on the marble bridge were carried away later (his n.1). Hall reached by a wide white marble stair; black wood throne carved through, cloisonné incense burners and large enamel vases. Picture on silk.

title: Wolseley: lions at the gate
excerpt_other: the paved road leading up to the gate, upon either side of which was the colossal representation of a lion mounted upon a granite pedestal.
summary_en: A pair of colossal lions, bronze-coloured. Later hearsay at Shanghai that they were gold, not checked; Varin p.233 calls them bronze on white marble.

title: 養吉齋叢錄 卷四
locator: 卷四, line 275 of the corpus file
excerpt_zh: 圆明园之南书房，旧在东如意门外。嘉庆辛酉，于奏事门内赐屋四楹为人直地，与军机直房相邻，而旧直庐亦不废，以内监守之，每奉敕校勘书籍于此。
summary_en: The garden's 南書房 stood outside the east 如意門. In 嘉慶辛酉 (1801) a four-bay room was added inside the memorial gate beside the Council office, and the old lodging stayed in use for checking books.

title: 日下舊聞考 园门 (十八门)、水闸三座
excerpt_zh: 園内為門十八南曰大宫門曰左右門曰東西夾道門曰東西如意門曰福園門曰西南門曰水閘門曰藻園門東曰東樓門曰鐡門曰明春門曰隨墻門曰蘂珠宫門西曰隨墻門正北曰北樓門為閘三西南為一空進水閘東北為五空出水閘為一空出水閘（圓明園冊）臣等謹按圓明園之水發源玉泉山由西馬厰入進水閘支流派衍至園内日天琳宇桞浪聞鶯諸處之響水口水勢遂分西北高而東南低五空出水閘在明春門北一空出水閘在蘂珠宫北水出苑牆經長春園出七空閘東入清河
summary_en: Lists the eighteen garden gates by compass side (大宫門, 福園門, 藻園門, 明春門, 蘂珠宫門, 北樓門 and others) and the three sluices. The note traces the water: in from 玉泉山 Jade Spring Hill by the south-west one-opening inlet, splitting at 日天琳宇 and 桞浪聞鶯, falling from north-west to south-east, out through the five-opening and one-opening sluices and across Changchun Yuan to the seven-opening sluice 七空閘.

title: 圆明园围墙历史变迁考
summary_en: Park history of the walls and gates: loss from 1919 onward (army, road stone, sales), rebuilding from 1984 to 2006 on the old line. Historic gates include 明春门, 绿油门, 蕊珠门, 秀清村门, 藻园门, 福缘门.
